An industrial leaf Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) has been authored and saved to [sop_esp32_dma_uart_spi_ring_buffer_bit_flip_ingestion.md](./docs/sop_esp32_dma_uart_spi_ring_buffer_bit_flip_ingestion.md).

### Summary of Document Structure & Specifications

```text
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  180nm DRAM Array (8F^2, 1T1C, Cs >= 28 fF, Cb/Cs 5-9) │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │ Bit-Flip Event Telemetry
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│      ESP32 Dual-Peripheral Ingestion Engine            │
│   - HS-SPI Slave (up to 40 MHz) / UART (up to 5 Mbps)  │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │ Autonomous DMA Engine
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│        SRAM Internal DMA Ping-Pong Descriptors         │
│   - Linked-List Circular Descriptors (2 KB - 4 KB/blk) │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │ Hardware ISR (EOF / Queue)
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│   FreeRTOS Double-Buffered Ring-Buffer Task (Core 0)   │
│   - Lockless Head/Tail Pointers (64 KB - 128 KB Ring)  │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │ Zero-Copy Telemetry Stream
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│   Telemetry Metrology & Retention Logger (Core 1)      │
│   - Timestamped Bit-Flip Classification & March C- Map │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

1. **Context & Physical Parameters Incorporated**:
   - **Cell Geometry & Topology**: 180nm channel length ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), stacked capacitor (COB) crown MIM/poly structure with high-$\kappa$/ONO ($\kappa > 15$).
   - **Capacitance & Leakage Constraints**: Storage node budget $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$ (25–30 fF), $C_b = 150\text{ to }250\text{ fF}$ across 256/512 cells/bitline, $C_b/C_s$ maintained at $5:1\text{ to }9:1$ (must not exceed $10:1$), leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - **Pipeline Specifications**: High-speed SPI slave (up to $40\text{ MHz}$) and UART (up to $5.0\text{ Mbps}$), dual ping-pong internal SRAM DMA buffers ($B_{dma} = 4096\text{ bytes}$), $128\text{ KB}$ lockless circular software ring-buffer with hardware flow control and backpressure handshaking.

2. **Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets**:
   - **Max Ingestion Throughput**: $\ge 20.0\text{ Mbit/s}$ ($\pm 0.5\text{ Mbit/s}$).
   - **Packet/Frame Loss Rate**: $0\text{ frames lost}$ ($0.00\%$ loss over $1.0\times 10^7$ frames).
   - **DMA Buffer Switching Latency**: $\le 1.8\ \mu\text{s}$ ($\pm 0.2\ \mu\text{s}$).
   - **Ring-Buffer Fill Headroom**: $\ge 40.0\%$ reserved margin under $10\text{ MB/s}$ burst load.

3. **Citations & Verification**:
   - Cited *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*, *1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets*, and *SkyWater 130nm Open PDK Overview & Architecture*.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Ingesting high-throughput bit-flip streams from a 180nm DRAM test vehicle via ESP32 DMA UART/SPI requires strict isolation between the DMA bus master and the FreeRTOS dual-core task scheduling. The internal SRAM arbiter on the ESP32 introduces contention when Core 0 runs Wi-Fi/BT stacks while Core 1 handles double-buffered ring descriptor handoffs. The circular buffer must reside entirely in internal SRAM (DRAM domain) rather than external PSRAM because SPI/PSRAM bus cache miss latencies of 20-30 CPU cycles will cause DMA FIFO overrun and burst packet drops under sustained 20 Mbps bit-error streaming.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At Gen 2 (180nm planar node), DRAM cell retention degradation exhibits strong spatial clustering and bursty error bursts during March C- test passes (specifically M2: ↕(r0, w1) and M4: ↕(r1, w0)). When weak capacitors experience rapid leakage, telemetry bursts can generate back-to-back bit-flip coordinate frames. If the SPI slave/UART peripheral lacks hardware flow control (CTS/RTS or SPI handshake READY line) or if the DMA descriptor chain wrap-around is not managed with atomic lock-free head/tail pointers, transient backpressure will corrupt the sequential bit-flip address mapping.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Specifying ESP32-WROOM-32E or ESP32-S3 modules for metrology instrumentation exposes the test bench to silicon revision differences (e.g., ECO revisions modifying peripheral DMA FIFO depth and internal pull-ups). Sourcing must require genuine Espressif modules with consistent silicon rev v3.0+, AEC-Q100 or industrial temp rating (-40°C to +105°C) to withstand prolonged exposure adjacent to hot-stage wafer chucks and environmental thermal profiling setups.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The project timeline requires immediate plug-and-play validation of COTS ESP32 telemetry hardware to unblock the Automated Parametric Retention & March C- metrology testbed. Sourcing off-the-shelf boards avoids custom FPGA breakout spins, but firmware validation must be completed within 10 engineering days. Delay risks stalling wafer-level parametric characterization runs across quartz tube diffusion furnace thermal profiling splits.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. DMA descriptor ring buffer overrun during March C- burst error surges resulting in unlogged retention fault addresses and unrecoverable frame desynchronization.
1. Internal SRAM bus arbitration contention between CPU Core 1 cache refill and DMA controller causing silent frame corruption without hardware CRC flags.
1. Ground bounce and ringing on 3.3V LVCMOS SPI/UART lines at >10 MHz data rates over cable runs between the probe station/chuck interface and the ESP32 breakout.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-FIRMWARE-3-2-1-01` | **Sustained Maximum Ingestion Bandwidth and DMA Descriptor Wrap-Around Stress Test** | Keysight 33622A Arbitrary Waveform Generator / Pattern Generator, Saleae Logic Pro 16 Logic Analyzer, ESP32 Development Board (ESP32-WROOM-32E), Host PC running Python telemetry verification client over USB-UART. | 1. Connect pattern generator to ESP32 RX/MOSI inputs and inject a continuous pseudorandom binary sequence (PRBS9) framed with 16-bit sync headers and incremental 32-bit packet sequence numbers at exactly 10.00 Mbps for 60 consecutive minutes. 2. Monitor host-side ingestion buffer to verify contiguous sequence number receipt. 3. Measure GPIO toggle latency on descriptor completion ISR using the logic analyzer. 4. Introduce transient 12.5 Mbps burst injections for 200 ms intervals to test backpressure behavior. | `Zero dropped packets (packet loss rate = 0.00%) over 4.5 GB of transferred test frames; maximum DMA descriptor ISR service latency must not exceed 4.8 microseconds; ring-buffer overflow flag counter must register exactly 0 under nominal 10.0 Mbps sustained throughput.` |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-FIRMWARE-3-2-1-02` | **Retention Bit-Flip Burst Telemetry and Timestamp Accuracy Validation** | Rigol DG4162 Function/Arbitrary Generator, Tektronix MSO54 4-Channel Oscilloscope, ESP32-WROOM-32E metrology interface node, Host telemetry logging workstation. | 1. Program pattern generator to simulate 10,000 synthetic DRAM retention failures structured as burst-mode bit-flip packets (32-bit row/col address + 64-bit microsecond timestamp + 16-bit CRC). 2. Fire burst sequence at an instantaneous peak rate of 50,000 events/second for a 500 ms burst duration. 3. Record logged arrival timestamps and compare with generator trigger pulse timestamps on the oscilloscope. 4. Verify CRC integrity across all logged failure coordinate records. | `100.0% of the 10,000 synthetic failure frames captured with zero CRC mismatches; logged timestamp jitter relative to master pulse trigger must remain within ±2.0 microseconds.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact-resistant safety glasses with side shields, ESD-safe dissipative nitrile gloves (class 0, 4-mil thickness), Static-dissipative lab coat (cleanroom class 100/1000 compatible), Grounded ESD heel straps or conductive cleanroom safety shoes
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For IPA skin contact: Wash thoroughly with non-abrasive soap and copious water for 15 minutes. For IPA eye contact: Flush eyes immediately at eyewash station for minimum 15 minutes with eyelids held open. For flux smoke inhalation: Move personnel immediately to fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing becomes labored. Consult medical staff if irritation persists.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Benchtop localized ESD-safe fume extraction hood with active charcoal and HEPA filtration operating at a minimum face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM) during any soldering, board rework, or solvent cleaning operations.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent IPA and solvent-wetted lint-free cleanroom wipes in dedicated, hermetically sealed, red polypropylene flammable hazardous waste receptacles. Dispose via approved hazardous organic solvent chemical waste stream; do not pour into sanitary or acidic drains.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Grade (VLSI / MOS Grade) | `99.9%` |
| **Lead-Free Solder Residue (Flux Rosin Core)** | `65997-06-0` | Technical Grade | `<3.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `48 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Bare ENIG (Electroless Nickel Immersion Gold) or Lead-Free HASL PCB connector pads free of oxidation, flux residue, and ionic contamination (< 0.1 ug/cm2 equivalent NaCl).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Assembled ESP32 interface header pins solvent-cleaned, dry, and sealed with conformal coating or anti-static barrier film ready for probe station interface docking.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Atmospheric moisture absorption and sulfide tarnishing on exposed probe connector contacts cause contact resistance instability (> 50 mOhm variation), leading to signal integrity attenuation and bit errors at >10 MHz telemetry clock rates.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified COTS ESP32-WROOM-32E dual-core ingestion firmware architecture featuring a double-buffered DMA circular ring buffer that ingests DRAM retention bit-flip data streams over UART/SPI at up to 10 Mbps without frame loss, providing microsecond-level hardware timestamping for March C- parametric diagnostics.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:

- [ ] `bitflip_ingestion_stress_telemetry_report.pdf`
- [ ] `sustained_10mbps_stream_validation_log.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Zero frame drop rate across circular DMA descriptor chain under sustained 10 Mbps PRBS9 streaming** | `0` | +0 packets | Automated packet sequence auditor analyzing 60-minute ingestion log file. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Hardware bit-flip event timestamp acquisition latency jitter relative to hardware trigger** | `1.0` | ±1.0 us | MSO54 4-channel oscilloscope time-interval error (TIE) measurement across 10,000 pulses. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Maximum DMA buffer handover ISR execution execution latency on ESP32 Core 1** | `3.5` | < 5.0 us | Embedded DWT cycle counter measurement toggling GPIO debug pin monitored by logic analyzer. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Successful completion of 60-minute continuous 10 Mbps streaming stress test without descriptor overrun or parity errors, 100% capture of 10,000 synthetic burst failure packets with verified CRC, and formal engineering review signoff by Systems Engineer and Domain Expert.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Precision Microsecond Hardware Timestamping & Protocol Packetization Engine

**Level:** Leaf SOP  
**Subsystem:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > Metrology & Firmware  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm-scale metrology / 180 nm node)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### Architectural Flow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Sense Amp Readout    │
│        Latched         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  ESP32 Hardware Timer  │
│        Capture         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Packet Serialization  │
│       and CRC16        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   DMA Double Buffer    │
│          Ring          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  High-Speed Telemetry  │
│       Streaming        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Hardware Timer Clock & Prescaler Initialization:**
   - Configure the ESP32 64-bit hardware general-purpose timer (Timer Group 0, Timer 0) with an APB clock source ($80\text{ MHz}$).
   - Set the clock prescaler divider to $80$ to establish an exact $1\text{ MHz}$ tick frequency, yielding an intrinsic timestamp granularity of exactly $1.0\ \mu\text{s}$.
   - Enable auto-reload on 64-bit overflow to guarantee monotonic timestamp continuity during multi-hour retention decay tests.

2. **Sense Amplifier Latch Trigger Coupling:**
   - Interface the sensing latch completion strobe from the DRAM folded-bitline sense amplifier controller (following bitline equalization to $V_{DD}/2$ and access transistor turn-on where $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}(V_{\text{cell}} - V_{DD}/2)$ develops $\sim 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$) to an interrupt-capable GPIO on the ESP32.
   - Configure the GPIO edge detector to capture the 64-bit timer register on the rising edge of `SAN`/latch assertion via direct register access inside the ISR.

3. **Telemetry Packet Serialization & Framing:**
   - Allocate fixed-size, packed binary frames (32 bytes) structured as follows:
     - **Header & Sync Marker:** 2 bytes (`0xAA55`)
     - **Hardware Timestamp:** 8 bytes (64-bit microsecond counter)
     - **Address Coordinates:** 4 bytes (Row address [12 bits], Column address [10 bits], Bank ID [2 bits])
     - **Cell Electrical Metrology:** 4 bytes (Readout state bit, expected state bit, bit-flip flag, estimated signal margin $\Delta V$)
     - **Environmental Telemetry:** 6 bytes (Junction temperature and supply voltage monitor ADC counts)
     - **Frame Index & Reserved:** 6 bytes
     - **Integrity Checksum:** 2 bytes (CRC-16-CCITT across bytes 0–29)
   - Perform bit-flip delta detection by XOR-ing the sense amplifier readout bit against the March C- expected background pattern.

4. **Zero-Copy DMA Ring Buffering & Packet Transmission:**
   - Queue serialized packets into a double-buffered ping-pong ring buffer (minimum buffer depth: 256 entries per block) using DMA-backed streaming over high-speed UART ($921,600\text{ baud}$) or USB-CDC.
   - Guard against buffer overruns by verifying that the packetization ISR execution latency remains below $4.0\ \mu\text{s}$ per bit-flip readout event.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hardware Timestamp Resolution** | `1.0` | $\pm 0.0$ (deterministic prescaler) | $\mu\text{s}$ |
| **ISR Capture & Serialization Latency** | $\le 4.0$ | $\text{Max } 5.0$ | $\mu\text{s}$ |
| **DRAM Sensing Differential Threshold ($\Delta V$)** | `100` to `150` | $\text{Min } 80$ | $\text{mV}$ |
| **Packet Data Integrity (CRC-16 Error Rate)** | `0.0` | $0\text{ corrupted frames in } 10^6\text{ packets}$ | $\text{Bit errors}$ |

---

### 3. Context Citations

- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout:**  
  Bitlines equalized to $V_{DD}/2$; differential voltage signal development $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}(V_{\text{cell}} - V_{DD}/2)$ yields approximately $100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$ across bitlines BL and /BL for nominal cell parameters ($C_s \approx 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$), establishing the sensing trigger threshold for retention flip metrology.
- **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets:**  
  180 nm folded bitline cell area ($8F^2 = 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$), nominal storage capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$, and bitline capacitance $C_b = 150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$ defining the physical capacitance ratio budget ($5:1$ to $9:1$) monitored by the packetization telemetry engine.
- **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018):**  
  Photolithographic process controls and alignment constraints for Gen 2 (improving to $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$ tolerance), defining the physical layer fabrication fidelity under which cell capacitance and leakage parameters operate.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: On the ESP32 dual-core Xtensa architecture, dedicating PRO_CPU to timing-critical retention pulse generation and APP_CPU to DMA packetization is non-negotiable. If hardware timer ISRs share bus arbitration with the FreeRTOS tick or SPI/UART DMA engines, interrupt latency jitter will breach the 1 µs threshold. The 64-bit hardware timer counter (TIMERG0) must be latched directly into the ring buffer via direct register access, bypassing OS scheduling wrappers entirely to prevent variable dispatch jitter.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm DRAM node parametric characterization, storage node junction leakage currents (sub-fA/cell) dictate retention times spanning from tens of milliseconds to tens of seconds. Precise correlation between variable retention pause time and physical cell failure coordinates requires strictly deterministic timestamping. Timestamp jitter exceeding 2.5 µs introduces unacceptable ambiguity into high-temperature Arrhenius activation energy (Ea) curve fittings for junction trap identification.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Standard ESP32-WROOM modules integrate low-cost 40 MHz crystal oscillators characterized by ±20 ppm frequency tolerance and severe thermal drift (~0.5 ppm/°C). Thermal cycling near wafer-level heated chucks (25°C to 125°C) will distort packet timestamp intervals. Sourcing ESP32 modules with external temperature-compensated crystal oscillators (TCXO) or feeding an external 10 MHz reference to an input capture GPIO pin is essential to avoid measurement discrepancies across test fixtures.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The telemetry protocol packet structure must adhere strictly to a fixed-width binary frame schema (32-byte header with magic byte, 64-bit microsecond timestamp, 32-bit fail address, 16-bit physical row/col, and CRC16-CCITT). Streaming raw ASCII or JSON over UART at microsecond rates saturates the serial bus and overruns ring buffers during burst March C- fail cascades, violating our milestone telemetry bandwidth and data retention audit requirements.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Hardware timer counter rollover or asynchronous interrupt preemption during 64-bit read causing high-order word corruption and multi-second timestamp discontinuities.
1. DMA ring buffer overrun during sudden high-density bit-flip cascades, causing silent packet drops and catastrophic loss of retention failure temporal ordering.
1. Thermal-induced oscillator drift and clock slew across high-temperature retention testing, resulting in false acceleration factors and distorted Arrhenius activation energy calculations.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-FIRMWARE-3-2-2-01` | **Microsecond Hardware Timer Determinism and Interrupt Latency Jitter Verification** | Keysight DSOX3024T 200 MHz 4-channel Digital Storage Oscilloscope, Rigol DG1022Z Arbitrary Waveform Generator, Keysight 53220A 350 MHz Universal Frequency Counter/Timer. | 1. Connect function generator to GPIO18 supplying a 10 kHz 3.3V square pulse train with 50% duty cycle. 2. Connect Oscilloscope Channel 1 to GPIO18 and Channel 2 to GPIO19. 3. Configure oscilloscope persistence to infinite and trigger on Channel 1 rising edge. 4. Capture 1,000,000 consecutive edge transitions. 5. Measure the delta-t propagation delay between input edge and ISR output strobe across all 1,000,000 cycles, recording mean latency and peak-to-peak jitter. | `Mean interrupt latency must measure <= 1.20 µs with peak-to-peak jitter <= 0.25 µs across 1,000,000 samples. Zero samples may exceed 1.50 µs total latency.` |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-FIRMWARE-3-2-2-02` | **Sustained Burst Telemetry Packetization and Zero-Loss Stream Throughput Test** | Host PC running custom Python/C telemetry validation suite, Total Phase Beagle I2C/SPI/UART Protocol Analyzer, FTDI FT232H High-Speed USB-to-UART Bridge operating at 3 Mbaud. | 1. Connect ESP32 UART TX to protocol analyzer and FTDI high-speed interface. 2. Initiate continuous synthetic fault injection stream at a sustained rate of 10,000 packets/second for exactly 3,600 seconds (1 hour, 3.6 x 10^7 total packets). 3. Host software validates packet sequence monotonically increasing counters, 64-bit hardware timestamps, and CRC16-CCITT integrity. 4. Protocol analyzer monitors physical UART line for framing errors, parity errors, and buffer overflow flags. | `Zero dropped packets out of 36,000,000 frames (Packet Loss = 0.00%). All CRC16 checksums must pass 100%. Inter-packet timestamp deltas must remain monotonic with zero negative step deviations.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: EN 166 compliant UV-protective and impact-resistant safety glasses, Static-dissipative ESD lab coat with wrist strap grounding (ANSI/ESD S20.20), Powder-free Class 100 nitrile gloves (EN ISO 374-1), ESD-safe safety shoes with conductive heel grounders
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye exposure: Flush immediately with copious amounts of tempered water for at least 15 minutes at an eyewash station; seek medical consultation if irritation persists. Inhalation: Move subject to fresh air immediately. Skin contact: Wash thoroughly with mild soap and DI water.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard electronics cleanroom laminar flow bench (ISO Class 6) with local chemical fume extraction snorkel providing face velocity >= 0.5 m/s during solvent cleaning of PCB assemblies.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA wipe cloths and rinse solutions must be collected in grounded, airtight, dedicated flammable hazardous solvent drums. Disposed in accordance with cleanroom solvent waste streams; do not drain into municipal water lines.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor / Electronic Grade (VLSI) | `99.9% v/v` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: As-fabricated and soldered PCB with gold-immersion (ENIG) test pad finish, ultrasonic-cleaned with VLSI-grade IPA and dried under 99.999% dry nitrogen purge.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Conformal coated or dry-nitrogen dessicator stored controller board ready for mechanical integration into automated wafer probe card interface.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Atmospheric humidity adsorption and ionic salt contamination across high-impedance ADC/comparator analog sensing pins and UART differential traces, inducing parasitic leakage, false bit triggers, and clock phase jitter.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Delivery and full hardware-in-the-loop verification of bare-metal microsecond timestamping firmware and DMA binary packetization engine for ESP32, enabling deterministic, zero-loss telemetry capture during high-speed parametric DRAM retention and March C- fault analysis.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `esp32_hw_timestamp_telemetry_engine_v1.0.bin`
- [ ] `timestamp_jitter_and_dma_latency_report.pdf`
- [ ] `burst_telemetry_1hr_verification_log.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Maximum peak-to-peak hardware timestamp acquisition jitter across 1,000,000 triggered events** | `0.20 µs` | +0.05 µs | High-bandwidth 200 MHz digital storage oscilloscope persistence measurement cross-checked with hardware frequency counter. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Sustained packet streaming throughput without buffer overrun or frame drop under continuous fault injection** | `10000 packets/sec` | +1000, -0 packets/sec | Automated CRC16 protocol analyzer parsing and sequence continuity verification across 36,000,000 consecutive frames over 3 Mbaud UART. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **End-to-end binary packet encoding and DMA ring buffer insertion execution time** | `4.5 µs` | ±0.5 µs | Direct cycle-count profiling using Xtensa CCOUNT processor register before and after packetization subroutine. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Successful completion of 1-hour sustained 10,000 pkt/s stress test with zero packet drops, 100% valid CRC16-CCITT frames, hardware timestamp jitter <= 0.25 µs, and formal approval by both Lead Systems Engineer and DRAM Metrology Lead.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Identification
- **Title**: High-Throughput COTS USB-to-High-Speed Serial Transceiver & Host Ingestion Metrology
- **Task Hierarchy**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > ESP32 Closed-Loop Motor Controller [Electronics & Firmware] > Automated Parametric Retention & March C- Diagnostic Test Firmware [Firmware & Software] > Automated Variable-Delay Parametric Retention Metrology & Telemetry Logger [Metrology] > High-Speed Telemetry Streaming & Timestamped Bit-Flip Logger Integration [Firmware & Software] > High-Throughput COTS USB-to-High-Speed Serial Transceiver & Host Ingestion Metrology [Metrology]
- **Generation**: Gen 2 (µm)
- **Action Type**: Buy (COTS Integration & Metrology Qualification)

---

## 1. System Architecture & Metrology Flow

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│        180nm 1T1C DRAM Matrix Under Test     │
│   (Cs = 25-28 fF, Delta V = 100-150 mV, 85°C)│
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       │ March C- / Retention Triggers
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│       ESP32 Controller & Telemetry Engine    │
│    (High-Speed Streamer & Bit-Flip Logger)   │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       │ 3.3V CMOS UART / High-Speed Serial
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│     COTS USB-to-Serial Transceiver (FT232H)  │
│         (High-Speed 480 Mbps USB PHY)        │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       │ High-Speed USB Packet Frame Stream
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│     Host Ingestion & Diagnostic Pipeline     │
│   (Zero-Loss Ingestion, March C- Analyzer)   │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

### Step 1: COTS Hardware Procurement & Physical Interconnect Setup
1. Procure an industrial COTS High-Speed USB-to-Serial UART/FIFO transceiver board (FTDI FT232H / FT2232H or equivalent USB 2.0 High-Speed 480 Mbps bridge).
2. Wire the 3.3V CMOS level serial UART/synchronous serial interface between the ESP32 diagnostic controller and the COTS transceiver:
   - Connect `TXD` (ESP32) $\rightarrow$ `RXD` (Transceiver).
   - Connect `RXD` (ESP32) $\leftarrow$ `TXD` (Transceiver).
   - Connect hardware flow control lines `RTS`/`CTS` to prevent hardware FIFO overruns during burst diagnostic streaming.
   - Bond common ground with impedance-controlled return paths to ensure clean edge transitions without ground bounce.

### Step 2: Transceiver & Controller Firmware Baud Configuration
1. Configure the ESP32 high-speed UART clock divider to operate at a verified baud rate of **3.00 Mbaud** or **12.00 Mbaud** (synchronous FIFO mode) with 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit (8-N-1).
2. Set USB transceiver latency timer to **1 ms** via host EEPROM/driver configuration (FTDI VCP/D2XX driver) to prevent buffering stalls during sparse retention bit-flip events.

### Step 3: Diagnostic Stream Protocol & Timestamped Bit-Flip Payload Structuring
1. Implement framed packet streaming for March C- diagnostic runs ($12N$ operations) and variable retention delay sweeps:
   - Header sync word: `0x55AA55AA`.
   - Payload: 64-bit microsecond hardware timestamp, 32-bit row/column matrix address, 8-bit written value, 8-bit sensed read value ($\Delta V$ discrimination), and 16-bit CRC checksum.
2. In variable-delay parametric retention testing across the nominal target window ($> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$), stream both failure coordinate logs and heartbeat frames.

### Step 4: Host Ingestion Pipeline & Throughput Verification
1. Launch the host ingestion metrology daemon (Python / C++ with ring-buffer memory pool and non-blocking I/O).
2. Execute continuous transmission stress test over 10 consecutive retention runs, capturing at sustained raw bitstreams with throughput verification.
3. Validate frame integrity via end-to-end CRC validation; verify zero packet loss and zero byte drops under peak March C- fault-burst emulation.

---

## 3. Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                        Metrology Ingestion Targets     
                   ┌───────────────────────────────────┐
```

## 4. Context Source Citations

1. **`180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench`**:
   - Access transistor geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Minimum cell storage capacitance budget: $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$.
   - Sub-threshold and junction leakage threshold: $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
2. **`Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering`**:
   - Minimum storage capacitance: $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF/cell}$.
   - Data retention time target: $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Stacked capacitor physical thickness and gate dielectric dry oxidation ($850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$, $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$).
3. **`Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout`**:
   - Differential bitline readout signal: $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$.
   - Signal development range: $100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$ based on $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Bondwire loop height (< 150 um) and parasitic bondwire inductance (target < 1.2 nH) must not degrade DDR power distribution network (PDN) or induce simultaneous switching noise (SSN). Pinout strictly conforms to JEDEC TSOP-54 / FBGA-60.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: Wafer backgrinding to 150 um must maintain total thickness variation (TTV) < 5 um with zero micro-cracking. Thermosonic gold/copper wirebond ball shear force must exceed 18 gf. Epoxy mold compound (EMC) CTE must match silicon (~3 ppm/K).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Leadframes, ceramic carrier substrates, and Sumitomo/Henkel certified mold compound are COTS. Wafer saw dicing and thermosonic ball bonding can be performed on local lab bonder or contracted to regional OSAT partner.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 40-80 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Die dicing micro-chipping or thermosonic pad delamination causes open circuit or moisture ingress popcorning during 260°C solder reflow).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Dicing blade vibration inducing micro-cracks penetrating active guard ring, leading to moisture degradation.
1. Intermetallic compound (IMC) voiding (Kirkendall effect) at wirebond pad interface causing open circuits.
1. Package delamination / popcorning during surface-mount reflow soldering due to mold compound moisture absorption.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

Position shear chisel 3.0 um above bond pad aluminum metallization. 2. Perform destructive lateral ball shear test on 30 randomly selected bond balls across peripheral pads. 3. Hook bondwire loop at mid-span and execute vertical pull test to wire rupture according to MIL-STD-883 Method 2011. | `Ball shear force >= 18.0 gf with > 75% ductile residual aluminum coverage (Pass); Wire pull strength >= 5.0 gf (Pass).` |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-FIRMWARE-3-2-3-02` | **Electrical Die Sort (EDS) Cold/Hot Wafer Sort Array Pattern Test** | Advantest / Teradyne Automated Wafer Prober with Multi-Contact Epoxy Probe Card | 1. Step probe card pins to die contact pads with 50 um probe overdrive. 2. Execute JEDEC parametric DC continuity, leakage, and standby IDD current tests. 3. Run algorithmic March C- memory test across all rows and columns to map functional bit yield. | `Parametric DC continuity pass (Pass); Standby current IDD2N <= 150 uA (Pass); Array yield >= 90% functional dies (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Conductive ESD grounding wrist strap and heel grounders, Nitrile chemical-resistant gloves (for die-attach epoxy dispensing), Safety glasses with side shields, Particulate N95 respirator during wafer sawing wheel changes and dicing sludge cleanup
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact with uncured epoxy: Wash with copious soap and warm water (do not use solvents like acetone which increase dermal absorption). Eye contact with silica dicing slurry: Flush at eyewash for 15 minutes.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dicing saw fully enclosed with continuous high-volume DI water mist shroud. Mold press and post-mold curing ovens vented through dedicated VOC thermal oxidizer exhaust stack.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Silicon dicing slurry centrifuged and segregated into solid cake for non-hazardous landfill. Cured thermoset epoxy scrap disposed of as regulated solid waste.

| **Silver-Filled Conductive Die Attach Adhesive** | `7440-22-4` | Electronic Grade Silver Flake | `70-80 wt% Ag in epoxy base` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `48.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Saw-diced wafer mounted on UV dicing tape, clean and dry with zero particulate or water residue.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Epoxy die-attached, cured, and thermosonically wirebonded to leadframe/substrate pads prior to molding.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Atmospheric oxidation of exposed aluminum/copper bond pads degrades thermosonic ball bond adhesion, inducing high electrical contact resistance or catastrophic non-stick bond pad lifts.

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of High-Throughput COTS USB-to-High-Speed Serial Transceiver & Host Ingestion Metrology: BEOL metallization, electrical die sort (EDS), wafer backgrinding/dicing, and wirebond plastic encapsulation successfully yield JEDEC-qualified DRAM packaged units.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Parametric Charge-Decay Metrology & Cell Retention Characterization Protocol

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 2 (µm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The closed-loop integration between the ESP32 diagnostic controller and the 180nm DRAM test fixture relies on synchronous GPIO/SPI telemetry that lacks deterministic sub-microsecond timestamping. Jitter during automated March C- and variable-delay retention sweeps introduces timing skew into parametric decay curve fitting, directly obscuring subthreshold leakage versus gate-induced drain leakage (GIDL) separation. Furthermore, driving wordline level shifters from unregulated bench supplies risks ground bounce on bitline reference rails during simultaneous multi-bank sense amplifier strobing.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm node with a planar/stacked cell capacitance of C_s ~ 25 fF and bitline parasitic capacitance C_BL ~ 250 fF, the signal margin Delta V developed across the folded bitline pair is only 100 mV to 150 mV. If the Dickson charge pump driving V_PP fails to maintain >= 2.6V under active wordline load, incomplete full-rail '1' writing (V_DD - V_th ~ 1.2V) reduces initial stored charge Q_s by >33%, collapsing the differential read signal down to <50 mV and inducing false bit-flip misclassifications in retention tail distributions.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Custom high-voltage Dickson charge pump verification fixtures and precision picoammeter SMU channels (e.g., Keysight B2902B / Keithley 2636B) face extended procurement lead times and high calibration overhead. The metrology protocol must leverage available COTS ESP32-S3 microcontroller breakout boards with calibrated internal DAC/ADC telemetry buffers and discrete fast solid-state switches (such as ADG1436) to avoid qualification line stoppages.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The characterization cycle budget allocates only 120 seconds per retention wafer coupon, which conflicts with measuring 64ms-to-10s pause-refresh distributions across varying junction temperatures (25°C to 85°C). The test firmware must implement logarithmic pause-time binning (e.g., 10ms, 50ms, 250ms, 1s, 5s) and parallel wordline row group sampling to prevent test execution bottlenecks from breaching sprint delivery milestones.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. V_PP charge pump droop below 2.5V under rapid row-hammer write bursts, inducing sub-threshold pass-gate write truncation and premature retention tail collapse.
1. Parasitic substrate injection and junction leakage acceleration caused by thermal drift during unchilled hot-chuck testing, masking native capacitor dielectric degradation.
1. Sense amplifier precharge voltage (V_DD/2 = 0.9V) drift due to equalization transistor mismatch, creating offset latch errors that register false cell charge loss.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-FIRMWARE-3-3-01` | **Automated V_PP Overdrive Retention Tail & March C- Degradation Sweep** | Keysight B2902B Source Measure Unit (SMU), Rigol MSO5000 Mixed Signal Oscilloscope, Custom ESP32-S3 Firmware Test Fixture with level shifters, ThermoStream Temptronic thermal chuck (-10°C to +125°C). | 1. Execute full-array March C- sequence {up(w0); up(r0,w1); up(r1,w0); down(r0,w1); down(r1,w0); down(r0)} at standard refresh interval (64 ms) to confirm baseline 100% bit yield. 2. Write solid data '1' (charge state = Q_s) across Bank 0 (1024 rows x 256 columns). 3. Disable auto-refresh controller and impose programmable retention pause delta t stepping logarithmically from 10 ms to 10.0 s in 20 logarithmic increments. 4. Trigger high-speed read strobe via ESP32 GPIO, asserting wordlines at V_PP = 2.7V; capture folded bitline differential development waveform on oscilloscope channels 1 & 2. 5. Log failing bit coordinates, bit-error rate (BER), and sense-amplifier latch time via ESP32 telemetry UART stream at 921600 baud. 6. Repeat sweep while stepping Dickson pump output voltage V_PP from 2.7V down to 1.8V in 100mV decrements to quantify write-loss retention degradation. | `Fail if median retention time t_ret(50%) at 85°C drops below 250 ms when V_PP >= 2.6V. Fail if differential bitline voltage Delta V < 90 mV during sense amplifier strobe. Fail if March C- detects non-retention structural faults (stuck-at, transition, coupling) across Bank 0.` |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-FIRMWARE-3-3-02` | **Subthreshold Pass-Gate Leakage & Storage Node Charge-Decay Metrology** | Keithley 4200-SCS Parameter Analyzer with 4210-PA preamplifiers (1 fA current resolution), Cascade Microtech Summit 12000 probe station with triaxial shielding, ESP32 telemetry capture bridge. | 1. Set V_BL = 1.80V, pulse V_WL to 2.70V for 100 ns to fully charge isolated cell capacitor C_s (25 fF) to 1.80V, then immediately pull V_WL to 0.0V (pass transistor off). 2. Force V_BL to 0.0V to establish maximum drain-to-source stress (V_DS = 1.8V) across the unselected pass transistor. 3. Hold quiescent state for duration tau = 1.0 s, continuously logging off-state drain leakage current I_off on SMU2 at 1 kHz sampling rate. 4. Pulse V_WL to 2.70V and execute fast charge-integration Coulomb measurement Q_rem via pulsed IV on SMU2 to compute remaining storage node voltage V_cell = Q_rem / C_s. 5. Compute retention decay constant tau_decay = -t / ln(V_cell / V_DD) across temperatures 25°C, 50°C, and 85°C. | `Pass if off-state leakage I_off <= 0.85 fA per cell at 25°C and <= 25.0 fA per cell at 85°C. Pass if retained storage node voltage V_cell >= 1.35V after 100 ms hold at 85°C (retention loss <= 25%). Fail if gate-induced drain leakage (GIDL) exceeds 2.0 fA under -0.5V V_BB bias.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom-compatible nitrile gloves (minimum 5 mil thickness, double-gloved during chemical wipe down), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact splash-resistant safety glasses with side shields, ESD-safe anti-static cleanroom lab coat with conductive wrist strap grounding tethered to bench busbar, Thermal protective insulated gloves rated to -50°C to +150°C for Temptronic ThermoStream chuck handling
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye Contact: Immediately flush eyes with gently flowing isotonic eyewash solution for at least 15 minutes while holding eyelids open; seek immediate ophthalmological attention. Skin Contact: Remove contaminated clothing and rinse skin thoroughly with copious water for 15 minutes. Inhalation: Relocate victim to fresh uncontaminated air; if breathing is labored, administer medical oxygen by certified personnel; seek emergency medical care. High Voltage Electrical Shock: Disconnect electrical mains immediately via emergency stop button; verify pulse and respiration; initiate CPR if non-responsive and deploy AED.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operation must be conducted within a certified laminar flow hood / clean bench providing minimum face velocity of 0.45 m/s (90 fpm) with ULPA filtration. Dedicated local solvent exhaust snorkel required for open IPA solvent wipe stations with minimum exhaust capture volume of 50 CFM. Thermal chuck nitrogen exhaust line must be vented directly into facility scrubber exhaust duct to prevent oxygen displacement.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA solvent wipes and rinse liquids must be collected in closed, grounded, explosion-proof Type I red safety cans labeled 'Hazardous Flammable Solvent Waste - Isopropanol'. Store in NFPA-approved flammable cabinets. Dispose via certified licensed hazardous waste disposal contractor; strictly zero drain disposal. Solder flux residues and lead-free electronic waste must be segregated into dedicated solid toxic waste containment.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Grade VLSI / Electronic Grade | `>= 99.9%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (N2 Gas)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity (UHP) Grade 5.0 | `>= 99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly opened, passivated (Si3N4 / polyimide) wafer coupon or unpackaged open-cavity test package with micro-cleansed bond pads free of particulate contamination (>0.2 um) and organic residue.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Electrically characterized wafer coupon with intact wire bonds or probe marks exhibiting scrub depth < 1.5 um and no pass-through cratering to underlying inter-metal dielectric (IMD).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive atmospheric humidity exposure (>45% RH) induces moisture absorption in inter-metal dielectric oxides and native copper/aluminum pad oxidation, causing non-ohmic micro-probe contact resistance, parasitic surface leakage paths across bitline pads, and invalid subthreshold parametric retention measurements.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full empirical parametric qualification and telemetry validation of the 180nm DRAM cell charge decay characteristics, confirming that V_PP overdrive >= 2.6V sustains storage node cell retention t_ret > 250ms at 85°C with folded bitline sense amplifier differential margins exceeding 100 mV.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram180_retention_charge_decay_telemetry_dataset.csv`
- [ ] `vpp_overdrive_vs_bitline_sensing_margin_report.pdf`
- [ ] `probe_station_contact_scrub_damage_inspection.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-PARAM-RET-01` | **Storage node capacitor retention time t_ret at 50% bit-failure boundary under 85°C chuck temperature with V_PP = 2.70V must meet or exceed minimum target.** | `250 ms` | +500 ms / -25 ms | Automated ESP32-S3 variable-delay logarithmic pause retention sweep cross-verified with Keysight B2902B SMU pulse-sense telemetry. |
| `ASSERT-PARAM-VPP-02` | **On-chip boosted wordline driver voltage (V_PP) output from the Dickson charge pump under 20 MHz active switching load must remain above minimum threshold.** | `2.65 V` | ±0.05 V | High-impedance active micro-probing (10 MOhm, <1 pF probe) captured on Rigol MSO5000 oscilloscope during multi-row write bursts. |
| `ASSERT-PARAM-SENSE-03` | **Folded bitline complementary differential signal development Delta V across BL and /BL prior to sense amplifier latch activation must exceed critical sensing threshold.** | `125 mV` | ±25 mV | Sub-picosecond differential oscilloscope probe measurement directly across test-structure sense amplifier bitline pairs during wordline assertion. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Unambiguous researcher sign-off requires: 100% completion of March C- diagnostics with zero non-retention hard errors; automated logarithmic retention decay curves generated across a minimum of 3 coupon dies over temperatures 25°C, 50°C, and 85°C confirming t_ret(85°C) >= 250 ms; V_PP charge pump stability verified at >= 2.60V under maximum burst load; and probe mark scrub damage verified < 1.5 um depth via optical/SEM profilometry.

testcases.pre_conditions: Device under test (DUT) bonded to test substrate; ambient temperature stabilized at 85.0°C ± 0.5°C; V_DD regulated at 1.80V ± 10mV; V_PP generated at 2.70V ± 20mV via onboard Dickson oscillator; all storage nodes initialized to alternating checkerboard (AAh/55h) via March C-.
testcases.procedure:
1. Execute full-array March C- sequence {up(w0); up(r0,w1); up(r1,w0); down(r0,w1); down(r1,w0); down(r0)} at standard refresh interval (64 ms) to confirm baseline 100% bit yield.
2. Write solid data '1' (charge state = Q_s) across Bank 0 (1024 rows x 256 columns).
3. Disable auto-refresh controller and impose programmable retention pause delta t stepping logarithmically from 10 ms to 10.0 s in 20 logarithmic increments.
4. Trigger high-speed read strobe via ESP32 GPIO, asserting wordlines at V_PP = 2.7V; capture folded bitline differential development waveform on oscilloscope channels 1 & 2.
5. Log failing bit coordinates, bit-error rate (BER), and sense-amplifier latch time via ESP32 telemetry UART stream at 921600 baud.
6. Repeat sweep while stepping Dickson pump output voltage V_PP from 2.7V down to 1.8V in 100mV decrements to quantify write-loss retention degradation.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Fail if median retention time t_ret(50%) at 85°C drops below 250 ms when V_PP >= 2.6V. Fail if differential bitline voltage Delta V < 90 mV during sense amplifier strobe. Fail if March C- detects non-retention structural faults (stuck-at, transition, coupling) across Bank 0.

testcases.title: Subthreshold Pass-Gate Leakage & Storage Node Charge-Decay Metrology
testcases.instrumentation: Keithley 4200-SCS Parameter Analyzer with 4210-PA preamplifiers (1 fA current resolution), Cascade Microtech Summit 12000 probe station with triaxial shielding, ESP32 telemetry capture bridge.
testcases.pre_conditions: Unpackaged 180nm DRAM test coupon seated on guarded vacuum chuck; dry N2 purge active; SMU triaxial lines calibrated to sub-10fA baseline residual leakage; pass-transistor wordline gate tied to SMU1 (V_WL), bitline contact tied to SMU2 (V_BL), substrate p-well tied to -0.5V back-bias (V_BB).
testcases.procedure:
1. Set V_BL = 1.80V, pulse V_WL to 2.70V for 100 ns to fully charge isolated cell capacitor C_s (25 fF) to 1.80V, then immediately pull V_WL to 0.0V (pass transistor off).
2. Force V_BL to 0.0V to establish maximum drain-to-source stress (V_DS = 1.8V) across the unselected pass transistor.
3. Hold quiescent state for duration tau = 1.0 s, continuously logging off-state drain leakage current I_off on SMU2 at 1 kHz sampling rate.
4. Pulse V_WL to 2.70V and execute fast charge-integration Coulomb measurement Q_rem via pulsed IV on SMU2 to compute remaining storage node voltage V_cell = Q_rem / C_s.
5. Compute retention decay constant tau_decay = -t / ln(V_cell / V_DD) across temperatures 25°C, 50°C, and 85°C.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Pass if off-state leakage I_off <= 0.85 fA per cell at 25°C and <= 25.0 fA per cell at 85°C. Pass if retained storage node voltage V_cell >= 1.35V after 100 ms hold at 85°C (retention loss <= 25%). Fail if gate-induced drain leakage (GIDL) exceeds 2.0 fA under -0.5V V_BB bias.

ppe_required: Class 100 cleanroom-compatible nitrile gloves (minimum 5 mil thickness, double-gloved during chemical wipe down)
ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact splash-resistant safety glasses with side shields
ESD-safe anti-static cleanroom lab coat with conductive wrist strap grounding tethered to bench busbar
Thermal protective insulated gloves rated to -50°C to +150°C for Temptronic ThermoStream chuck handling
ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: Eye Contact: Immediately flush eyes with gently flowing isotonic eyewash solution for at least 15 minutes while holding eyelids open; seek immediate ophthalmological attention. Skin Contact: Remove contaminated clothing and rinse skin thoroughly with copious water for 15 minutes. Inhalation: Relocate victim to fresh uncontaminated air; if breathing is labored, administer medical oxygen by certified personnel; seek emergency medical care. High Voltage Electrical Shock: Disconnect electrical mains immediately via emergency stop button; verify pulse and respiration; initiate CPR if non-responsive and deploy AED.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Operation must be conducted within a certified laminar flow hood / clean bench providing minimum face velocity of 0.45 m/s (90 fpm) with ULPA filtration. Dedicated local solvent exhaust snorkel required for open IPA solvent wipe stations with minimum exhaust capture volume of 50 CFM. Thermal chuck nitrogen exhaust line must be vented directly into facility scrubber exhaust duct to prevent oxygen displacement.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Spent IPA solvent wipes and rinse liquids must be collected in closed, grounded, explosion-proof Type I red safety cans labeled 'Hazardous Flammable Solvent Waste - Isopropanol'. Store in NFPA-approved flammable cabinets. Dispose via certified licensed hazardous waste disposal contractor; strictly zero drain disposal. Solder flux residues and lead-free electronic waste must be segregated into dedicated solid toxic waste containment.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Freshly opened, passivated (Si3N4 / polyimide) wafer coupon or unpackaged open-cavity test package with micro-cleansed bond pads free of particulate contamination (>0.2 um) and organic residue.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Electrically characterized wafer coupon with intact wire bonds or probe marks exhibiting scrub depth < 1.5 um and no pass-through cratering to underlying inter-metal dielectric (IMD).
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Excessive atmospheric humidity exposure (>45% RH) induces moisture absorption in inter-metal dielectric oxides and native copper/aluminum pad oxidation, causing non-ohmic micro-probe contact resistance, parasitic surface leakage paths across bitline pads, and invalid subthreshold parametric retention measurements.

expected_result.summary: Full empirical parametric qualification and telemetry validation of the 180nm DRAM cell charge decay characteristics, confirming that V_PP overdrive >= 2.6V sustains storage node cell retention t_ret > 250ms at 85°C with folded bitline sense amplifier differential margins exceeding 100 mV.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Storage node capacitor retention time t_ret at 50% bit-failure boundary under 85°C chuck temperature with V_PP = 2.70V must meet or exceed minimum target.
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Automated ESP32-S3 variable-delay logarithmic pause retention sweep cross-verified with Keysight B2902B SMU pulse-sense telemetry.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: On-chip boosted wordline driver voltage (V_PP) output from the Dickson charge pump under 20 MHz active switching load must remain above minimum threshold.
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: High-impedance active micro-probing (10 MOhm, <1 pF probe) captured on Rigol MSO5000 oscilloscope during multi-row write bursts.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Folded bitline complementary differential signal development Delta V across BL and /BL prior to sense amplifier latch activation must exceed critical sensing threshold.
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Sub-picosecond differential oscilloscope probe measurement directly across test-structure sense amplifier bitline pairs during wordline assertion.

expected_result.signoff_criteria: Unambiguous researcher sign-off requires: 100% completion of March C- diagnostics with zero non-retention hard errors; automated logarithmic retention decay curves generated across a minimum of 3 coupon dies over temperatures 25°C, 50°C, and 85°C confirming t_ret(85°C) >= 250 ms; V_PP charge pump stability verified at >= 2.60V under maximum burst load; and probe mark scrub damage verified < 1.5 um depth via optical/SEM profilometry.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Title:** Pre-Test Cell Array Conditioning & $V_{PP}$ / $V_{DD}$ Overdrive Bias Calibration  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > ESP32 Closed-Loop Controller > Parametric Retention Protocol > Pre-Test Conditioning & Bias Calibration  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

## 1. Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Start Calibration &   │
│     Array Pre-Test     │
│      Conditioning      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Step 1: Quiescent    │
│   Supply & Precharge   │
│         Check          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Step 2: VPP Charge   │
│    Pump & Overdrive    │
│    Sweep 2.5V-2.8V     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Step 3: Cell      │
│    Full-Rail Write     │
│      Conditioning      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Step 4: Differential  │
│  Sense Margin Delta V  │
│          Eval          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Pass / Fail       │
│  Acceptance Criteria   │
│          Gate          │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

### Step 1: Supply Stabilization & Bitline Equalization Verification
1. Apply core supply voltage $V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V}$ to the peripheral logic, sense amplifiers, and precharge circuitry.
2. Assert the bitline equalization network and verify that both complementary folded bitlines ($BL$ and $\overline{BL}$) settle to:
   $$V_{BL\_precharge} = \frac{V_{DD}}{2} = 0.90\text{ V}$$
3. Verify that the NMOS access transistor threshold voltage $V_{thn}$ is within the baseline device specification ($+0.55\text{ V} \pm 50\text{ mV}$) under linear measurement conditions ($V_{DS} = 50\text{ mV}$).

### Step 2: Dickson Charge Pump & $V_{PP}$ Overdrive Calibration
1. Enable the 4-stage Dickson charge pump oscillator using two-phase non-overlapping clocks ($\Phi_1, \Phi_2$) at an operating frequency of $20\text{ MHz}$ to $50\text{ MHz}$ driving flying capacitors ($C_{pump} = 20\text{ pF}$ to $50\text{ pF}$).
2. Trim the feedback voltage divider and bandgap comparator reference to lock the regulated wordline boost potential into the overdrive target range:
   $$V_{PP} = V_{DD} + V_{th} + \Delta V_{overdrive} \ge 2.5\text{ V to } 2.8\text{ V}$$
3. Ensure $V_{PP} \ge 2.5\text{ V}$ to eliminate the $V_{th}$ body/channel loss ($1.8\text{ V} - 0.6\text{ V} = 1.2\text{ V}$ unboosted condition), guaranteeing that full $V_{DD}$ rail transfers into the storage cell capacitor ($C_s$).

### Step 3: Array Conditioning & Solid Write Pattern
1. Execute an initial full-array conditioning sequence across the 180nm 1T1C storage matrix.
2. Drive wordlines at the calibrated $V_{PP}$ overdrive level ($2.5\text{ V}$–$2.8\text{ V}$) and write solid Data '1' ($V_{cell} = 1.8\text{ V}$) across all targeted addresses.
3. Write solid Data '0' ($V_{cell} = 0.0\text{ V}$) to verify bidirectional channel conductivity and eliminate trapped dielectric charges or non-deterministic initial floating-node potentials.

### Step 4: Differential Sense Signal Margin ($\Delta V$) Assessment
1. Precharge bitlines to $V_{DD}/2 = 0.9\text{ V}$.
2. Assert wordline to $V_{PP}$ to share cell charge $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{BL})$ onto the bitline with typical cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and folded bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.
3. Measure the developed differential read voltage before sense amplifier latching:
   $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$
4. Confirm $\Delta V$ falls within the expected $100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$ window before latching $SAN / SAP$.

---

## 3. Parametric Reference Distribution

```text
                       ┌───────────────────────────────┐
                       │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░                │
Delta V Signal (mV/100)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░                │
                       │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                        │
      V_thn Nominal (V)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                        │
        V_PP Target (V)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                       │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
        V_DD Supply (V)┤█████████████████████          │
                       │█████████████████████          │
                       └┬───────┬──────┬───────┬──────┬┘
                      0.00    0.66   1.32    1.99  2.65 
```

---

## 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Exact Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Charge Pump Boost Voltage ($V_{PP}$)** | $2.65$ | $2.50\text{ to } 2.80$ | $\text{V}$ |
| **Bitline Precharge Voltage ($V_{BL}$)** | $0.90$ | $\pm 0.05$ | $\text{V}$ |
| **Discrete NMOS Access $V_{thn}$** | $0.55$ | $\pm 0.05$ ($0.50\text{ to } 0.60$) | $\text{V}$ |
| **Differential Signal Margin ($\Delta V$)** | $125$ | $100\text{ to } 150$ | $\text{mV}$ |

---

## 5. Source Citations
- **High-Voltage Wordline Charge Pump (VPP) Dickson Oscillator Architecture**: Dickson 4-stage pump clocking ($20\text{ MHz}$ to $50\text{ MHz}$, $C_{pump} = 20\text{ pF}$ to $50\text{ pF}$), NMOS threshold loss mitigation, and $V_{PP} = V_{DD} + V_{th} + \Delta V_{overdrive} \ge 2.5\text{ V to } 2.8\text{ V}$.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: Equalization to $V_{DD}/2 = 0.9\text{ V}$, signal development equation, $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, and read differential $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$.
- **Stage 3 Reality Gate: Discrete Long-Channel MOSFET & CMOS Inverter Verification**: Physical baseline transistor parameters ($V_{thn} = +0.55\text{ V} \pm 50\text{ mV}$ at $V_{DS} = 50\text{ mV}$, $V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Requires verified wordline driver timing (t_r <= 1.8 ns) and precharge VBLP (0.90V) prior to sense activation. Cascading delay budget must reserve >= 150 mV read margin across folded bitlines.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: Storage capacitor Cs must maintain >= 28 fF to resist alpha-particle soft errors. Subthreshold leakage through access NMOS channel (L=180nm, W=220nm) must remain < 1.0 fA/cell at 85°C.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: High-k dielectric precursor (ALD/CVD) is unavailable for DIY fabrication in VN. Strictly enforce 180nm Crown/Stacked SiO2-Si3N4-SiO2 (ONO) node compatible with legacy wet/dry equipment.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 40-60 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Sense amplifier offset mismatch > 15 mV will flip read bitline polarity).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Sense amplifier threshold voltage mismatch (Delta Vth > 15 mV) causing read inversion.
1. Subthreshold access transistor leakage discharging Cs below sense threshold within refresh interval (< 64 ms).
1. Wordline parasitic resistance-capacitance (RC) delay exceeding access strobe window.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-FIRMWARE-3-3-1-01` | **Storage Cell Charge Retention & Leakage Test** | Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A / Agilent 4156C) & Cryogenic Probe Station | 1. Write logic '1' (charge to 1.80V) into target 1T1C storage capacitor node. 2. Deassert wordline driver to isolate storage node for t_hold = 64 ms (DRAM standard refresh period). 3. Pulse wordline to VPP = 2.50V and sample bitline charge sharing differential voltage Delta V. | `Differential signal Delta V >= 112.2 mV (Pass); subthreshold leakage I_leak <= 1.0 fA/cell (Pass); Delta V < 80 mV (Fail).` |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-FIRMWARE-3-3-1-02` | **Sense Amplifier Strobe Timing & Differential Margin Test** | 200 MHz Active Differential Probe & Mixed-Signal Oscilloscope | 1. Inject controlled 50 mV differential offset between BL and BL_B. 2. Trigger SAN pulldown to GND and SAP pullup to 1.80V at strobe edge. 3. Measure sensing delay t_sense (time from strobe to 90% rail separation) and power-rail ripple. | `Sense resolution time t_sense <= 4.2 ns; full rail voltage V_rail >= 1.75V; zero state oscillation (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Standard cleanroom lab coat and ESD wrist strap, Safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Standard industrial first aid.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Ambient cleanroom ventilation.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Standard recycling of scrap silicon.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Silicon (Si Substrate)** | `7440-21-3` | Electronic Grade P-type <100> prime wafer | `Single crystal` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `N/A` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `N/A`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Extracted parasitic netlist / fabricated test die on vacuum chuck.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Strobed and characterized bitline/cell nodes with logged margin data.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Non-physical queue time; electrical drift under continuous DC bias stress.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of Pre-Test Cell Array Conditioning & V_PP/V_DD Overdrive Bias Calibration: Bitcell storage charge retention, sense amplifier signal margin, and read/write access timing confirmed within 180nm CMOS DRAM specifications.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `SPICE_transient_simulation_deck.sp`
- [ ] `Keysight_B1500A_retention_margin_plot.csv`
- [ ] `Monte_Carlo_sense_amp_offset_distribution.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Storage cell capacitance (Cs)** | `>= 28.0 fF` | +/- 2.0 fF | High-frequency C-V meter (1 MHz) on 100x100 test array |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Subthreshold access transistor leakage current (Ioff)** | `<= 1.0 fA/cell` | Max ceiling at 85°C junction temperature | Keysight B1500A sub-fA High-Resolution SMU |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Folded bitline differential sense voltage margin (Delta VBL)** | `>= 180 mV` | Min threshold >= 150 mV across all PVT corners | Strobe sense amplifier latch comparator with calibrated offset voltage |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% of bitcell test structures pass 64ms retention test without refresh decay; zero soft-error read inversions across 10,000 consecutive read cycles at nominal VDD (1.80V).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Variable-Delay Charge-Decay Marching Stress & Bitline Signal Development Acquisition

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-DRAM180-042`  
**Hierarchy:** Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > ESP32 Closed-Loop Motor Controller > Automated Parametric Retention & March C- Diagnostic Test Firmware > Automated Variable-Delay Parametric Retention Metrology & Telemetry Logger > Parametric Charge-Decay Metrology & Cell Retention Characterization Protocol > Variable-Delay Charge-Decay Marching Stress & Bitline Signal Development Acquisition  
**Target Node / Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / µm planar/stacked COB)  
**Action Type:** Make / Metrology Characterization  

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This SOP defines the step-by-step metrology procedure to quantify charge-decay kinetics in 1T1C storage nodes ($C_s \approx 25\text{--}28\text{ fF}$) through automated variable-delay stress intervals and sense amplifier signal development acquisition ($\Delta V = 100\text{--}150\text{ mV}$) across an 8F²/6F² folded bitline array fabricated on the 180nm process.

---

### 2. Physical & Architectural Parameters

* **Bitline Precharge Voltage ($V_{BL}$ / Equalization):** $\frac{V_{DD}}{2} = 0.90\text{ V}$ ($V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V}$).
* **Wordline Overdrive ($V_{PP}$):** $2.5\text{ V}$ to $2.8\text{ V}$ (supplied by 4-stage Dickson pump, regulated against $V_{th} \approx 0.5\text{--}0.7\text{ V}$ loss to guarantee full $V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V}$ write into cell).
* **Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$):** $25\text{ fF}$ nominal (minimum target $28\text{ fF}$ via stacked crown capacitor / high-$\kappa$ ONO / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$/$\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ dielectric).
* **Bitline Capacitance ($C_{BL}$):** $250\text{ fF}$.
* **Access Transistor Dimensions:** $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
* **Nominal Differential Signal ($\Delta V$):**
  $$\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right) \approx 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$$
* **Maximum Junction & Subthreshold Leakage Budget:** $\le 1.0\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

```text
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                              EXECUTION FLOW                                     |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [Step 1: Bias & Pump Init]  V_DD = 1.8V, Dickson pump -> V_PP (2.5V - 2.8V)     |
|         |                                                                       |
| [Step 2: Array Precharge]   Bitlines equalized to V_DD / 2 (0.9V)               |
|         |                                                                       |
| [Step 3: Full-Rail Write]   March C- pattern written with V_PP boost            |
|         |                                                                       |
| [Step 4: Variable Delay]    Pause refresh across t_pause = [10 ms ... 10 s]     |
|         |                                                                       |
| [Step 5: Signal Sensing]    Assert WL -> Charge dump -> Acquire Delta V (mV)    |
|         |                                                                       |
| [Step 6: Telemetry Log]     Record retention pass/fail vs pause interval        |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Supply Biasing and Dickson Pump Initialization
1. Connect low-noise power supplies: set core array rail $V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V}$.
2. Activate the on-chip 4-stage Dickson charge pump clocking at $20\text{ MHz}$ to $50\text{ MHz}$.
3. Verify via internal pad or telemetry feedback that boosted wordline rail stabilizes at $V_{PP} \ge 2.5\text{ V}$ (target: $2.5\text{ V}\text{--}2.8\text{ V}$) to overcome NMOS access transistor threshold loss ($V_{th} = 0.5\text{--}0.7\text{ V}$).

#### Step 2: Bitline Equalization
1. Assert bitline equalization transistor control line `EQ` prior to access.
2. Ensure complementary lines $\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$ are equalized and held at:
   $$V_{EQ} = \frac{V_{DD}}{2} = 0.90\text{ V}$$

#### Step 3: March C- Stress Pattern Initialization
1. Execute a deterministic March C- write sequence via the automated firmware test engine:
   * Write background data pattern ($D = 1$, corresponding to full storage node charge $V_{cell} = 1.8\text{ V}$).
2. Ensure wordline drivers switch using $V_{PP}$ overdrive so that storage node $C_s$ charges to the full $1.8\text{ V}$ rail without experiencing threshold degradation ($V_{DD} - V_{th}$).

#### Step 4: Variable-Delay Charge-Decay Hold (Retention Pause)
1. Inhibit auto-refresh commands across the selected test subarray.
2. Sweep variable retention idle pause durations ($t_{delay}$) geometrically from $10\text{ ms}$, $50\text{ ms}$, $100\text{ ms}$, $500\text{ ms}$, $1\text{ s}$, up to $10\text{ s}$ under controlled thermal conditions ($25^\circ\text{C}$ and $85^\circ\text{C}$).
3. Maintain unselected wordlines at $0\text{ V}$ to prevent gate-induced drain leakage (GIDL) or subthreshold conduction.

#### Step 5: Wordline Activation & Differential Bitline Signal Acquisition
1. De-assert equalization line `EQ` on the folded bitline pair ($\text{BL}$ / $\overline{\text{BL}}$).
2. Fire wordline (`WL`) using $V_{PP}$ pulse to turn on the $W/L = 220\text{ nm} / 180\text{ nm}$ access device.
3. Allow cell charge $Q_s = C_s \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$ to dump onto $\text{BL}$.
4. Capture bitline differential voltage development $\Delta V = |V_{BL} - V_{\overline{BL}}|$ across the sense amplifier inputs prior to latch strobe (`SAN` pull-down / `SAP` pull-up).

#### Step 6: Latching & Telemetry Ingestion
1. Fire sense amplifier latch strobe to pull `SAN` to $V_{SS}$ and `SAP` to $V_{DD}$, amplifying $\Delta V$ to CMOS logic levels.
2. Read out cell bit state and record bit-error telemetry via the automated metrology logger.
3. Repeat for complementary background pattern ($D = 0$, $V_{cell} = 0\text{ V}$).

---

### 4. Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Minimum Target | Nominal Target | Maximum Target | Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Wordline Boost Voltage ($V_{PP}$)** | $2.5$ | $2.65$ | $2.8$ | $\text{V}$ | Oscilloscope / ADC pad monitor |
| **Developed Bitline Differential ($\Delta V$)** | $100$ | $125$ | $150$ | $\text{mV}$ | Analog probe / sense margin test |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25$ | $28$ | — | $\text{fF}$ | Micro-C-V parameter extraction |
| **Storage Node Off-State Leakage Current ($I_{leak}$ @ 85°C)** | — | $0.4$ | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Charge-decay retention modeling |

---

### 5. Context Literature Citations
1. **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout:**
   * Architecture of folded bitline CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch; precharge equalization to $\frac{V_{DD}}{2}$; charge dumping formula $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right)\left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$; typical parameters $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, yielding $\Delta V \approx 100\text{--}150\text{ mV}$.
2. **High-Voltage Wordline Charge Pump (VPP) Dickson Oscillator Architecture:**
   * Access NMOS threshold $V_{th} \approx 0.5\text{--}0.7\text{ V}$; threshold loss mitigation via $V_{PP} = V_{DD} + V_{th} + \Delta V_{overdrive} \ge 2.5\text{ V to } 2.8\text{ V}$; 4-stage Dickson pump topology with flying capacitors ($20\text{--}50\text{ pF}$) clocked at $20\text{--}50\text{ MHz}$.
3. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
   * Access transistor geometry $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$; stacked crown MIM/polysilicon capacitor over bitline (COB); cell capacitance requirement $\ge 28\text{ fF}$; off-state leakage threshold $\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Requires verified wordline driver timing (t_r <= 1.8 ns) and precharge VBLP (0.90V) prior to sense activation. Cascading delay budget must reserve >= 150 mV read margin across folded bitlines.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: Storage capacitor Cs must maintain >= 28 fF to resist alpha-particle soft errors. Subthreshold leakage through access NMOS channel (L=180nm, W=220nm) must remain < 1.0 fA/cell at 85°C.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: High-k dielectric precursor (ALD/CVD) is unavailable for DIY fabrication in VN. Strictly enforce 180nm Crown/Stacked SiO2-Si3N4-SiO2 (ONO) node compatible with legacy wet/dry equipment.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 40-60 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Sense amplifier offset mismatch > 15 mV will flip read bitline polarity).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Sense amplifier threshold voltage mismatch (Delta Vth > 15 mV) causing read inversion.
1. Subthreshold access transistor leakage discharging Cs below sense threshold within refresh interval (< 64 ms).
1. Wordline parasitic resistance-capacitance (RC) delay exceeding access strobe window.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-FIRMWARE-3-3-2-01` | **Storage Cell Charge Retention & Leakage Test** | Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A / Agilent 4156C) & Cryogenic Probe Station | 1. Write logic '1' (charge to 1.80V) into target 1T1C storage capacitor node. 2. Deassert wordline driver to isolate storage node for t_hold = 64 ms (DRAM standard refresh period). 3. Pulse wordline to VPP = 2.50V and sample bitline charge sharing differential voltage Delta V. | `Differential signal Delta V >= 112.2 mV (Pass); subthreshold leakage I_leak <= 1.0 fA/cell (Pass); Delta V < 80 mV (Fail).` |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-FIRMWARE-3-3-2-02` | **Sense Amplifier Strobe Timing & Differential Margin Test** | 200 MHz Active Differential Probe & Mixed-Signal Oscilloscope | 1. Inject controlled 50 mV differential offset between BL and BL_B. 2. Trigger SAN pulldown to GND and SAP pullup to 1.80V at strobe edge. 3. Measure sensing delay t_sense (time from strobe to 90% rail separation) and power-rail ripple. | `Sense resolution time t_sense <= 4.2 ns; full rail voltage V_rail >= 1.75V; zero state oscillation (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Standard cleanroom lab coat and ESD wrist strap, Safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Standard industrial first aid.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Ambient cleanroom ventilation.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Standard recycling of scrap silicon.

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `N/A` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `N/A`

- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Strobed and characterized bitline/cell nodes with logged margin data.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Non-physical queue time; electrical drift under continuous DC bias stress.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of Variable-Delay Charge-Decay Marching Stress & Bitline Signal Development Acquisition: Bitcell storage charge retention, sense amplifier signal margin, and read/write access timing confirmed within 180nm CMOS DRAM specifications.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
