### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ESD Grounding Wrist Strap with 1 Megohm resistor, ANSI Z87.1 certified clear safety glasses with side shields, Electrostatic dissipative (ESD) lab coat, Class 100 nitrile gloves (powder-free)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye Contact: Flush eyes with copious amounts of water at emergency eyewash station for at least 15 minutes while holding eyelids open. Skin Contact: Wash skin with mild soap and water; remove contaminated clothing. Inhalation: Move personnel to fresh air immediately. Ingestion: Do not induce vomiting without medical guidance; seek immediate medical attention.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard electronics laboratory environment with continuous general exhaust ventilation providing minimum 8 to 10 air changes per hour (ACH). Local chemical bench exhaust / fume hood rated at minimum 100 FPM face velocity for board solvent cleaning.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent isopropyl alcohol in dedicated, labeled, flame-proof, grounded hazardous solvent waste containers. Do not discharge into municipal drain systems. Dispose of via licensed chemical waste management contractor in compliance with local environmental regulations.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor / Electronic Grade (VLSI) | `99.9%` |
| **Deionized Water** | `7732-18-5` | ASTM Type I (18.2 MOhm-cm) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Solvent-cleaned, dry, dust-free PCB test coupons and unpackaged 180nm silicon dies stored in vacuum-sealed moisture-barrier bags (MBB) with active desiccant and humidity indicator cards (HIC < 10%).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Cleaned, nitrogen-purged test fixture interface; zero ionic contamination or flux residues; bond pads and micro-probing pads free of oxidative film or mechanical pitting.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding allowable atmospheric exposure induces surface oxidation and moisture condensation on high-impedance probing nodes, increasing contact resistance by > 2.5 Ohms and introducing parasitic capacitive loading (> 3 pF) that distorts dynamic picosecond rise/fall edge measurements and invalidates extracted SDC I/O slew constraints.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Complete cycle-accurate dynamic timing verification and constraint extraction package for the 180nm DRAM controller core, including correlated SDC files for OpenROAD physical synthesis, SystemVerilog timing assertion regression suite, and multi-corner STA signoff reports.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram_controller_extracted_constraints.sdc`
- [ ] `dynamic_timing_verification_report.pdf`
- [ ] `pvt_corner_slack_matrix.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Worst Negative Slack (WNS) for FPGA-to-DRAM Controller Core Clock Domain at 100 MHz under Worst-Case Slow-Slow Corner** | `0.45 ns` | ±0.10 ns | OpenROAD OpenSTA post-route static timing report against extracted SDC |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Sense Amplifier Dynamic Charge Restoration Margin (Wordline pulse width before Precharge Equalization initiation)** | `42.50 ns` | ±1.50 ns | Mixed-signal logic analyzer timing capture and SVA assertion formal check |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Maximum Allowable Inter-Lane Data-to-Strobe (DQ-to-DQS) Clock Skew at PHY Interface** | `180 ps` | ±25 ps | 4 GHz real-time digital oscilloscope edge-delay statistical histogram |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Zero SVA dynamic assertion violations across 1,000,000 continuous simulated DRAM operational cycles, OpenSTA signoff confirming WNS >= 0.000 ns and TNS == 0.000 ns across all three PVT corners (SS/TT/FF), and formal verification of dram_controller_extracted_constraints.sdc clean execution in OpenROAD physical synthesis.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## PVT Corner Static Timing Analysis & Signoff Compliance Audit

- **Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180NM-STA-001`
- **Revision:** 1.0
- **Scope:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip Architecture & Integration
- **Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm Node

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Flow Diagram

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Setup PVT Corners   │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Extract RC and Gate  │
│        Delays         │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│     Static Timing     │
│     Analysis STA      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Signoff Compliance   │
│         Audit         │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **PVT Corner Characterization Grid Configuration:**
   - Define Process Corners: Slow-Slow (SS), Typical-Typical (TT), Fast-Fast (FF).
   - Configure Voltage Supply: Nominal logic core $V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V}$. Configure the high-voltage boosted wordline domain $V_{PP}$ bounded between $2.5\text{ V}$ and $2.8\text{ V}$ (Dickson oscillator frequency: $20\text{ MHz}$ to $50\text{ MHz}$; flying capacitance $C_{pump} = 20\text{ pF}$ to $50\text{ pF}$).
   - Set Thermal Bounds: Low operating junction $-40^\circ\text{C}$, nominal $25^\circ\text{C}$, and worst-case temperature signoff at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

2. **Parasitic RC & Parasitic Ratio Extraction:**
   - Extract folded bitline parasitic capacitance $C_b$ across array blocks of $256$ to $512$ cells per bitline (expected range: $150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$).
   - Verify 1T1C stacked capacitor storage node capacitance $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ (nominal $28\text{ fF}$ with high-$\kappa$ dielectric $\kappa > 15$).
   - Audit the array capacitance ratio: maintain $C_b / C_s$ strictly between $5:1$ and $9:1$. Flag paths where $C_b / C_s \ge 10:1$ due to read signal margin collapse.

3. **Wordline Overdrive & Path Delay Audit:**
   - Compute pass-transistor gate drive margin: verify $V_{PP} = V_{DD} + V_{th} + \Delta V_{overdrive} \ge 2.5\text{ V}$ (with $V_{th} \sim 0.5\text{ V} - 0.7\text{ V}$, $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Ensure the wordline high level eliminates the $V_{DD} - V_{th} = 1.2\text{ V}$ write-level threshold loss to safeguard retention timing.

4. **JEDEC Dynamic Timing Verification ($t_{RP}$, $t_{RCD}$, $t_{RFC}$):**
   - Run setup/hold STA on the DDR PHY and JEDEC state machine against array charge/discharge paths.
   - Verify row-precharge time ($t_{RP}$) against bitline precharge equalization networks, row-to-column delay ($t_{RCD}$) against sense amplifier latching times, and refresh cycle time ($t_{RFC}$) against array cell retention bounds at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
               PVT Signoff Physical Parameters & Limits 
              ┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
              │█                                       │
V_PP Boost Min┤█                                       │
              │▓▓                                      │
 C_b/C_s Ratio┤▓▓                                      │
   C_b Typ Max┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
              │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
       C_s Min┤░░░░░                                   │
              │░░░░░                                   │
              └┬─────────┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬┘
              0.0      62.5      125.0    187.5   250.0 
```

| Metric / Parameter | Lower Limit | Nominal Target | Upper Limit | Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25.0$ | $28.0$ | $30.0$ | $\text{fF}$ | LPE / Post-layout 3D field solver |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_b$)** | $150.0$ | $200.0$ | $250.0$ | $\text{fF}$ | Extracted 256/512 cell array netlist |
| **Bitline-to-Cell Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | $5.0 : 1$ | $7.0 : 1$ | $9.0 : 1$ | Dimensionless | Ratio validation ($\le 10:1$ critical limit) |
| **Boosted Supply Voltage ($V_{PP}$)** | $2.5$ | $2.7$ | $2.8$ | $\text{V}$ | Regulated Dickson charge pump transient audit |
| **Cell Leakage Current (@ $85^\circ\text{C}$)** | — | — | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | SPICE subthreshold + junction leakage signoff |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

1. **High-Voltage Wordline Charge Pump ($V_{PP}$) Dickson Oscillator Architecture**:
   - $V_{th} = 0.5\text{ V} - 0.7\text{ V}$, nominal logic $V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V}$.
   - $V_{PP} = V_{DD} + V_{th} + \Delta V_{overdrive} \ge 2.5\text{ V}$ to $2.8\text{ V}$.
   - Dickson charge pump: 4-stage, $C_{pump} = 20\text{ pF}$ to $50\text{ pF}$, two-phase clocks at $20\text{ MHz}$ to $50\text{ MHz}$.
2. **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**:
   - Cell footprint: $8F^2$ folded bitline ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$).
   - $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ (nominally $28\text{ fF}$).
   - $C_b = 150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$ (256/512 cells per bitline).
   - $C_b / C_s$ ratio between $5:1$ and $9:1$ (degrades severely if $> 10:1$).
3. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - Access transistor dimensions: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - High-$\kappa$ dielectric: $\kappa > 15$.
   - Leakage target: sub-threshold and junction leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Static Timing Analysis (STA) signoff for the FPGA memory controller interfacing to the 180nm custom DRAM PHY must strictly account for clock skew, board trace propagation delay mismatch (<15 ps between DQ and DQS), and level-shifter jitter between the 3.3V FPGA I/O and the 1.8V DRAM core interface. Relying solely on typical PVT corners without modeling cross-domain clock domain crossing (CDC) between the ESP32 SPI configuration bridge and FPGA PHY will introduce metastabilities during burst refresh cycles.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm node with a 360nm bitline pitch, sense amplifier latching times (t_RCD) and precharge times (t_RP) are heavily dependent on bitline parasitic capacitance (~250-350 fF) and transistor subthreshold leakage at the slow-slow (SS, 1.62V, 125°C) corner. The STA constraints must enforce multicycle paths on sense amplifier restore margins (driving SAP to VDD and SAN to GND) rather than assuming single-cycle logic evaluation; failure to model temperature inversion on threshold voltage will result in false positive timing signoff.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: FPGA silicon stepping variations (e.g., speed grade -1 vs -2 on Spartan-6/7 or Gowin devices) combined with foundry fab process variation (180nm shuttle lot wafer-to-wafer gate oxide thickness ±8%) present severe yield hazards. STA models must ingest worst-case standard cell and I/O cell Liberty (.lib) files corresponding directly to the actual procured silicon lot and PCB dielectric (FR4 vs Isola 370HR) tolerance to prevent dead-on-arrival controller boards.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Signoff compliance audit must be gated by automated script parsing of OpenSTA / Vivado / Quartus timing reports against the JEDEC SDR/DDR state machine specifications before committing to mask tape-out or fabrication runs. The project timeline cannot absorb an iteration where dynamic functional testing uncovers static setup/hold violations that should have been caught in Milestone Gen 2 metrology gate reviews.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Hold time violation on bidirectional DQ data bus at the Fast-Fast corner (FF, 1.98V, -40°C) causing corrupted data write during tWR window.
1. Setup violation on Row Address Strobe (RAS_N) at the Slow-Slow corner (SS, 1.62V, 125°C) resulting in unselected wordlines and silent refresh failure (tRFC breach).
1. Metastable state machine lockout during JEDEC precharge-to-activate transition due to asynchronous reset recovery/removal timing violations.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-FPGA-1-3-3-01` | **Automated Multi-Corner Static Timing Signoff & Slack Margin Audit** | OpenSTA / Synopsys PrimeTime static timing analysis engine executed via scripted TCL harness, integrated with digital storage oscilloscope (Keysight Infiniium 4 GHz, 20 GSa/s) and differential active probes (Keysight N2750A) for physical correlation. | 1. Ingest post-route Verilog netlist and SPEF parasitics into the STA engine. 2. Apply JEDEC timing SDC constraints: tRCD >= 20 ns, tRP >= 20 ns, tRAS >= 40 ns, and I/O setup/hold constraints (tIS = 1.5 ns, tIH = 0.8 ns). 3. Execute multi-corner STA report across all three PVT corners with on-chip variation (OCV) derating factor of 5%. 4. Extract Worst Negative Slack (WNS) and Total Negative Slack (TNS) for both setup and hold paths. 5. Correlate critical path delay against physical probe measurement on the hardware prototype FPGA test points. | `Setup WNS >= +0.50 ns across all PVT corners; Hold WNS >= +0.25 ns across all PVT corners; Total Negative Slack (TNS) == 0.00 ns; Clock domain crossing paths must report 0 unconstrained endpoints.` |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-FPGA-1-3-3-02` | **JEDEC Cycle-Accurate Protocol Timing & Refresh State Machine Margin Audit** | Logic Analyzer (Saleae Logic Pro 16 / Tektronix TLA7012) connected to Mictor interface connector, combined with cycle-accurate Verilog testbench co-simulation log analyzer. | 1. Mount controller DUT in thermal chamber and set temperature to 85°C with VDD = 1.62V (SS corner emulation). 2. Initiate continuous write/read burst transactions interspaced with auto-refresh (REF) commands under maximum JEDEC burst rate. 3. Capture 10,000 continuous command cycles on the logic analyzer. 4. Run automated Python protocol checker script on the exported trace data to measure tRP (Precharge to Active), tRCD (Active to Read/Write), and tRFC (Refresh Command Period). 5. Decrease controller refresh interval down to JEDEC margin limits (tRFC = 66 ns) and verify state machine command spacing. | `Zero JEDEC protocol violations detected over 10,000 sampled cycles; measured tRP >= 20.00 ns ± 0.00 ns; measured tRCD >= 20.00 ns ± 0.00 ns; measured tRFC >= 66.00 ns ± 0.00 ns; no data parity or CRC errors observed.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: EN 166 compliant UV/impact-resistant safety glasses, ESD-safe dissipative nitrile gloves (0.1 mm thickness), ESD grounding wrist strap with 1 MOhm current-limiting resistor, Static-dissipative lab coat (surface resistivity < 10^9 ohms/sq)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact with IPA: Rinse immediately with copious physiological saline or eyewash water for at least 15 minutes. Inhalation of solvent vapors: Move victim to fresh air immediately; administer oxygen if breathing becomes labored. In case of cryogenic N2 frostbite from purge vent: Warm affected skin gradually with lukewarm water (38-42°C); do not rub affected tissue.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operation conducted inside an ISO Class 7 cleanroom environment with localized benchtop HEPA/chemical canopy exhaust hood rated at minimum 100 FPM face velocity; thermal chamber exhaust ducted outside facility to prevent N2 displacement asphyxiation.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA lint-free wipes and solvent residues collected in dedicated sealed, flame-resistant flammable waste cans; disposed of via licensed hazardous solvent reclamation stream per EPA/local environmental guidelines.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) Electronic Cleaner** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Grade VLSI | `99.8%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (N2) Gas for Chamber Purge** | `7727-37-9` | High Purity Grade 5.0 | `99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `48 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Dry post-place-and-route synthesized FPGA netlist / packaged 180nm test vehicle PCB with lead-free immersion gold (ENIG) contact pads free of particulate contamination (>0.5 um count = 0) and oxidation.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Electrically validated, ESD-sealed anti-static vacuum barrier bag purged with dry nitrogen and moisture barrier desiccant pouch (relative humidity < 10%).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture absorption by exposed PCB substrates and IC packages causing popcorn cracking during thermal cycling stress tests, coupled with atmospheric copper/tin intermetallic corrosion that alters high-frequency trace impedance (>5 Ohms drift) and invalidates STA physical correlation.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Complete Static Timing Analysis (STA) and physical JEDEC compliance closure for the FPGA high-speed memory controller core driving the 180nm DRAM PHY, demonstrating zero setup and hold timing violations across Slow-Slow (1.62V, 125°C), Typical-Typical (1.80V, 25°C), and Fast-Fast (1.98V, -40°C) PVT corners with empirical physical scope verification.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `STA_MultiCorner_Signoff_Summary_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `JEDEC_Protocol_Cycle_Timing_Audit.csv`
- [ ] `Oscilloscope_DQ_DQS_EyeDiagram_Correlated.tiff`

| `ASSERT-02` | **Worst Negative Slack (WNS) for hold paths at Fast-Fast corner (1.98V, -40°C)** | `>= +0.25 ns` | +0.00 ns / +2.00 ns | Automated OpenSTA multi-corner report parser script |
| `ASSERT-03` | **JEDEC tRP and tRCD state machine command period margin at 100 MHz clock** | `20.00 ns` | ±0.15 ns | High-bandwidth logic analyzer capture and automated cycle-timing validation script |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Zero setup, hold, recovery, or removal timing violations (TNS = 0.00 ns) across all PVT corners, 100% clock domain crossing paths formally verified with 0 metastabilities, and unanimous signoff approval recorded by systems engineering, circuit design, and QA council representatives.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Verilog DDR PHY IP Block Integration & Differential I/O Pin Placement

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > ESP32 Closed-Loop Motor Controller [Electronics & Firmware] > FPGA High-Speed DRAM Memory Controller Core (Verilog DDR PHY & JEDEC State Machine) [Digital Logic & FPGA] > Verilog DDR PHY IP Block Integration & Differential I/O Pin Placement [Circuit Design]
**Target Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type**: Make

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: Wirebond Shear >= 18 gf, ATE Functional Yield >= 90%, Coplanarity <= 0.08 mm.
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using Dage 4000 Bond Tester & Advantest Wafer Prober / CMM.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The integration of a commercial or open-source Verilog DDR PHY IP macro into the 180nm physical floorplan requires stringent clock domain crossing (CDC) isolation between the FPGA high-speed controller logic and the analog differential SSTL/LVDS transceiver pads. Floorplanning differential pin pairs (CK/CK#, DQS/DQS#) requires strict adjacency and identical routing guides in OpenROAD to prevent phase mismatch, duty cycle distortion (DCD > 2%), and common-mode noise conversion across the PDN.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm (Gen 2), achieving JEDEC-compliant DDR/DDR2 signaling rates requires rigorous parasitic extraction (OpenRCX) of pad bonding parasitics, ESD clamp capacitance (target < 1.2 pF), and differential trace impedance matching (50 ohm single-ended, 100 ohm differential). Differential pin placement must maintain symmetric pin escape pitches with interleaved VDDQ/VSSQ power-ground guard rings to suppress crosstalk and ground bounce during simultaneous switching noise (SSN) events.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Procuring pre-characterized silicon-proven 180nm Verilog DDR PHY Hard/Soft IP macros demands verified foundry PDK compatibility (GDSII, LEF, LIB, and timing models). Sourcing external COTS FPGA interface companion boards or test sockets must guarantee impedance-controlled high-speed differential signal integrity up to 400 MT/s without requiring exotic lead times or non-standard substrate stackups.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Acquisition and integration schedule milestones risk slippage if the third-party PHY IP macro exhibits Black-box LVS/DRC clearance issues in OpenROAD or KLayout. The verification gate requires complete signoff of timing libraries across PVT corners (0.9V-1.98V, -40°C to 125°C) before freeze, preventing costly tape-out re-spins on multi-project wafer (MPW) runs.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Differential clock/strobe skew exceeding 25 ps due to asymmetric wirelength routing or unbalanced CTS buffer insertion in OpenROAD.
1. Severe simultaneous switching output (SSO) ground bounce exceeding 150 mV on VSSQ due to insufficient decoupled differential I/O pad cell placement.
1. Impedance mismatch causing reflected wave ring-back below V_IH(ac) threshold during read/write DQS burst sequences.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-FPGA-2-01` | **DDR PHY Differential Pin Skew and Eye-Diagram Verification** | Keysight Infiniium 40 GHz High-Bandwidth Digital Oscilloscope, differential active probes (Keysight InfiniiMax III 13 GHz), Keysight 81160A Pulse Function Arbitrary Noise Generator, OpenROAD timing analyzer (OpenSTA). | 1. Power up test fixture to nominal VDD=1.8V, VDDQ=1.8V at 25°C ambient. 2. Configure FPGA controller core to issue continuous JEDEC DDR write burst patterns (0x55AA55AA) at 200 MHz (400 MT/s). 3. Connect differential active probes to CK/CK# and DQS/DQS# package test points. 4. Measure intra-pair differential skew, transition rise/fall times (20% to 80%), and eye height/width over 100,000 unit intervals (UI). 5. Compare physical oscilloscope measurements against post-layout OpenSTA SPEF timing reports. | `Differential intra-pair skew between complementary pins must be <= 15 ps; eye opening width must be >= 0.70 UI at BER 10^-12; eye height >= 350 mV across 100,000 UI.` |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-FPGA-2-02` | **Simultaneous Switching Noise (SSN) and Ground Bounce Under Maximum Toggle Rate** | Tektronix MSO64B 8 GHz Oscilloscope with 50-ohm coaxial micro-probing tips, Rohde & Schwarz HMP4040 Low-Noise Linear DC Power Supply, Thermal Stream Chamber (-40°C to 125°C). | 1. Initialize device in thermal chamber at 85°C. 2. Configure FPGA controller to trigger pseudorandom PRBS-7 data toggle bursts concurrently across all data pins. 3. Micro-probe VSSQ and VDDQ pads directly at the package substrate adjacent to differential DQS pairs. 4. Capture peak-to-peak transient rail bounce during full bus turn-around transitions over 50 consecutive write cycles. | `VSSQ ground bounce peak amplitude <= 90 mV; VDDQ droop <= 100 mV (<= 5.5% nominal 1.8V); zero false-triggering or phase-lock loss detected by the receiver DQS circuit.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level 2 ESD-safe lab coat (surface resistivity 10^6 - 10^9 ohms/sq), ANSI Z87.1 approved UV/impact-resistant safety glasses, Electrostatic dissipative nitrile gloves (Class 100 cleanroom compatible), Heel grounders and calibrated ESD wrist strap with 1 Mohm current-limiting resistor
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with solvent, wash immediately with running water for at least 15 minutes. In case of eye contact, rinse cautiously with eyewash station for 15 minutes while holding eyelids open. If inhaled, remove victim to fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing becomes labored. In case of electric shock from high-voltage probing test fixtures, disconnect main power breaker immediately and initiate CPR if unresponsive.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Benchtop chemical fume extraction trunk with minimum face velocity of 100 FPM (0.51 m/s) active during board solvent cleaning; laminar flow clean bench (ISO Class 5) for bare die socketing and optical inspection.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent solvent wipes and liquid IPA effluent collected in dedicated UN-rated flammable hazardous waste containers; do not vent to open drains; dispose via certified semiconductor solvent recovery contractor.

| **Deionized Water** | `7732-18-5` | ASTM Type I (18.2 MOhm-cm) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `240 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-cleaned gold-plated (ENIG/ENEPIG) substrate bond pads and test carrier socket free of particulate contamination and organic residue (contact angle < 15 deg).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Assembled test fixture passivated under dry nitrogen purge, zero solder flux dendrites, moisture sensitivity level compliant (MSL-3 sealed).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Atmospheric moisture absorption and copper/silver galvanic oxidation on fine-pitch bond fingers causing parasitic contact resistance spike (> 1.5 ohm) and differential return loss degradation (> -10 dB).

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full physical design, differential I/O pin placement signoff, and post-layout verification of the Verilog DDR PHY IP macro on the 180nm node meeting all JEDEC timing constraints and DRC/LVS physical DRC rules.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `ddr_phy_macro_routed_floorplan.gds`
- [ ] `ddr_differential_io_sta_timing_report.csv`
- [ ] `differential_eye_diagram_compliance_signoff.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Maximum intra-pair differential routing skew for CK/CK# and DQS/DQS# nets** | `10.0 ps` | +/- 2.5 ps | OpenSTA static timing analysis with extracted OpenRCX SPEF parasitic netlist |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Differential trace characteristic impedance (Z_diff) across package substrate escape** | `100.0 ohm` | +/- 5.0 ohm | Time Domain Reflectometry (TDR) measurement and FastCap 3D field solver simulation |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Simultaneous switching output ground bounce on VSSQ during 16-bit PRBS-7 burst** | `75.0 mV` | <= +15.0 mV | High-bandwidth active micro-probing across dedicated VSSQ/VDDQ package pads on test bench |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Zero DRC violations in KLayout using 180nm open-source rules; zero setup/hold timing violations across all PVT corners (WCS/BCS/TYP); differential pin skew <= 12.5 ps verified; written signoff approval signed by Systems Engineer and Lead Domain Expert.

# Standard Operating Procedure: FPGA Hardware-in-the-Loop Timing Metrology & Bitline Latency Verification

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 2 (µm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Coupling an ESP32-driven closed-loop positioning platform to an FPGA-based nanosecond metrology loop introduces asynchronous clock-domain boundary jitter. The ESP32's microsecond-scale step-direction pulses and SPI feedback must be optically isolated and synchronized to the FPGA's 200 MHz core timebase using dual-rank flip-flops to prevent metastability during real-time DRAM bitline latching measurements.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm DRAM nodes, bitline parasitic capacitance (Cbl ~ 150-250 fF) combined with sense amplifier activation delay (t_RCD) dictates sub-nanosecond signal integrity. Using off-the-shelf FPGA high-speed I/O (LVDS/SSTL) to sample bitline sensing thresholds requires de-embedding PCB track impedance (Zo = 50 ohm) and probe capacitance (< 0.8 pF), or the measured latency will be artificially masked by instrumentation RC time constants.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: COTS FPGA development kits (e.g., Xilinx Artix-7 or Gowin GW2A) and high-bandwidth active differential probes (>= 1.5 GHz) face intermittent distribution constraints in regional Southeast Asia labs. The setup must standardize on accessible FMC (FPGA Mezzanine Card) carrier interconnects with standardized SMA breakout interfaces to prevent custom breakout PCB fabrication bottlenecks.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The verification testbench must not become a blocking dependency for the physical wafer probing milestone. Firmware for the Verilog DDR PHY state machine and ESP32 motion synchronization must be frozen and validated in RTL/Cocotb co-simulation at least 10 working days prior to physical wafer probe card mounting.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Clock skew and phase drift between the FPGA PLL reference clock and the device-under-test (DUT) bitline strobe causing false sense-amplifier margin violations.
1. High ground-bounce and common-mode impedance across the probe-card-to-FPGA ground return loop corrupting sub-50mV bitline differential voltage sensing.
1. Mechanical micro-stepping vibration resonance (> 30 Hz) from the NEMA 17 stage inducing micro-probe contact bounce and physical pad damage on the 180nm die.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-FPGA-3-01` | **FPGA HIL Bitline Sense-Amplifier Latency (t_RCD) Timing Calibration** | FPGA Development Board (Xilinx Artix-7 XC7A100T-FGG484), 2.5 GHz 4-Channel Mixed-Signal Oscilloscope (Keysight DSOX6004A or equivalent), 2x 1.5 GHz Active Differential Probes (probe tip capacitance < 0.8 pF), ESP32 Motion Stage Interface Board. | 1. Command ESP32 stage controller to position probe needles on the DRAM die sense-amp test points. 2. Trigger FPGA state machine to issue JEDEC ACTIVATE command to target row 0x00A5. 3. Simultaneously acquire differential bitline voltage (BL/BL#) via oscilloscope and start FPGA internal high-speed SerDes time-to-digital converter (TDC). 4. Record the delay from ACTIVATE edge to differential bitline delta reaching 100 mV. 5. Repeat across 10,000 cycles across corner supply voltages (1.62V, 1.80V, 1.98V). | `Measured bitline sense delay t_RCD must be within 18.0 ns ± 1.5 ns at 1.80V nominal VDD, with FPGA internal TDC tracking scope reference within ± 250 ps across all 10,000 cycles.` |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-FPGA-3-02` | **Closed-Loop Stage Vibration and Contact Resistance Metrology under High-Speed PHY Burst** | Optical Linear Encoder (1.0 µm resolution), Sorbothane Damped 4040 Stage, Keithley 2400 SourceMeter (4-wire Kelvin sensing), Rigol DS7054 Oscilloscope connected to stage error monitor. | 1. Position stage to engage probe needles with 15 µm target pad overdrive. 2. Initiate full-bandwidth DDR PHY memory transactions for 30 minutes continuous run. 3. Monitor stage linear displacement deviation via optical encoder. 4. Continuously log contact resistance across VDD/VSS probe contacts using 4-wire Kelvin probe. 5. Inspect bit-error count registers on FPGA memory controller. | `Stage dynamic position drift must remain < 1.0 µm peak-to-peak; probe contact resistance variation must remain < 0.15 ohm; total bit errors logged by FPGA over 30 minutes must equal 0 (BER < 1e-12).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ESD-safe cleanroom coat and grounding wrist strap (1 Mohm series resistor), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV and impact safety glasses, Nitrile chemical-resistant gloves (Class 100 cleanroom compatible, thickness >= 4 mil), ESD static-dissipative cleanroom booties
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of IPA eye contact: Flush eyes immediately with copious amounts of clean running water or saline solution for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open; seek medical evaluation. In case of skin exposure: Wash with mild soap and water; remove contaminated apparel. If inhaled: Move personnel to fresh clean air; if breathing difficulties persist, administer oxygen and call emergency services.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operation within Class 1000 (ISO 6) cleanroom laminar flow bench with localized exhausted solvent cleaning enclosure maintaining face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 fpm) for IPA solvent handling and degreasing.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent IPA cleaning wipes and rinsing solvent into dedicated, labeled flammables-rated hazardous solvent waste containers. Do not pour into municipal drains. Seal containers tightly to prevent VOC vapor accumulation and route through licensed hazardous chemical disposal vendors.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI / Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Deionized Water (DI Water)** | `7732-18-5` | ASTM Type I (> 18 MOhm-cm) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly developed/etched 180nm DRAM test die pads rinsed with DI water (18 MOhm-cm), blown dry with filtered N2 gas, free of native oxide and organic residues.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Probed bond pads cleaned of probe-needle scrub particles via filtered N2 blow-off; vacuum-sealed or nitrogen-purged ready for wire-bonding or post-electrical passivation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Native oxide (Al2O3 / CuOx) formation and airborne organic particulate accumulation exceeding 30 minutes in ambient air elevates probe contact resistance (> 5 ohms), causing signal attenuation, false bitline latency measurements, and mechanical scrubbing pad wear.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full hardware-in-the-loop timing metrology platform validated, demonstrating synchronized ESP32 micro-stepping stage placement (< 1 µm accuracy) and sub-nanosecond FPGA DRAM controller bitline latency characterization conforming to 180nm open-source memory architecture specifications.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `HIL_Bitline_Latency_Timing_Matrix_TC_MCU_COTS_FPGA_3.csv`
- [ ] `Stage_Position_Jitter_and_Dynamic_Stability_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `Oscilloscope_Differential_Sensing_De-embedded_Waveforms.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **FPGA-instrumented bitline activation latency (t_RCD) characterization matches de-embedded oscilloscope measurement** | `18.5 ns` | ± 0.5 ns | High-bandwidth 2.5 GHz oscilloscope cross-correlation with FPGA internal SerDes TDC timestamp counter over 10,000 read bursts |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Closed-loop micro-positioning stage physical hold stability during DDR PHY memory cycle execution** | `0.0 µm` | ± 1.0 µm | Continuous optical linear encoder real-time telemetry logging via ESP32 hardware interrupt timer at 1 kHz sample rate |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Kelvin probe dynamic contact resistance across DRAM power and sensing pads under continuous operation** | `0.85 ohm` | < 1.5 ohm maximum threshold | Keithley 2400 4-wire DC resistance measurement logged at 10 Hz during continuous active DRAM burst testing |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researcher exit signoff requires 100% completion of TC-MCU-COTS-FPGA-3-01 and TC-MCU-COTS-FPGA-3-02 with zero zero-bit errors over 30 minutes, all ASSERT-01 through ASSERT-03 metrics within defined tolerances, and all raw CSV data and high-resolution waveforms signed off and archived in the project repository.

testcases.pre_conditions: ESP32 closed-loop PID control loop active; NEMA 17 motor powered with 1/16 microstepping; FPGA executing continuous pseudo-random DRAM READ/WRITE bursts at 133 MHz DDR (266 MT/s).
testcases.procedure: 1. Position stage to engage probe needles with 15 µm target pad overdrive. 2. Initiate full-bandwidth DDR PHY memory transactions for 30 minutes continuous run. 3. Monitor stage linear displacement deviation via optical encoder. 4. Continuously log contact resistance across VDD/VSS probe contacts using 4-wire Kelvin probe. 5. Inspect bit-error count registers on FPGA memory controller.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Stage dynamic position drift must remain < 1.0 µm peak-to-peak; probe contact resistance variation must remain < 0.15 ohm; total bit errors logged by FPGA over 30 minutes must equal 0 (BER < 1e-12).

ppe_required: ESD-safe cleanroom coat and grounding wrist strap (1 Mohm series resistor)
ANSI Z87.1 certified UV and impact safety glasses
Nitrile chemical-resistant gloves (Class 100 cleanroom compatible, thickness >= 4 mil)
ESD static-dissipative cleanroom booties
ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: In case of IPA eye contact: Flush eyes immediately with copious amounts of clean running water or saline solution for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open; seek medical evaluation. In case of skin exposure: Wash with mild soap and water; remove contaminated apparel. If inhaled: Move personnel to fresh clean air; if breathing difficulties persist, administer oxygen and call emergency services.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Operation within Class 1000 (ISO 6) cleanroom laminar flow bench with localized exhausted solvent cleaning enclosure maintaining face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 fpm) for IPA solvent handling and degreasing.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Collect spent IPA cleaning wipes and rinsing solvent into dedicated, labeled flammables-rated hazardous solvent waste containers. Do not pour into municipal drains. Seal containers tightly to prevent VOC vapor accumulation and route through licensed hazardous chemical disposal vendors.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Freshly developed/etched 180nm DRAM test die pads rinsed with DI water (18 MOhm-cm), blown dry with filtered N2 gas, free of native oxide and organic residues.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Probed bond pads cleaned of probe-needle scrub particles via filtered N2 blow-off; vacuum-sealed or nitrogen-purged ready for wire-bonding or post-electrical passivation.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Native oxide (Al2O3 / CuOx) formation and airborne organic particulate accumulation exceeding 30 minutes in ambient air elevates probe contact resistance (> 5 ohms), causing signal attenuation, false bitline latency measurements, and mechanical scrubbing pad wear.

expected_result.summary: Full hardware-in-the-loop timing metrology platform validated, demonstrating synchronized ESP32 micro-stepping stage placement (< 1 µm accuracy) and sub-nanosecond FPGA DRAM controller bitline latency characterization conforming to 180nm open-source memory architecture specifications.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: FPGA-instrumented bitline activation latency (t_RCD) characterization matches de-embedded oscilloscope measurement
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: High-bandwidth 2.5 GHz oscilloscope cross-correlation with FPGA internal SerDes TDC timestamp counter over 10,000 read bursts

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Closed-loop micro-positioning stage physical hold stability during DDR PHY memory cycle execution
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Continuous optical linear encoder real-time telemetry logging via ESP32 hardware interrupt timer at 1 kHz sample rate

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Kelvin probe dynamic contact resistance across DRAM power and sensing pads under continuous operation
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Keithley 2400 4-wire DC resistance measurement logged at 10 Hz during continuous active DRAM burst testing

expected_result.signoff_criteria: Researcher exit signoff requires 100% completion of TC-MCU-COTS-FPGA-3-01 and TC-MCU-COTS-FPGA-3-02 with zero zero-bit errors over 30 minutes, all ASSERT-01 through ASSERT-03 metrics within defined tolerances, and all raw CSV data and high-resolution waveforms signed off and archived in the project repository.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## High-Bandwidth Active Differential Probe Interposer Board & Fixture Acquisition

- **Document Link**: [sop_high_bandwidth_active_differential_probe_interposer.md](./docs/knowledge/sop_high_bandwidth_active_differential_probe_interposer.md)
- **Node ID**: `node-active-diff-probe-interposer`
- **Context Path**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > ESP32 Closed-Loop Motor Controller > FPGA High-Speed DRAM Memory Controller Core (Verilog DDR PHY & JEDEC State Machine) > FPGA Hardware-in-the-Loop Timing Metrology & Bitline Latency Verification > High-Bandwidth Active Differential Probe Interposer Board & Fixture Acquisition
- **Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type**: Make

---

### Signal Chain Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   DUT Bitline Pad /    │
│   Package Test Point   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Direct Solder-in    │
│    Active Probe Tip    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│         Custom         │
│  Controlled-Impedance  │
│    Interposer Board    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Active Differential   │
│    Probe Amplifier     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       Real-Time        │
│  Oscilloscope / FPGA   │
│     Metrology Core     │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Capacitance Budget Comparison

```text
                   ┌───────────────────────────────────┐
                   │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
C_BL Range Max (fF)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                   │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒              │
C_BL Range Min (fF)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒              │
    C_cell Min (fF)┤▓▓▓▓                               │
                   │▓▓▓▓                               │
    C_cell Nom (fF)┤█████                              │
                   │█████                              │
                   └┬────────┬───────┬────────┬───────┬┘
                   0.0     62.5    125.0    187.5 250.0 
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate Material & Controlled-Impedance Stackup Definition**:
   - Fabricate on high-frequency, low-loss laminate (Rogers RO4350B or Panasonic Megtron 6, $\varepsilon_r \approx 3.48 \text{ to } 3.65$).
   - Implement a 4-layer stackup: Layer 1 differential coplanar microstrip ($BL$ and $/BL$), Layer 2 continuous ground plane ($GND$), Layer 3 active probe DC rails ($\pm 3.3\text{ V}$), Layer 4 auxiliary telemetry.
   - Tune trace width and spacing to achieve a differential impedance of $Z_{\text{diff}} = 100\,\Omega \pm 5\%$ ($Z_{\text{single-ended}} = 50\,\Omega$).

2. **Ultra-Low Parasitic Loading Probe Tip & Damping Integration**:
   - Surface-mount 0201/01005 thin-film damping resistors ($50\,\Omega \text{ to } 100\,\Omega$) right at the interposer entry pads to suppress stub resonance.
   - Constrain cumulative probe tip loading capacitance to $\le 0.35\text{ pF}$ to prevent pulling down the intrinsic bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_b = 150\text{ fF to } 250\text{ fF}$).
   - Match differential physical routing lengths to within $\Delta L < 150\,\mu\text{m}$ to guarantee intra-pair skew $\le 1.0\text{ ps}$.

3. **Mechanical Fixture Machining & Micro-Positioning Rig Assembly**:
   - CNC-machine an ESD-dissipative baseplate with vacuum holding for the DUT package.
   - Mount an articulated 3-axis XYZ micro-positioner stage ($10\,\mu\text{m}$ vernier resolution) to rigidly dock the active differential probe head.
   - Connect active probe output to oscilloscope/FPGA high-speed ADC ports using phase-matched coaxial cables ($\Delta t \le \pm 2\text{ ps}$).

4. **De-Embedding Calibration & In-Situ Verification**:
   - Perform 2-port differential S-parameter sweeps ($S_{dd11}$, $S_{dd21}$) using a VNA and calibration coupon from $100\text{ kHz}$ to $4.0\text{ GHz}$.
   - Export Touchstone `.s2p` files into the scope/FPGA de-embedding engine to strip out interposer insertion loss and group delay.
   - Perform readout cycles on the 180nm folded bitline memory test cell, verifying signal resolution across the expected $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$ window.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Physical Unit | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Analog System Bandwidth ($-3\text{ dB}$)** | $\ge 2.5$ | Min $2.5$ | $\text{GHz}$ | VNA $S_{dd21}$ frequency response sweep |
| **Input Tip Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{\text{in}}$)** | $\le 0.35$ | Max $0.35$ | $\text{pF}$ | LCR meter at $100\text{ MHz}$ / TDR reflection profile |
| **Differential Characteristic Impedance ($Z_{\text{diff}}$)** | $100$ | $\pm 5\%$ ($95 - 105$) | $\Omega$ | TDR differential step profile ($t_r \le 35\text{ ps}$) |
| **Intra-Pair Differential Skew ($\Delta t_{\text{skew}}$)** | $\le 1.0$ | Max $1.5$ | $\text{ps}$ | Time-domain transmission difference between BL & /BL |
| **Bitline Signal Amplitude Resolution ($\Delta V_{\text{detect}}$)** | $100 - 150$ | Capable of resolving $\ge 50$ | $\text{mV}$ | Real-time oscilloscope vertical differential sensitivity |

---

### Verified Local Literature Citations

- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch between complementary bitlines $BL$ and $/BL$.
  - Bitline precharge to $V_{DD}/2$.
  - Differential signal development: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right) \approx 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$ for $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - $180\text{ nm}$ technology node, $8F^2$ folded bitline layout with stacked capacitor over bitline (COB); transistor dimensions $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Storage node capacitance $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$ minimum budget.
- **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**:
  - $8F^2$ footprint at $F = 180\text{ nm}$ ($\text{cell area} = 0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2$).
  - Storage capacitance $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF to } 30\text{ fF}$ (nominal $28\text{ fF}$).
  - Bitline parasitic capacitance $C_b = 150\text{ fF to } 250\text{ fF}$.
  - Capacitance ratio constraint: $C_b / C_s$ maintained between $5:1$ and $9:1$ (degrades severely if $> 10:1$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Integrating an active differential probe interposer between the FPGA PHY and the 180nm DRAM test fixture introduces parasitic loop inductance and capacitive loading on high-speed DQ/DQS lanes. If interposer stub length exceeds 1.2 mm, transmission line reflections will distort eye diagrams and corrupt sub-nanosecond bitline timing measurements.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: High-bandwidth active differential probing (>4 GHz) requires controlled 100-ohm differential impedance across the interposer traces with precise probe tip damping resistors (typically 50-100 ohms). Probe tip input capacitance must stay strictly below 0.3 pF to prevent slew-rate degradation and spurious jitter in low-amplitude bitline sense-amplifier readouts.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Active differential RF probe amplifiers and specialized interposer micro-connectors (e.g., SMPM or micro-coaxial solder-in tips) face extended lead times (12-16 weeks) and export restrictions. Sourcing must secure pre-calibrated S-parameter de-embedding files (.s2p/.s4p) directly from vendors like Keysight or Tektronix to prevent fixture-induced calibration voids.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The purchase and validation schedule must align tightly with the Gen 2 FPGA HIL milestone. Any delay in verifying probe de-embedding or mechanical fixture planarity risks blocking the critical path for physical bitline latency signoff on the 180nm DRAM prototype.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Excessive capacitive loading (>0.4 pF) from probe tips causing severe rise-time degradation and false timing violation triggers on DDR DQS edges.
1. Mechanical contact planarity skew (>15 µm across fixture landing pads) leading to probe tip breakage, intermittent ground references, or catastrophic pad lift on the test board.
1. Omission or corruption of fixture S-parameter de-embedding profiles resulting in overestimation of bitline access latency (tAA/tRCD) by >800 ps.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-FPGA-3-1-01` | **Interposer Differential Return and Insertion Loss Characterization via VNA** | Keysight N5224B 4-Port PNA Microwave Network Analyzer (10 MHz - 43.5 GHz) with N4691D Electronic Calibration (ECal) Module and micro-probing station. | 1. Land calibrated GSGSG micro-probes on the input and output landing pads of the active differential probe interposer DQ0/DQS lanes. 2. Perform full 4-port S-parameter sweep from 50 MHz to 6.0 GHz at -10 dBm stimulus power. 3. Extract differential insertion loss (SDD21) and differential return loss (SDD11). 4. Record group delay flatness across the operating Nyquist band (up to 2.5 GHz). | `Differential return loss SDD11 must be <= -15 dB up to 2.5 GHz; differential insertion loss SDD21 variation must be within -1.2 dB +/- 0.3 dB up to 2.5 GHz; group delay variation must not exceed +/- 25 ps.` |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-FPGA-3-1-02` | **Active Probe Loading and Rise-Time Impact Verification on DDR PHY Slew Rate** | Tektronix DPO71604C 16 GHz Digital Phosphor Oscilloscope with P7716 16 GHz TriMode Active Differential Probes and calibrated fast-edge pulse generator (Picosecond Pulse Labs 4015D, 15 ps rise time). | 1. Connect active differential probe tip to the interposer test point across the differential microstrip line. 2. Inject 500 mV peak-to-peak step edge with 100 ps nominal rise time (20%-80%). 3. Measure 20%-80% rise time at the terminated end with and without the active probe attached. 4. Calculate added probe tip loading capacitance using delta rise-time degradation formula. 5. Inspect 10-90% transition for ringing or peaking. | `Loaded 20%-80% rise time degradation must be <= 12% relative to bare trace reference; effective probe tip capacitive loading must be <= 0.28 pF; post-transition overshoot/ringing must be < 5% of step amplitude.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Static-dissipative nitrile gloves (ESD compliant), ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with side shields, Class 1000 cleanroom anti-static smock with grounding wrist strap
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For eye contact with solvent: Flush eyes immediately with copious amounts of tempered water for at least 15 minutes at eyewash station. For skin contact: Wash affected area with mild soap and water. Inhalation of solvent fumes: Move victim to fresh air immediately; seek medical attention if irritation or respiratory distress persists.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Benchtop chemical solvent operations and precision contact cleaning must be executed under a certified Class II Type A2 laminar flow chemical fume hood with face velocity maintained between 80-100 fpm.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA solvent wipes and residue must be collected in closed, dedicated flammable solvent hazardous waste containers labeled with GHS flammable markings; do not drain to cleanroom municipal wastewater.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Electronic Grade (VLSI) | `>= 99.8%` |
| **Deionized Water** | `7732-18-5` | ASTM Type I (18.2 MOhm-cm) | `100%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Solvent-cleaned (IPA degreased), pristine gold-plated (ENIG/ENEPIG) landing pads free from copper oxidation, solder mask residues, and organic particulates.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Interposer fixture landed, vacuum-packaged in ESD-shielding barrier bag purged with dry nitrogen (<5% RH), ready for physical attachment to DRAM daughterboard.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Atmospheric exposure beyond queue time causes surface organic adsorption and moisture accumulation on probe tip solder joints, increasing parasitic contact resistance by >1.5 ohms and causing RF impedance mismatches.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full acquisition, physical inspection, S-parameter de-embedding validation, and active electrical loading characterization of the high-bandwidth active differential probe interposer board and fixture for 180nm DRAM HIL metrology.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `TC-MCU-COTS-FPGA-3-1_SParameter_DeEmbedding.s4p`
- [ ] `Interposer_Step_Response_Transient_Verification.csv`
- [ ] `Active_Probe_Fixture_Acceptance_Report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Differential return loss (SDD11) of the interposer signal path across operating band up to 2.5 GHz** | `-18.0 dB` | <= -15.0 dB maximum threshold | Calibrated 4-port VNA frequency-domain S-parameter extraction |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Equivalent active differential probe tip shunt loading capacitance** | `0.22 pF` | +/- 0.05 pF (strict upper limit 0.28 pF) | Transient step response rise-time degradation analysis against 15 ps fast-edge standard |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Interposer planar fixture contact resistance per signal pin** | `45 mOhm` | +/- 10 mOhm | 4-wire Kelvin DC resistance bridge measurement |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All S-parameter profiles verify return loss <= -15 dB up to 2.5 GHz, transient probe tip loading capacitance verified <= 0.28 pF, 4-wire Kelvin contact resistance <= 55 mOhm across all contact pins, and vendor calibration .s4p files successfully de-embedded into the FPGA HIL oscilloscope setup without convergence error.

# Standard Operating Procedure: FPGA HIL Testbench Instrumentation & Time-to-Digital Converter Core Implementation

**Category**: Circuit Design | **Generation**: Gen 2 (µm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Integrating an on-chip Tapped Delay Line (TDL) or Vernier Time-to-Digital Converter (TDC) within the FPGA fabric introduces severe routing-induced skew across Look-Up Table (LUT) carry chains (CARRY4/CARRY8 blocks). Without hard macro placement locks and dedicated clock routing (BUFG/PLL), intrinsic jitter (>25 ps RMS) and non-uniform bin widths will corrupt physical bitline sensing latency measurements on the 180nm test vehicle.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm CMOS nodes with target gate delays (tau_d <= 80 ps/stage) and discrete NMOS/PMOS switching thresholds (V_M = 0.90 V +/- 50 mV), measuring transient bitline discharge and sense amplifier latching dynamics requires TDC sub-50 ps single-shot resolution. Differential non-linearity (DNL) and integral non-linearity (INL) calibration via wide-range code density tests must be implemented directly in the HIL state machine before taking active DRAM read metrology.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: High-speed LVDS/sub-LVDS receiver transceivers and FMC high-density daughterboards for micro-coaxial probing between the FPGA carrier and the wafer probe station face long procurement cycles. Relying on specialized ultra-high-speed COTS FPGA families without standardized open-source bitstream toolchain support (e.g., open-source ECP5/Xilinx 7-series toolchains) risks stalling the physical verification schedule in Vietnam.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Verification milestones for the Gen 2 discrete CMOS device gates cannot proceed to array integration without automated HIL timing signoff. The HIL TDC instrumentation package must run unattended batch regressions across 10,000 read cycles within 48 hours to validate the 180nm stage 3 physical reality gate.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Thermal-induced PVT drift in FPGA carry-chain propagation velocity causing severe TDC transfer curve distortion (DNL > 1.5 LSB), rendering bitline discharge timing unresolvable.
1. Impedance mismatch at the 180nm wafer probe interface causing reflection ringing that exceeds the LVDS/CMOS receiver threshold (NM_L/NM_H margin erosion), falsely triggering early TDC stops.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Tapped-Delay-Line TDC RTL Core & Calibration Engine Synthesis

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Start Trigger:     │
│   Wordline Assertion   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Tapped-Delay-Line    │
│      Carry Chain       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  DFF Sample Registers  │
│      on BL Latch       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Thermometer Code    │
│        Decoder         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼

```

```text
Max Ret (ms)┤░░░░░░░░░░░                               │
            │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                │

   C_BL (fF)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
            │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│

            0.0      62.5       125.0     187.5   250.0 
```

---

### Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **RTL Primitive Instantiation & Tapped Delay Line Sizing:**
   - Instantiate dedicated arithmetic carry-chain primitives (`CARRY4` / `CARRY8` equivalent) arranged into a continuous, non-broken vertical routing column.
   - Sizing: Configure a tapped-delay chain of 256 to 512 delay stages to cover a maximum measurement interval exceeding the wordline-to-sense-amplifier signal development window ($>10\text{ ns}$).
   - Constrain delay line taps using physical placement macros (`RLOC`/`BEL` or equivalent structural synthesis attributes) to eliminate routing skew across consecutive stages.

2. **Trigger & Capture Clock Domain Registration:**
   - Route the DRAM Wordline (WL) assert pulse as the asynchronous **Start** launch event propagating along the carry chain tap inputs.
   - Route the Sense Amplifier Enable (`SAN`/`SAP` activation) or Bitline (BL) differential threshold detection pulse as the **Stop** capture clock driving the distributed D-type flip-flop (DFF) capture registers tapping each stage.

3. **Thermometer-to-Binary & Bubble Filtering Logic:**
   - Feed raw capture bits into a Wallace-tree or leading-one bubble error filter to eliminate non-monotonic transition bubbles induced by clock jitter and sub-gate routing skews.
   - Convert filtered thermometer code into a high-speed binary position index ($N$-bit wide).

4. **Statistical Code-Density Calibration Engine Synthesis:**
   - Synthesize an integrated dual-port BRAM histogram engine accumulating bin hit counts from an uncorrelated calibration oscillator ($N \ge 10^5$ random samples).
   - Compute Differential Non-Linearity (DNL) and Integral Non-Linearity (INL) correction lookup tables (LUT). Map raw bin indices into calibrated picosecond latency bins.

5. **Physical Timing Metrology Integration:**
   - Couple calibrated TDC outputs to measure the physical bitline charge-sharing interval $\Delta t_{\text{sense}}$ where $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$, verifying readout margins against access transistor channel constraints ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Effective Single-Tap Resolution (LSB)** | $\le 25$ | $\text{ps}$ | Statistical code density analysis across all delay taps |
| **Differential Non-Linearity (DNL)** | $< \pm 0.85$ | $\text{LSB}$ | BRAM histogram density verification ($10^5$ samples) |
| **Integral Non-Linearity (INL)** | $< \pm 1.25$ | $\text{LSB}$ | Cumulative calibrated transfer function measurement |
| **Signal Resolution for DRAM Sensing** | $\le 100$ to $150$ | $\text{mV}$ | Measured at $C_s = 25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$ on $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ bitline load |

---

### Verified Literature Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:** Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$; minimum storage capacitance budget $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$; leakage current target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; oxide-nitride-oxide (ONO) or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-k stack ($\kappa > 15$).
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout:** Differential signal development $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$; typical cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, generating signal $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to }150\text{ mV}$; CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch sensing operation.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:** Storage capacitance maintenance of $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$; data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; bitline/wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$; gate dielectric dry oxidation $\text{SiO}_2 \sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.

---
*Captured architectural micro-knowledge has been persisted to [docs/sop_tdl_tdc_synthesis.md](./docs/sop_tdl_tdc_synthesis.md).*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Synthesizing a tapped-delay-line (TDL) Time-to-Digital Converter on an FPGA fabric to measure sub-nanosecond DRAM bitline charge-sharing dynamics and sense amplifier latch timing introduces severe PVT susceptibility. An unconstrained carry chain (e.g., CARRY4/CARRY8 primitives) exhibits intrinsic stage delays from 15 ps to 45 ps, but routing skew between taps and sampling flip-flops can exceed the tap delay itself, creating non-monotonicities and wide pseudo-bins. The online code-density calibration engine must dynamically track core voltage droop caused by simultaneous switching outputs (SSO) during memory burst operations without overflowing BRAM bin registers.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm CMOS planar node, 1T1C bitline charge-sharing Delta V is nominal +/-110 mV (C_s = 28 fF, C_b = 200 fF), with sense amplifier development times typically spanning 350 ps to 800 ps. To accurately profile the bitline sensing margin and avoid false latching assertions, the TDL-TDC must achieve single-shot LSB resolution <= 25 ps with an integrated non-linearity (INL) under 1.2 LSB after statistical calibration. If the calibration engine relies on an uncorrelated ring oscillator without uniform phase distribution, differential non-linearity (DNL) will collapse into bubble codes, destroying metrology fidelity.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Implementing high-resolution TDL cores on COTS FPGA platforms (e.g., AMD Artix-7 or Lattice ECP5) demands strict speed-grade binning (-2 or -3 minimum) to preserve carry-chain propagation consistency. Sourcing commercial-off-the-shelf boards with matched length SMA/U.FL differential trace routing to the 180nm test vehicle PCB is critical; board-level impedance mismatches or localized thermal dissipation gradients across the FPGA package will degrade TDC calibration repeatability across batch runs.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Sprint tracking for Gen 2 metrology milestones requires the calibration engine RTL to converge within 8 workdays. If routing placement constraints (LOC/BEL attributes) must be hand-tuned across 128 to 256 delay stages to eliminate bubble errors, physical synthesis iterations will block the hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) sign-off gate. Verilog synthesis scripts and automated bitstream generation must be standardized immediately to avoid delaying DRAM silicon characterization.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Bubble code occurrence in thermometer-to-binary decoding caused by clock routing skew across slice boundaries, producing meta-stable readout or false timing histograms.
1. Thermal drift and on-chip VDD fluctuations exceeding the online calibration engine tracking bandwidth, leading to severe DNL degradation and missing timing bins during prolonged bitline discharge runs.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-FPGA-3-2-1-01` | **Tapped-Delay-Line TDC Code-Density Histogram Calibration and DNL/INL Linearity Verification** | COTS FPGA Development Platform (Artix-7 XC7A35T-2FTG256C), Keysight 81160A Pulse Pattern Generator (calibrated asynchronous hit generator, <1 ps rms jitter), Rohde & Schwarz RTO6 4 GHz Oscilloscope, Host PC running Python automated metrology suite via UART/AXI-Stream. | 1. Configure the Keysight 81160A to deliver 10,000,000 asynchronous hit pulses (Poisson distribution relative to the 200 MHz TDC reference clock) to the FPGA low-jitter differential LVDS input. 2. Activate the hardware online calibration engine to compile the raw hit counts per delay tap into an internal dual-port BRAM histogram table. 3. Read back bin counts via AXI-Stream interface and compute average bin width (LSB_avg = T_clk / N_taps). 4. Calculate Differential Non-Linearity (DNL) and Integral Non-Linearity (INL) for all 128 taps across the full transfer function. | `Average tap resolution LSB_avg <= 25.0 ps; Maximum DNL strictly between -0.85 LSB and +0.95 LSB; Maximum absolute INL <= 1.20 LSB; Zero missing bins across all 128 stages.` |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-FPGA-3-2-1-02` | **HIL Real-Time DRAM Bitline Sensing Latency and Jitter Verification** | Tektronix AWG70002A Arbitrary Waveform Generator (synthesizing 180nm DRAM WL pulse and +/-110 mV bitline differential signal), FPGA HIL Test Rig, High-Bandwidth Active Differential Probe (Tektronix TDP4000), Real-Time Spectrum/Phase Jitter Analyzer. | 1. Program AWG to launch a simulated DRAM WL pulse (Start signal) and a delayed sense amplifier trigger pulse (Stop signal) representing cell charge sharing. 2. Sweep the synthetic t_RCD (WL activation to SA enable) from 500 ps to 2000 ps in discrete 20 ps increments, capturing 50,000 shots per step. 3. Acquire digitized time stamps from the FPGA TDC engine over high-speed UART. 4. Compute single-shot precision (standard deviation sigma_TDC) and linearity error relative to AWG programmed delay. | `Single-shot timing resolution precision standard deviation sigma_TDC <= 18.5 ps rms; Transfer linearity R^2 >= 0.9992 across the 500 ps to 2000 ps dynamic range; Monotonic timestamp progression with zero uncorrected bubble codes.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ANSI Z87.1 certified UV- and impact-resistant safety glasses, ESD-safe dissipative lab coat, Class 100 cleanroom compatible powder-free nitrile gloves (thickness >= 4 mil), Continuous static-dissipative wrist strap with 1 Mohm series resistor
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Inhalation: Remove victim to fresh air immediately; seek medical attention if respiratory irritation persists. Eye Contact: Flush cautiously with sterile eyewash solution for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Skin Contact: Wash thoroughly with mild soap and copious water. Ingestion: Do not induce vomiting; contact emergency medical services and poison control immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operate within an electronics metrology clean bench or laboratory equipped with localized benchtop HEPA filtration and dedicated ESD-safe fume extraction maintaining a minimum capture velocity of 100 fpm (0.51 m/s) at the board surface.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent IPA solvent wipes and cleaning effluents into designated airtight, grounded HDPE flammable solvent waste drums. Dispose of as hazardous organic solvent waste in full compliance with local environmental regulations; do not drain into sanitary sewers.

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Gold-plated SMA and edge connectors pristine, solvent-cleaned, dry, and free of oxidation or particulate debris.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: PCB testbench cleaned of flux residue, passivated with conformal ESD barrier coating, packaged in moisture-barrier bags with fresh desiccant.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Atmospheric moisture absorption and board-level micro-corrosion increase contact resistance and dielectric dissipation factor (tan delta) on high-speed LVDS traces, introducing systematic transmission line dispersion and exceeding the 25 ps jitter budget.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:

The engine provides sub-25 ps single-shot timing resolution for sensing margin verification, outputting monotonic time-of-flight registers directly to HIL test instrumentation.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:

- [ ] `calibration_code_density_dnl_inl_data.csv`
- [ ] `timing_closure_floorplan_view.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Single-shot effective resolution (LSB_eff) of calibrated delay stages** | `22.5 ps` | +/- 2.5 ps | Code-density histogram analysis under 10M Poisson random pulse distribution per TC-MCU-COTS-FPGA-3-2-1-01 |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Integral Non-Linearity (INL) post calibration across all active taps** | `0.95 LSB` | <= 1.20 LSB peak-to-peak | Cumulative sum calculation of calibrated DNL data extracted via automated AXI-Stream readout |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Single-shot standard deviation timing jitter (sigma_TDC)** | `15.0 ps rms` | <= 18.5 ps rms | Statistical standard deviation of 50,000 captures at fixed 1000 ps delay step per TC-MCU-COTS-FPGA-3-2-1-02 |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researchers achieve clean static timing closure (WNS > 0.35 ns at 200 MHz core clock) on the FPGA target, verify monotonic TDC operation with 0 uncorrected bubble codes across 10^7 continuous shots, and confirm INL <= 1.2 LSB with artifacts committed to the project metrology repository.

critics.systems_engineer: Synthesizing a tapped-delay-line (TDL) Time-to-Digital Converter on an FPGA fabric to measure sub-nanosecond DRAM bitline charge-sharing dynamics and sense amplifier latch timing introduces severe PVT susceptibility. An unconstrained carry chain (e.g., CARRY4/CARRY8 primitives) exhibits intrinsic stage delays from 15 ps to 45 ps, but routing skew between taps and sampling flip-flops can exceed the tap delay itself, creating non-monotonicities and wide pseudo-bins. The online code-density calibration engine must dynamically track core voltage droop caused by simultaneous switching outputs (SSO) during memory burst operations without overflowing BRAM bin registers.
critics.domain_expert: At the 180nm CMOS planar node, 1T1C bitline charge-sharing Delta V is nominal +/-110 mV (C_s = 28 fF, C_b = 200 fF), with sense amplifier development times typically spanning 350 ps to 800 ps. To accurately profile the bitline sensing margin and avoid false latching assertions, the TDL-TDC must achieve single-shot LSB resolution <= 25 ps with an integrated non-linearity (INL) under 1.2 LSB after statistical calibration. If the calibration engine relies on an uncorrelated ring oscillator without uniform phase distribution, differential non-linearity (DNL) will collapse into bubble codes, destroying metrology fidelity.
critics.supply_chain: Implementing high-resolution TDL cores on COTS FPGA platforms (e.g., AMD Artix-7 or Lattice ECP5) demands strict speed-grade binning (-2 or -3 minimum) to preserve carry-chain propagation consistency. Sourcing commercial-off-the-shelf boards with matched length SMA/U.FL differential trace routing to the 180nm test vehicle PCB is critical; board-level impedance mismatches or localized thermal dissipation gradients across the FPGA package will degrade TDC calibration repeatability across batch runs.
critics.laya_pm: Sprint tracking for Gen 2 metrology milestones requires the calibration engine RTL to converge within 8 workdays. If routing placement constraints (LOC/BEL attributes) must be hand-tuned across 128 to 256 delay stages to eliminate bubble errors, physical synthesis iterations will block the hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) sign-off gate. Verilog synthesis scripts and automated bitstream generation must be standardized immediately to avoid delaying DRAM silicon characterization.
critical_failure_modes: Bubble code occurrence in thermometer-to-binary decoding caused by clock routing skew across slice boundaries, producing meta-stable readout or false timing histograms.

Thermal drift and on-chip VDD fluctuations exceeding the online calibration engine tracking bandwidth, leading to severe DNL degradation and missing timing bins during prolonged bitline discharge runs.

testcases.title: Tapped-Delay-Line TDC Code-Density Histogram Calibration and DNL/INL Linearity Verification
testcases.instrumentation: COTS FPGA Development Platform (Artix-7 XC7A35T-2FTG256C), Keysight 81160A Pulse Pattern Generator (calibrated asynchronous hit generator, <1 ps rms jitter), Rohde & Schwarz RTO6 4 GHz Oscilloscope, Host PC running Python automated metrology suite via UART/AXI-Stream.
testcases.pre_conditions: FPGA programmed with TDL-TDC RTL bitstream; manual placement (LOC/BEL) locked for 128 carry stages; VDDINT stabilized at 1.00 V +/- 10 mV; junction temperature monitored and stable at 25 deg C +/- 2 deg C; code-density calibration memory cleared.
testcases.procedure: 1. Configure the Keysight 81160A to deliver 10,000,000 asynchronous hit pulses (Poisson distribution relative to the 200 MHz TDC reference clock) to the FPGA low-jitter differential LVDS input. 2. Activate the hardware online calibration engine to compile the raw hit counts per delay tap into an internal dual-port BRAM histogram table. 3. Read back bin counts via AXI-Stream interface and compute average bin width (LSB_avg = T_clk / N_taps). 4. Calculate Differential Non-Linearity (DNL) and Integral Non-Linearity (INL) for all 128 taps across the full transfer function.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Average tap resolution LSB_avg <= 25.0 ps; Maximum DNL strictly between -0.85 LSB and +0.95 LSB; Maximum absolute INL <= 1.20 LSB; Zero missing bins across all 128 stages.

testcases.title: HIL Real-Time DRAM Bitline Sensing Latency and Jitter Verification
testcases.instrumentation: Tektronix AWG70002A Arbitrary Waveform Generator (synthesizing 180nm DRAM WL pulse and +/-110 mV bitline differential signal), FPGA HIL Test Rig, High-Bandwidth Active Differential Probe (Tektronix TDP4000), Real-Time Spectrum/Phase Jitter Analyzer.
testcases.pre_conditions: TDL-TDC calibrated per TC-MCU-COTS-FPGA-3-2-1-01; calibrated LUT loaded into bubble-correction decoder; AWG calibrated to output 1.8 V CMOS WL trigger aligned to bitline perturbation with programmable delays from 100 ps to 2500 ps in 10 ps steps.
testcases.procedure: 1. Program AWG to launch a simulated DRAM WL pulse (Start signal) and a delayed sense amplifier trigger pulse (Stop signal) representing cell charge sharing. 2. Sweep the synthetic t_RCD (WL activation to SA enable) from 500 ps to 2000 ps in discrete 20 ps increments, capturing 50,000 shots per step. 3. Acquire digitized time stamps from the FPGA TDC engine over high-speed UART. 4. Compute single-shot precision (standard deviation sigma_TDC) and linearity error relative to AWG programmed delay.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Single-shot timing resolution precision standard deviation sigma_TDC <= 18.5 ps rms; Transfer linearity R^2 >= 0.9992 across the 500 ps to 2000 ps dynamic range; Monotonic timestamp progression with zero uncorrected bubble codes.
