# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Bi-directional Level Shifter Schematic Synthesis (3.3V ESP32 to 1.8V DRAM)

- **Node ID**: `node-level-shifter-3v3-1v8-gen2`
- **Hierarchical Path**: `180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration]` > `ESP32 Closed-Loop Motor Controller [Electronics & Firmware]` > `Signal Integrity & Level Shifter Daughtercard PCB (50-Ohm Controlled Impedance Microstrips) [PCB & Hardware]` > `50-Ohm Controlled Impedance Stackup Design & Level Shifter Schematic Synthesis [Circuit Design]` > `Bi-directional Level Shifter Schematic Synthesis (3.3V ESP32 to 1.8V DRAM) [Circuit Design]`
- **Generation**: Gen 2 (µm)
- **Action Type**: Make
- **Role**: Domain Expert AI (DRAM Foundation VN Multi-Agent Council)

---

### 1. Structural Architecture & Signal Flow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   ESP32 3.3V Domain    │◄─╮
│                        │  │
└────────────┬───────────┘  │
             │              │
             │              │
             ▼              │
┌────────────────────────┐  │
│                        │  │
│  Bi-directional Level  │  │
│        Shifter         ├◄─┤
│                        │  │
└────────────┬───────────┘  │
             │              │
             │              │
             ▼              │
┌────────────────────────┐  │
│                        │  │
│  180nm DRAM 1.8V V_DD  │  │
│         Domain         ├──╯
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

```text
                  Interface & Node Voltage Budget (V)   
              ┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
              │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
    ESP32 V_IO┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
              │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒       │
  Boosted V_PP┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒       │
V_BLP (V_DD/2)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                            │
              │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                            │
1.8V DRAM V_DD┤██████████████████████                  │
              │██████████████████████                  │
              └┬─────────┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬┘
             0.00      0.82      1.65     2.47     3.30 
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Power Supply & Decoupling Rail Allocation**:
   - Establish two decoupled power rails: Port A low-voltage reference at $V_{\text{CCA}} = 1.8\,\text{V}$ ($V_{\text{DD}}$ domain for 180nm DRAM access/sense circuitry) and Port B high-voltage reference at $V_{\text{CCB}} = 3.3\,\text{V}$ (ESP32 LVCMOS domain).
   - Place a $0.1\,\mu\text{F}$ X7R ceramic bypass capacitor in parallel with a $1\,\mu\text{F}$ capacitor within $2.0\,\text{mm}$ of each power pin to ground to suppress transient supply droop during state switching.

2. **Pass-Gate & Auto-Directional Transceiver Topology Selection**:
   - Synthesize bi-directional communication channels (Data Bus `DQ[n]`, bidirectional handshakes) using an auto-direction sensing discrete N-channel MOSFET pass-gate topology or an integrated dual-supply level translator (e.g., TXB0108/TXS0108 class).
   - For discrete pass-gate channels: Connect the NMOS source to DRAM Port A ($1.8\,\text{V}$ line) and the drain to ESP32 Port B ($3.3\,\text{V}$ line). Bias the NMOS gate permanently to $V_{\text{CCA}} = 1.8\,\text{V}$.
   - Connect a pull-up resistor $R_{\text{PU\_A}} = 10\,\text{k}\Omega$ to $1.8\,\text{V}$ on Port A, and $R_{\text{PU\_B}} = 10\,\text{k}\Omega$ to $3.3\,\text{V}$ on Port B.

3. **Equalization & Sense Amplifier Read/Write Interface Integration**:
   - Interface the level-shifted signals to match the DRAM internal timing phases:
     - Equalization voltage reference: $V_{\text{BLP}} = \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2} = 0.9\,\text{V}$ across bitlines $\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$.
     - Ensure DRAM inputs withstand boosted wordline overdrive voltage $V_{\text{PP}} = 2.6\,\text{V}\text{ to }2.8\,\text{V}$ applied to access gates ($W = 220\,\text{nm}, L = 180\,\text{nm}$) without back-biasing or current leakage exceeding $1\,\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
     - Match output drive timing to the DRAM sense activation window ($1\text{ to }2\,\text{ns}$ delay between N-sense pulldown $\text{SAN}$ to $\text{GND}$ and P-sense pullup $\text{SAP}$ to $V_{\text{DD}}$).

4. **Impedance Matching & Trace Interface Termination**:
   - Insert series damping resistors ($R_{\text{series}} = 22\,\Omega\text{ to }33\,\Omega$) adjacent to the level shifter outputs to match the downstream $50\,\Omega$ controlled impedance microstrip traces on the daughtercard PCB, eliminating reflections into the high-k stacked storage capacitor cells ($C_{\text{cell}} \ge 25\text{ to }30\,\text{fF}$).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Tolerance / Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **DRAM Port Output High Level ($V_{\text{OH\_A}}$)** | $1.8$ | $\text{V}$ | $\pm 5\%$ ($1.71\,\text{V} - 1.89\,\text{V}$) under nominal $V_{\text{CCA}}$ |
| **ESP32 Port Output High Level ($V_{\text{OH\_B}}$)** | $3.3$ | $\text{V}$ | $\pm 5\%$ ($3.135\,\text{V} - 3.465\,\text{V}$) under nominal $V_{\text{CCB}}$ |
| **N-to-P Sense Activation Alignment Delay ($\Delta t_{\text{SAN-SAP}}$)** | $1.0\text{ to }2.0$ | $\text{ns}$ | Verified via oscilloscope/logic analyzer at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Cell Leakage Isolation Ceiling ($I_{\text{leak}}$)** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Measured at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to maintain $> 64\,\text{ms}$ retention |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

1. **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**:
   - Access transistor geometry: $L = 180\,\text{nm}, W = 220\,\text{nm}$.
   - Minimum capacitance: $28\,\text{fF/cell}$ budget to ensure noise immunity against coupling and soft errors.
   - Leakage current target: $< 1\,\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

2. **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**:
   - Storage cell capacitance: $25\text{ to }30\,\text{fF/cell}$ for data retention $> 64\,\text{ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Physical oxide thickness: $\sim 3.5\,\text{nm}$ thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ gate dielectric; equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) $3\text{ to }4\,\text{nm}$ for stacked capacitors.

3. **[Cross-Coupled Regenerative Sense Amplifier Timing & Charge Restoration]**:
   - Equalization reference: $V_{\text{BLP}} = \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}$.
   - Overdrive wordline voltage: $V_{\text{PP}} = 2.6\,\text{V}\text{ to }2.8\,\text{V}$ ($V_{\text{DD}} + V_{\text{th}}$).
   - Sense activation sequencing: SAN pulled to $\text{GND}$, followed by SAP pulled to $V_{\text{DD}}$ with $1\text{ to }2\,\text{ns}$ delay.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Motor driver step/dir pulses must synchronize with closed-loop optical encoder feedback before commanding optical alignment moves. Hardware emergency stop and limit switches must be fail-safe.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: Kinematic positioning resolution for Gen 2 (µm) must achieve < 0.1 mm (Gen 1) or < 1 um (Gen 2). Vibrational resonance damping must settle stage within <= 150 ms after step command.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: TMC2209 silent stepper drivers, NEMA 17/23 motors, and linear ground guide rails are standard COTS. Buy off-the-shelf; Make is strictly restricted to stage brackets, anti-backlash nut fixtures, and firmware.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 24 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: MEDIUM (Backlash and thermal expansion in lead screws degrade positioning repeatability).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Mechanical lead-screw backlash exceeding 5 um during bidirectional fine step motion.
1. Stepper motor missed steps caused by microstepping resonance or driver thermal throttling.
1. Ground loop noise on encoder quadrature lines causing position loss.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-PCB-1-2-01` | **Stage Motion Repeatability & Anti-Backlash Bi-Directional Sweep** | Digital Dial Indicator (Mitutoyo 0.001 mm resolution) & Heidenhain Optical Linear Glass Scale | 1. Command stage to advance 10 mm forward in 100 um increments. 2. Reverse motion 10 mm back to initial origin coordinate. 3. Record position hysteresis gap between forward and reverse passes over 10 consecutive cycles. | `Positioning repeatability <= 1.0 um (Pass); Backlash hysteresis <= 2.0 um (Pass); Travel jerk < 0.05 m/s3 (Pass).` |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-PCB-1-2-02` | **Driver Closed-Loop Thermal & Jitter Stability Stress Test** | FLIR Thermal Imaging Camera & 4-Channel Logic Analyzer on Step/Dir Pins | 1. Monitor motor driver heatsink temperature throughout continuous 2-hour exercise run. 2. Capture step pulse jitter and motor coil inductive flyback voltages. 3. Verify zero missed step flag triggered on controller interrupt line. | `Driver heatsink temp <= 65°C without fan throttling (Pass); Zero missed steps over 72,000,000 pulses (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Anti-static ESD grounding wrist strap (1 MOhm safety resistor), Impact-resistant safety glasses, Close-toed cleanroom shoes
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Flush eyes with eyewash if IPA splashes. Mechanical pinch point: isolate 24V power supply and mechanically release leadscrew.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom HEPA laminar flow bench (ISO Class 5).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Solvent lint-free wipe disposal in approved self-closing oily waste bin.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade 99.9% | `Precision stage guide rail degreasing` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Clean dry substrate or mechanical component fixture.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Processed and inspected assembly node.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Particulate accumulation exceeding cleanroom ISO Class 5 limits.

# Standard Operating Procedure: High-Speed Bus Signal Integrity Transient & Eye-Diagram Verification

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 2 (µm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: FPGA DDR PHY state machine must rigorously implement JEDEC initialization sequences (200 us CKE low, precharge all, MRS registers). Skew across high-speed DDR DQ/DQS matched traces must hold <= 10 ps.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: PCB transmission line characteristic impedance must hold strictly at 50-ohm single-ended / 100-ohm differential (+/- 5%). Eye diagram opening at receiver must maintain >= 65% horizontal width and >= 200 mV vertical height.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Xilinx/Intel FPGA development carrier boards and high-speed SMA fixtures are standard COTS. Make is strictly restricted to custom daughtercard PCB layout, Verilog DDR PHY controller RTL, and firmware.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 32-60 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Jitter or power rail ripple on FPGA PLL induces intermittent read/write pattern errors during high-speed diagnostic telemetry sweeps).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Clock-to-data skew violating tIS/tIH setup/hold timing margin during DDR write bursts.
1. Power distribution network impedance resonance causing core VDD droop > 100 mV during simultaneous output switching.
1. Asynchronous clock domain crossing metastability in memory controller telemetry FIFO.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-PCB-1-3-01` | **DDR High-Speed Signal Integrity & Eye Diagram Oscilloscope Capture** | Keysight Infiniium 4 GHz Real-Time Oscilloscope with Differential High-Z Active Probes | 1. Probe DQ0-DQ7 and DQS differential strobe lines directly at DRAM test daughtercard receiver pins. 2. Accumulate 1,000,000 signal transitions into persistence eye diagram. 3. Extract horizontal eye width, vertical eye opening height, and RMS clock jitter. | `Eye width >= 65% UI (Pass); Vertical eye height >= 200 mV (Pass); Clock jitter RMS <= 12 ps (Pass).` |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-PCB-1-3-02` | **March C- Algorithmic Memory Fault & Retention Telemetry Verification** | FPGA Hardware-in-the-Loop Diagnostic Firmware & Automated Python Telemetry Suite | 1. Execute March C- sequence: (w0), up(r0, w1), up(r1, w0), down(r0, w1), down(r1, w0), (r0). 2. Sweep retention pause times from 1 ms to 128 ms between write and read phases. 3. Stream per-address failure bitmap via UART/USB to telemetry logging engine. | `March C- 100% address pass at nominal 64 ms refresh window (Pass); Zero bit error rate (BER < 1e-12) (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Anti-static ESD smock and grounded conductive wrist strap (1 MOhm safety resistor), Safety glasses with side shields during soldering and PCB prototyping, Nitrile gloves during circuit board solvent cleaning
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Thermal burn first aid station: Cold sterile water irrigation, hydrogel burn dressing. For flux vapor irritation, move to well-ventilated fresh air.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Point-of-use HEPA/carbon solder fume extractor at soldering workstation (airflow >= 150 m3/h). Standard laboratory climate-controlled HVAC.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent solder dross and PCB trimmings in designated recycling bin for precious metal recovery. Solvent cleaning wipes in sealed flammable safety receptacle.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Lead-Free Solder Alloy SAC305 (Sn-Ag-Cu)** | `7440-31-5` | RoHS Compliant Electronic Grade | `Sn96.5 / Ag3.0 / Cu0.5 wire & paste` |
| **Rosin Core Solder Flux (Colophony)** | `8050-09-7` | Type ROL0 / No-Clean | `Internal wire core flux (< 3 wt%)` |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade 99.9% | `Flux residue cleaning solvent` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `N/A` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `N/A`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Fabricated bare test daughtercard PCB with immersion gold (ENIG) surface finish.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Fully assembled, reflow-soldered, ultrasonic-cleaned, and impedance-tested PCB daughtercard.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Non-critical queue time. If bare PCBs exceed MSL shelf-life (> 168 hours in air), pre-bake at 125°C for 4 hours before reflow soldering to prevent PCB delamination and blistering.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of High-Speed Bus Signal Integrity Transient & Eye-Diagram Verification: High-speed FPGA DDR memory controller, 50-ohm test daughtercard PCB, and automated diagnostic firmware successfully achieve reliable read/write access and telemetry.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `FPGA_DDR_Controller_Synthesizable_RTL.tar.gz`
- [ ] `Controlled_Impedance_Daughtercard_Altium_Gerbers.zip`
- [ ] `Automated_March_C_Shmoo_Telemetry_Suite.py`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **PCB transmission line single-ended characteristic impedance (Z0)** | `50.0 ohms` | +/- 2.5 ohms (+/- 5%) | Time Domain Reflectometry (TDR) coupon measurement |
| `ASSERT-02` | **High-speed DDR data eye opening width at 200 MHz** | `>= 65.0% UI` | Minimum horizontal eye opening >= 60.0% UI | Real-time 4 GHz digital oscilloscope persistence eye diagram |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Algorithmic memory pattern test coverage (March C-)** | `100.0% address pass` | Zero single-bit faults across entire array at nominal VDD (1.80V) | Automated hardware-in-the-loop diagnostic firmware sweep |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Continuous 24-hour March C- stress run completed with zero bit errors (BER < 1e-12); Shmoo plot confirms stable voltage-frequency operating window between 1.62V and 1.98V at target clock rates.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): IBIS/SPICE I/O Buffer & Microstrip Transmission Line Model Setup

**Hierarchy Path**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > ESP32 Closed-Loop Motor Controller > Signal Integrity & Level Shifter Daughtercard PCB (50-Ohm Controlled Impedance Microstrips) > 50-Ohm Controlled Impedance Stackup Design & Level Shifter Schematic Synthesis > High-Speed Bus Signal Integrity Transient & Eye-Diagram Verification > [IBIS/SPICE I/O Buffer & Microstrip Transmission Line Model Setup](./docs/knowledge/ibis_spice_io_buffer_setup.md)  
**Generation**: Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$) | **Action Type**: Make

---

### Process Flow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   180nm Access NMOS    │
│     Buffer W=220nm     │
│        L=180nm         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   50-Ohm Microstrip    │
│   Transmission Line    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  TLM Pad De-embedding  │
│     W=100um L=50um     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       Transient        │
│    Eye-Diagram and     │
│  Timing Verification   │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 1. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

### Step 1: 180nm Transistor Sub-circuit & I/O Buffer Parameterization
1. Configure the core access transistor and buffer subcircuits to the 180nm node:
   - Channel gate length: $L = 180\text{ nm}$.
   - Channel gate width: $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
2. Assign the shared bitline contact series resistance and parasitic inductance representative of the tungsten plug (W-plug) contact interface.
3. Configure the 1T1C storage node cell model using a high-$\kappa$ dielectric stack ($\text{ONO}$ / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ / $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$, $\kappa > 15$) with minimum storage capacitance $C_s = 28\text{ fF}$.
4. Constrain junction and sub-threshold leakage parameters to $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

### Step 2: Array Bitline Lumped/Distributed Parasitic Loading
1. For an array block of 256 to 512 cells in a folded bitline architecture ($8F^2$ footprint, $0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ unit cell area), instantiate distributed parasitic bitline capacitance $C_b$ within $150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$.
2. Enforce the capacitance budget ratio $C_b / C_s$ strictly between $5:1$ and $9:1$ to maintain read signal margin.

### Step 3: TLM Contact & Pad De-Embedding Setup
1. Incorporate Transmission Line Measurement (TLM) de-embedding blocks representing the chip-to-board interconnect pad structures:
   - Contact pad dimensions: Pad width $W = 100\ \mu\text{m}$, Pad length $L_{\text{pad}} = 50\ \mu\text{m}$.
   - Pad gap spacings: $d \in \{5, 10, 20, 40, 80\}\ \mu\text{m}$.
2. Parameterize total pad interface resistance via $R_T = 2 R_c + (R_s / W) \cdot d$, extracting transfer length $L_T$ and specific contact resistivity $\rho_c = R_c \cdot W \cdot L_T = R_s \cdot L_T^2\ [\Omega\cdot\text{cm}^2]$.

### Step 4: 50-$\Omega$ Controlled Impedance Microstrip Synthesis & Interconnect Coupling
1. Configure PCB daughtercard microstrip transmission line models with characteristic impedance $Z_0 = 50.0\ \Omega \pm 10\%$.
2. Model frequency-dependent dielectric loss ($\tan\delta$), skin-effect series resistance, and microstrip trace delay between the DRAM output buffer and the ESP32 level shifter inputs.

### Step 5: IBIS / Transient Eye-Diagram Verification
1. Run transient pulse train and PRBS-7 signal integrity simulations.
2. Verify eye height, jitter, and reflection boundaries to ensure common-mode noise rejection and full logic level transition through the daughtercard PCB.

---

## 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                    Acceptance Target Metrics (Nominal)   
                ┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
                │░                                       │
    Leakage (fA)┤░                                       │
                │▒▒▒▒▒▒                                  │
Storage C_s (fF)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒                                  │
  Array C_b (fF)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
  Trace Z0 (Ohm)┤███████████                             │
                │███████████                             │
                └┬─────────┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬┘
                 0        50        100      150      200 
```

| Metric ID | Parameter | Nominal / Target Spec | Tolerance / Pass Boundary | Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Transmission Line Characteristic Impedance ($Z_0$) | $50.0$ | $45.0 \le Z_0 \le 55.0$ | $\Omega$ |
| **AC-02** | Storage Node Cell Capacitance ($C_s$) | $28.0$ | $\ge 25.0$ (Nominal: $\ge 28.0$) | $\text{fF}$ |
| **AC-03** | Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_b$) (256/512 cells) | $200.0$ | $150.0 \le C_b \le 250.0$ | $\text{fF}$ |
| **AC-04** | Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$) | $7.14 : 1$ | $5.0 : 1 \le C_b / C_s \le 9.0 : 1$ (Hard Max: $< 10.0 : 1$) | Dimensionless |
| **AC-05** | Storage Node Leakage Current ($85^\circ\text{C}$) | $< 1.0$ | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ |

---

## 3. Literature Citations & Physical Provenance

All parameters and constraints are directly derived from the verified local literature base:
1. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - Access transistor dimensions: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Stacked capacitor dielectric: $\text{ONO} / \text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ ($\kappa > 15$).
   - Storage capacitance minimum: $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$.
   - Leakage limit: $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
2. **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**:
   - Folded bitline area: $8F^2 = 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$.
   - Array block parasitic bitline capacitance: $C_b = 150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$.
   - Noise margin capacitance budget: $C_b / C_s \in [5:1, 9:1]$ ($< 10:1$).
3. **Transmission Line Measurement (TLM) for Specific Contact Resistivity**:
   - Pad geometry: $W = 100\ \mu\text{m}$, $L_{\text{pad}} = 50\ \mu\text{m}$.
   - Gap spacings: $d = 5, 10, 20, 40, 80\ \mu\text{m}$.
   - Formulation: $R_T = 2 R_c + (R_s / W) \cdot d$, with $\rho_c = R_c \cdot W \cdot L_T = R_s \cdot L_T^2\ [\Omega\cdot\text{cm}^2]$.

---
*Persisted micro-knowledge documentation generated at [`docs/knowledge/ibis_spice_io_buffer_setup.md`](./docs/knowledge/ibis_spice_io_buffer_setup.md).*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The IBIS behavioral model for the 180nm DRAM I/O buffer (V_DDIO = 1.8V) must maintain rigorous fidelity with transient SPICE level-shifter transceivers interfacing the 3.3V ESP32 motor controller bus. Neglecting package parasitics (L_pkg, C_pkg) and board microstrip discontinuities (dielectric dispersion epsilon_r(f), surface roughness skin effect loss) will corrupt the simulated eye diagram at the receiver, obscuring critical switching threshold shifts (V_M = 0.90V +/- 50mV) and dynamic delay mismatches against the 80ps/stage target.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Accurate extraction of the 50-Ohm controlled impedance microstrip requires modeling frequency-dependent complex propagation constant gamma(f) = alpha(f) + j*beta(f). At 180nm DRAM signaling speeds, copper foil profile roughness (Rq = 1.2 um to 2.5 um) and prepreg dielectric loss tangent (tan delta ~ 0.02 for standard FR4/Isola) introduce significant high-frequency attenuation, which shifts receiver dynamic switching margins (NM_H, NM_L < 0.65V) if modeled purely as ideal lossless LC transmission lines in SPICE/IBIS.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Controlled impedance stackup configurations for the daughtercard PCB depend strictly on dielectric thickness consistency (H = 100 um +/- 10%) and copper cladding tolerances from regional PCB fabricators. Deviation in trace etching (W_trace = 180 um +/- 15 um) will shift characteristic impedance Z0 outside the 45-55 Ohm window, invalidating the extracted IBIS transmission line models and driving procurement re-spins.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Simulation artifacts, IBIS v6.0/SPICE deck integration, and S-parameter Touchstone data models must complete characterization sign-off within Stage 3 reality gates to avoid halting downstream firmware testbench qualification on the ESP32 closed-loop platform.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Severe return loss and multiple reflection ringing caused by Z0 mismatch (>10% deviation from 50 Ohm), triggering false double-clocking or logic corruption across the 1.8V/3.3V level-shifter interface.
1. Underestimated skin effect and dielectric loss leading to eye-diagram closure (eye height < 400 mV, deterministic jitter > 120 ps) under pseudo-random binary sequence (PRBS-7) excitation.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-PCB-1-3-1-01` | **TDR Controlled Impedance & Microstrip S-Parameter Extraction Verification** | Keysight E5080B 4-Port Vector Network Analyzer (VNA) with TDR option (10 GHz bandwidth), Picoprobe 40A-GSG-150 coplanar microprobes, and CS-5 calibration substrate. | 1. Land GSG microprobes onto calibrated test pad launching structures at coupon Port 1 and Port 2. 2. Acquire S11 and S21 Touchstone parameter data from 10 MHz to 6 GHz. 3. Transform S11 to time-domain reflectometry (TDR) step profile with 35 ps incident rise time. 4. Extract characteristic impedance Z0 along the uniform trace region and compute per-unit-length attenuation alpha(f) at 1 GHz. | `TDR measured characteristic impedance must be within 50.0 Ohm +/- 2.5 Ohm (47.5 Ohm <= Z0 <= 52.5 Ohm) across 90% of trace length; insertion loss |S21| <= 0.85 dB at 1 GHz.` |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-PCB-1-3-1-02` | **IBIS/SPICE Transient Eye-Diagram & Noise Margin Correlation** | Synopsys PrimeSim / Cadence Spectre SPICE engine integrated with IBISCHK6 parser; Keysight Infiniium MXR-Series 4 GHz Digital Storage Oscilloscope (for hardware correlation). | 1. Run transient SPICE simulation for 10,000 unit intervals (UI) with 50-Ohm transmission line and capacitive termination load (C_L = 5 pF). 2. Overlay receiver pad voltage waveform to synthesize persistent eye diagram. 3. Extract eye height (EH), eye width (EW), and maximum peak-to-peak jitter (TJ). 4. Measure static noise margins NM_H and NM_L against the 0.65V threshold criterion. | `Eye height >= 1.10 V (under 1.8V rail); eye width >= 4.2 ns (for 5.0 ns UI); total deterministic jitter <= 110 ps; noise margins NM_H >= 0.65 V and NM_L >= 0.65 V.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses with side shields, ESD-safe dissipative static-control lab coat (IEC 61340-5-1 compliant), Powder-free cleanroom-grade nitrile gloves (thickness >= 4 mil), Dual-grounded conductive wrist strap with 1 MOhm current-limiting resistor
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact: Flush immediately with clean eyewash water for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Skin contact: Wash thoroughly with mild soap and water; remove contaminated clothing. Inhalation: Relocate personnel to fresh air. Ingestion: Rinse mouth thoroughly; do not induce vomiting and seek prompt medical evaluation.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Benchtop localized ESD extraction snorkel or chemical fume hood providing minimum face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM) during solvent wiping and microprobe cleaning.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent IPA wipes and rinse solvent in designated, grounded, airtight flammable solvent disposal containers conforming to EPA/RCRA regulations; label as hazardous organic solvent waste.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) Electronic Grade** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor / VLSI Grade | `>= 99.8%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `360 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly chemically cleaned immersion gold/ENIG or bare copper coupon contact pads, free of organic films, particulates, and fingerprints (contact angle < 30 deg).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Dry, probe-contacted test pads inspected under optical microscope, stored in antistatic nitrogen purge desiccator box at <= 5% RH.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Surface oxidation and atmospheric sulfide tarnishing on microstrip probe pads elevate contact resistance (R_c > 0.5 Ohm), distorting VNA TDR calibrations and corrupting return-loss measurements.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full synthesis and verified extraction of 180nm DRAM I/O buffer IBIS/SPICE models combined with 50-Ohm controlled impedance daughtercard microstrip models, demonstrating signal integrity compliance across transient timing, eye opening, and noise margins.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram_io_buffer_180nm.ibs`
- [ ] `microstrip_50ohm_w_element.sp`
- [ ] `high_speed_bus_eye_diagram_report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

critics.systems_engineer: The IBIS behavioral model for the 180nm DRAM I/O buffer (V_DDIO = 1.8V) must maintain rigorous fidelity with transient SPICE level-shifter transceivers interfacing the 3.3V ESP32 motor controller bus. Neglecting package parasitics (L_pkg, C_pkg) and board microstrip discontinuities (dielectric dispersion epsilon_r(f), surface roughness skin effect loss) will corrupt the simulated eye diagram at the receiver, obscuring critical switching threshold shifts (V_M = 0.90V +/- 50mV) and dynamic delay mismatches against the 80ps/stage target.
critics.domain_expert: Accurate extraction of the 50-Ohm controlled impedance microstrip requires modeling frequency-dependent complex propagation constant gamma(f) = alpha(f) + j*beta(f). At 180nm DRAM signaling speeds, copper foil profile roughness (Rq = 1.2 um to 2.5 um) and prepreg dielectric loss tangent (tan delta ~ 0.02 for standard FR4/Isola) introduce significant high-frequency attenuation, which shifts receiver dynamic switching margins (NM_H, NM_L < 0.65V) if modeled purely as ideal lossless LC transmission lines in SPICE/IBIS.
critics.supply_chain: Controlled impedance stackup configurations for the daughtercard PCB depend strictly on dielectric thickness consistency (H = 100 um +/- 10%) and copper cladding tolerances from regional PCB fabricators. Deviation in trace etching (W_trace = 180 um +/- 15 um) will shift characteristic impedance Z0 outside the 45-55 Ohm window, invalidating the extracted IBIS transmission line models and driving procurement re-spins.
critics.laya_pm: Simulation artifacts, IBIS v6.0/SPICE deck integration, and S-parameter Touchstone data models must complete characterization sign-off within Stage 3 reality gates to avoid halting downstream firmware testbench qualification on the ESP32 closed-loop platform.
critical_failure_modes: Severe return loss and multiple reflection ringing caused by Z0 mismatch (>10% deviation from 50 Ohm), triggering false double-clocking or logic corruption across the 1.8V/3.3V level-shifter interface.
Underestimated skin effect and dielectric loss leading to eye-diagram closure (eye height < 400 mV, deterministic jitter > 120 ps) under pseudo-random binary sequence (PRBS-7) excitation.

testcases.title: TDR Controlled Impedance & Microstrip S-Parameter Extraction Verification
testcases.instrumentation: Keysight E5080B 4-Port Vector Network Analyzer (VNA) with TDR option (10 GHz bandwidth), Picoprobe 40A-GSG-150 coplanar microprobes, and CS-5 calibration substrate.
testcases.pre_conditions: Daughtercard test coupon with 50-Ohm microstrip trace (length L = 50 mm) fabricated and stabilized in climate chamber at 25 deg C, 45% RH; SOLT calibration verified to return loss > 40 dB.
testcases.procedure: 1. Land GSG microprobes onto calibrated test pad launching structures at coupon Port 1 and Port 2. 2. Acquire S11 and S21 Touchstone parameter data from 10 MHz to 6 GHz. 3. Extract characteristic impedance Z0 along the uniform trace region and compute per-unit-length attenuation alpha(f) at 1 GHz.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: TDR measured characteristic impedance must be within 50.0 Ohm +/- 2.5 Ohm (47.5 Ohm <= Z0 <= 52.5 Ohm) across 90% of trace length; insertion loss |S21| <= 0.85 dB at 1 GHz.

testcases.title: IBIS/SPICE Transient Eye-Diagram & Noise Margin Correlation
testcases.instrumentation: Synopsys PrimeSim / Cadence Spectre SPICE engine integrated with IBISCHK6 parser; Keysight Infiniium MXR-Series 4 GHz Digital Storage Oscilloscope (for hardware correlation).
testcases.pre_conditions: IBIS model v6.0 generated for 180nm CMOS I/O buffer (V_DD = 1.8V, V_M = 0.90V +/- 50mV) loaded with W-element or Touchstone S2P microstrip model; PRBS-7 stimulus configured at 200 Mbps.
testcases.procedure: 1. Run transient SPICE simulation for 10,000 unit intervals (UI) with 50-Ohm transmission line and capacitive termination load (C_L = 5 pF). 2. Measure static noise margins NM_H and NM_L against the 0.65V threshold criterion.

nodes.sop_content:
An industrial Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) has been authored and saved to [sop_prbs_transient_bitline_bus_coupling.md](./docs/sop_prbs_transient_bitline_bus_coupling.md).

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   PRBS Stimulus and    │
│   Bus Model (50 Ohm)   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Bitline Coupling    │
│  Array Network (C_BL   │
│       = 250 fF)        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Wordline Boost     │
│  Dickson Driver (V_PP  │
│      = 2.5-2.8V)       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Charge Sharing and   │
│   Sensing (Delta V =   │
│      100-150 mV)       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Eye-Diagram and     │
│  Leakage Sign-Off (<=  │
│   1 fA/cell at 85 C)   │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Units | Tolerance / Boundary | Measurable Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bitline Read Differential Signal ($\Delta V$)** | `100 to 150` | $\text{mV}$ | Minimum developed sensing window ($C_s = 25\text{--}28\,\text{fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\,\text{fF}$) | SPICE Transient Waveform Measurement at SA Strobe |
| **Wordline Boost Voltage ($V_{PP}$)** | `2.5 to 2.8` | $\text{V}$ | Minimum overdrive level ($\ge V_{DD} + V_{th} + \Delta V_{overdrive}$) | Dynamic Node Voltage Extraction on Wordline Driver |
| **Bus Characteristic Impedance ($Z_0$)** | `50.0` | $\Omega$ | $\pm 10\%$ ($45\,\Omega\text{--}55\,\Omega$) | TDR / S-Parameter Transient Interconnect Extraction |
| **Cell Leakage Current (@ 85°C)** | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Maximum allowable threshold (sub-threshold + junction) | DC Operating Point / High-Temp Leakage SPICE Test |

---

### Verified Context Citations
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Access transistor $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, $W = 220\,\text{nm}$; storage capacitance budget $\ge 28\,\text{fF/cell}$ ($\kappa > 15$ dielectric); cell leakage current $< 1\,\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **High-Voltage Wordline Charge Pump (VPP) Dickson Oscillator Architecture**: Pass transistor $V_{th} \sim 0.5\,\text{V}\text{--}0.7\,\text{V}$; nominal $V_{DD} = 1.8\,\text{V}$; boosted overdrive voltage $V_{PP} \ge 2.5\,\text{V}\text{--}2.8\,\text{V}$; 4-stage Dickson pump with flying capacitors $C_{pump} = 20\,\text{pF}\text{--}50\,\text{pF}$ driven by two-phase non-overlapping clocks ($\Phi_1, \Phi_2$) at $20\,\text{MHz}\text{--}50\,\text{MHz}$.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: Folded bitline precharge to $V_{DD}/2 = 0.9\,\text{V}$; nominal cell capacitance $C_s = 25\,\text{fF}$, bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\,\text{fF}$; differential sensing signal $\Delta V \approx 100\,\text{mV}\text{--}150\,\text{mV}$; CMOS cross-coupled latch sensing with $SAN$ and $SAP$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The 180nm DRAM data bus operates at 1.8V nominal core CMOS levels, whereas the ESP32 closed-loop controller interface operates at 3.3V LVCMOS, requiring high-speed bidirectional level shifters. In transient simulation, inductive bond-wire return paths (L_wire ~ 1.5 nH) coupled with PCB microstrip discontinuities (Z0 = 50 Ohm +/- 10%) induce rail bounce (> 180 mV) during simultaneous switching noise (SSN) of PRBS-7/PRBS-15 patterns, risking false triggering of DRAM row/column sense amplifications.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm node, bitline capacitance C_BL (~ 150 fF to 200 fF) yields a delicate sense-amp differential margin (Delta V_sense ~ 100 mV to 150 mV). Fast edge-rate transient injection (t_r, t_f < 350 ps) from external level-shifted bus microstrips coupled capacitively through package leadframes and I/O pads into adjacent open bitlines can exceed 25 mV crosstalk, exceeding the allowable sense margin threshold and causing deterministic read-disturb bit flips.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Controlled impedance FR4/Megtron-4 substrates with exact H=0.15mm dielectric thickness and 0.5 oz electrodeposited copper require tight fabrication tolerances (+/- 5% impedance target) from qualified Quick-Turn PCB vendors. Specialized low-propagation-delay bidirectional level shifters (e.g., TI TXS0108E / NXP NTS0104) and high-bandwidth SMA launch connectors must maintain verified multi-source second-sourcing to hedge single-supplier assembly lead-time blowouts beyond 6 weeks.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Transient simulation convergence with full IBIS/SPICE models including parasitic RLC extraction must be locked before taping out the daughtercard revision. Physical metrology via 20 GHz TDR and 4-port VNA eye-diagram qualification must strictly align within the 2-week validation sprint to clear the milestone gate for closed-loop closed-firmware motor testbed integration.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Simultaneous Switching Noise (SSN) induced ground/VPP bounce exceeding 180 mV causing false sensing or wordline under-drive.
1. Far-end crosstalk (FEXT) between parallel 50-Ohm daughtercard microstrip lines exceeding -32 dB, causing deterministic timing jitter > 120 ps.
1. Impedance mismatch at SMA/level-shifter transition (Z_diff > 60 Ohm) causing transmission line reflections that erode PRBS eye opening below 65% UI.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-PCB-1-3-2-01` | **50-Ohm Microstrip Time-Domain Reflectometry (TDR) Impedance & Reflection Profile** | Keysight N1000A DCA-X Wideband Oscilloscope with 54754A Differential TDR Module (18 ps incident risetime), 50-Ohm semi-rigid SMA coaxial test leads, torque wrench (8 in-lb). | 1. Connect TDR Channel 1 to the daughtercard input SMA port terminated into an open/50-Ohm load at the DRAM interface pad. 2. Inject a 200 mV step edge with 35 ps system risetime. 3. Measure the characteristic impedance Z0 profile along the 50 mm microstrip trace. 4. Measure the reflection coefficient (Gamma) at the level-shifter ball/pin junction. 5. Log continuous impedance variation and maximum local deviation along the full physical trace length. | `Pass if measured characteristic impedance Z0 is 50.0 Ohm +/- 2.5 Ohm (47.5 Ohm to 52.5 Ohm) across >= 95% of trace length, and maximum reflection coefficient |Gamma| <= 0.05 (VSWR <= 1.11).` |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-PCB-1-3-2-02` | **PRBS-15 High-Speed Bus Eye-Diagram & Bitline Coupling Transient Verification** | Tektronix DPO72004C 20 GHz Real-Time Oscilloscope, differential active probe (TDP7708 8 GHz), Rohde & Schwarz SMBV100B Vector Signal Generator (PRBS pattern generator). | 1. Configure signal generator to stream PRBS-15 pattern at 100 MHz (200 Mbps DDR) into data bus lines D[0:7]. 2. Attach differential probe to adjacent un-driven sense line / quiet bitline test point. 3. Capture 1,000,000 continuous UI waveforms to construct composite eye-diagram. 4. Extract eye height, eye width, deterministic jitter (DJ), and peak-to-peak coupled crosstalk voltage on the quiet line. 5. Confirm eye-mask compliance against standard 1.8V SSTL/LVCMOS DRAM receiver boundaries. | `Pass if eye height >= 1.25 V (at 1.8V swing), eye width >= 0.75 UI (>= 3.75 ns at 200 Mbps), total jitter TJ (at BER 1e-12) <= 150 ps, and peak bitline-to-bus coupled crosstalk <= 18 mV.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, minimum 6 mil thickness), ANSI Z87.1 approved anti-splash safety glasses with side shields, Static-dissipative ESD lab coat with continuous wrist grounding strap, Fume hood rated chemical apron during solvent bench cleaning
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye Contact: Immediately flush eyes with copious amounts of water from dedicated eyewash station for minimum 15 minutes while lifting lower and upper eyelids; seek ophthalmological attention. Skin Contact: Remove contaminated clothing, flush skin thoroughly with copious water and mild soap. Inhalation: Relocate victim immediately to fresh air; provide oxygen if breathing is labored. Ingestion: Do not induce vomiting without medical directive; rinse mouth thoroughly with clean water and contact emergency medical center immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: All solvent wiping and flux residue removal must be executed under a certified chemical fume hood with face velocity maintaining 100 fpm +/- 10 fpm (0.51 m/s), ducted directly to VOC carbon bed scrubber. Laboratory ambient HVAC must maintain minimum 15 air changes per hour (ACH).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA and cleaning solvent mixtures must be collected in dedicated, grounded, poly-lined UN-rated flammable solvent containers labeled 'Hazardous Flammable Liquid Waste (IPA)'. Never drain into municipal sewers. Transport via licensed hazardous waste handler under closed-manifest incineration protocols.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (VLSI / SEMI Tier 3) | `>= 99.8% w/w` |
| **Deionized Water (DI Water)** | `7732-18-5` | ASTM Type I (18.2 MOhm-cm at 25 deg C) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Electroless Nickel Immersion Gold (ENIG) or Immersion Silver microstrip pads free of organic grease, flux residue, or ionic contamination (surface ionic cleanliness < 1.0 ug/in2 NaCl equivalent).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Precision-cleaned, nitrogen-blown dried daughtercard PCB with microstrip pads and SMA solder fillets inspected under 40x optical metrology, free of dendrites, micro-voiding, or solder splatters.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding allowable queue time in uncontrolled ambient humidity (> 50% RH) initiates surface copper/silver oxidation and moisture absorption in FR4/Megtron-4 prepregs, causing high-frequency dielectric loss tan(delta) degradation from 0.004 to > 0.012 and triggering reflow solder delamination/micro-voiding at high-speed level-shifter BGA pads.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completed transient simulation and physical S-parameter/TDR characterization confirming 50-Ohm (+/- 5%) controlled impedance on daughtercard microstrip lines, with verified PRBS-15 eye diagram margin and bitline-to-bus crosstalk suppression compliant with 180nm DRAM sensing margins.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `DRAM_SI_PRBS15_Eye_Diagram_Transient_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `Daughtercard_50Ohm_Microstrip_TDR_SParameter_Touchstone.s4p`
- [ ] `Bitline_to_Bus_Crosstalk_Transient_Coupling_Data.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Characteristic impedance Z0 of daughtercard high-speed bus microstrip traces across 100 MHz to 2.5 GHz band** | `50.0 Ohm` | +/- 2.5 Ohm | Time-Domain Reflectometry (TDR) measurement using Keysight N1000A with calibrated 18 ps step |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Peak bitline-to-bus coupled crosstalk transient voltage under PRBS-15 simultaneous switching excitation** | `12.0 mV` | <= 18.0 mV max | Differential active probing with Tektronix TDP7708 (8 GHz) at quiet line termination during 200 Mbps PRBS-15 transmission |
| `ASSERT-03` | **PRBS-15 receive eye opening height at 180nm DRAM receiver pads under nominal 1.8V bus operation** | `1.35 V` | >= 1.25 V min | Eye-diagram mask test over 1,000,000 UI using Tektronix DPO72004C real-time oscilloscope |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 8 high-speed bus data lines demonstrate 50 Ohm +/- 2.5 Ohm characteristic impedance by TDR, PRBS-15 eye opening exceeds 1.25 V height and 0.75 UI width without mask violations across 1e6 cycles, bitline-to-bus transient crosstalk peak is verified under 18 mV, and engineering review documentation is signed off by both Systems Engineer and Lead Metrology Engineer.

An actionable, industrial leaf Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) has been created and documented in [sop_oscilloscope_eye_diagram_jitter_metrology.md](./docs/sop_oscilloscope_eye_diagram_jitter_metrology.md).

---

### Metrology Workflow

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│     Oscilloscope      │
│     Calibration &     │
│     De-embedding      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Active Differential  │
│    Probe Fixturing    │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Real-Time Transient  │
│     & Eye-Diagram     │
│      Acquisition      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Dual-Dirac Jitter   │
│     Decomposition     │
│       TJ/DJ/RJ        │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│      Acceptance       │
│  Verification & Mask  │
│        Testing        │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Instrument Calibration & Touchstone S-Parameter De-Embedding**:
   - Power on the real-time oscilloscope ($\ge 4\text{ GHz}$ bandwidth, $\ge 20\text{ GSa/s}$) with $\ge 30\text{ min}$ warm-up.
   - Execute channel-to-channel deskew and DC offset nulling using active differential probe fixtures ($Z_{in} > 50\text{ k}\Omega \parallel 0.3\text{ pF}$).
   - Import `.s2p`/`.s4p` S-parameter Touchstone files for coaxial probe cables, PCB breakout traces, and level-shifter daughtercard fixtures into the oscilloscope de-embedding engine to eliminate parasitic insertion loss and phase delay.

2. **Fixturing to 50-Ohm Controlled Microstrips**:
   - Land differential active probe tips directly onto the $50\ \Omega$ single-ended ($100\ \Omega$ differential) microstrip breakout test points with low-inductance ground leads ($< 2\text{ mm}$).
   - Set termination impedance to $50\ \Omega$ DC coupling for level-shifted I/O, or high-impedance mode ($1\text{ M}\Omega$) when sensing unbuffered folded bitlines ($BL$, $/BL$).

3. **Triggering & Signal Development Transient Acquisition**:
   - Lock hardware triggers to DRAM Wordline assertion or synchronous bus clock edges; acquire continuous deep buffers of $\ge 10^6$ unit intervals (UI).
   - Validate precharge equalization baseline centers at $V_{DD}/2$.
   - Monitor bitline charge sharing transient:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_b + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$
     verifying raw differential swing lands strictly between $100\text{ mV}$ and $150\text{ mV}$.

4. **Eye-Diagram Synthesis & Mask Testing**:
   - Engage Phase-Locked Loop (PLL) Golden Clock Recovery and fold transient transitions across $> 10^6$ UIs into an eye diagram.
   - Position diamond/hexagonal inner keep-out mask centered at $V_{DD}/2$.
   - Run automated mask testing across all acquired cycles to verify zero violations at target bit-error-rate thresholds.

5. **Dual-Dirac Jitter Decomposition**:
   - Measure Time Interval Error (TIE) jitter across all rising/falling threshold crossings.
   - Decompose total jitter using the Dual-Dirac model at $\text{BER} = 10^{-12}$:
     $$TJ = DJ + 2 \cdot Q(10^{-12}) \cdot RJ_{rms} = DJ + 14.069 \cdot RJ_{rms}$$
   - Quantify Deterministic Jitter ($DJ$) subcomponents: Intersymbol Interference ($ISI$), Duty Cycle Distortion ($DCD$), and Periodic Jitter ($PJ$).

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                         ┌─────────────────────────────┐
                         │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░              │
   Target Eye Height (mV)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░              │
                         │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
Bitline Parasitic Cb (fF)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
     Storage Node Cs (fF)┤▓▓▓▓▓                        │
                         │▓▓▓▓▓                        │
  Sense Diff Delta V (mV)┤███████████████████          │
                         │███████████████████          │
                         └┬──────┬──────┬──────┬──────┬┘
                          0     50     100    150   200 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Nominal Target | Machine-Measurable Acceptance Range | Unit | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Differential Signal Swing ($\Delta V$)** | $125\text{ mV}$ | **$100\text{ mV} \le \Delta V \le 150\text{ mV}$** | $\text{mV}$ | Real-time differential voltage at sense amp latch activation |
| **Eye Opening Height ($V_{eye}$)** | $\ge 100\text{ mV}$ | **$\ge 100\text{ mV}$** at $\text{BER} = 10^{-12}$ | $\text{mV}$ | Vertical eye opening height at 50% UI horizontal eye center |
| **Total Jitter ($TJ$) / Eye Width** | $TJ \le 0.30\text{ UI}$ | **Eye Width $\ge 0.70\text{ UI}$** ($TJ \le 0.30\text{ UI}$ at $\text{BER} = 10^{-12}$) | $\text{UI}$ | Dual-Dirac decomposition ($DJ + 14.069 \cdot RJ_{rms}$) |
| **Precharge Differential Offset** | $0\text{ mV}$ | **$|V_{BL} - V_{/BL}| \le 5\text{ mV}$** | $\text{mV}$ | Mean differential DC voltage across $V_{DD}/2$ precharge phase |

---

### Literature Citations & Physical Constraints

1. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - Access transistor geometry: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Storage node capacitor budget: $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$ (stacked ONO / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$\kappa$, $\kappa > 15$).
   - Cell leakage limit: $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
2. **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**:
   - Folded bitline $8F^2$ footprint (cell area $= 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$) providing common-mode noise rejection.
   - Storage node capacitance: $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ (nominal $28\text{ fF}$).
   - Bitline parasitic capacitance: $C_b = 150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$ (blocks of 256/512 cells).
   - Capacitance ratio constraint: $C_b / C_s$ bounded between $5:1$ and $9:1$ ($< 10:1$ to preserve signal margin).
3. **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
   - CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch between complementary bitlines $BL$ and $/BL$.
   - Bitlines precharged/equalized to $V_{DD}/2$.
   - Charge development equation yields $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$ for $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_b = 250\text{ fF}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Procuring a high-bandwidth real-time oscilloscope (minimum 4 GHz analog bandwidth, >= 20 GSa/s real-time sample rate) is critical to capturing fifth-harmonic components of 180nm DRAM Gen 2 level-shifter transceivers (switching edges < 350 ps). However, without matching low-capacitance active differential probe heads (< 0.3 pF parasitic loading, >= 4 GHz), probe-tip boundary capacitance will artificially roll off transition times, skew deterministic jitter decomposition (TJ/DJ/RJ), and corrupt the closed-loop ESP32 motor controller address/command bus validation.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At Gen 2 (micron/sub-micron scale test interfaces), eye-diagram masks must clearly distinguish between inter-symbol interference (ISI) induced by PCB microstrip dispersion and intrinsic CMOS level-shifter propagation delay jitter. High-speed passive Z0 probes load 50-Ohm controlled-impedance lines severely (DC 500-Ohm loading attenuation), perturbing the termination network. An active probe system with automated de-embedding capability (using S-parameters measured via VNA) is mandatory to eliminate cable and connector loss from the true eye opening.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Real-time oscilloscopes in the 4 GHz to 8 GHz class (e.g., Keysight Infiniium, Rohde & Schwarz RTO, or Tektronix 5/6 Series) and calibrated active single-ended/differential probe amplifiers face long lead times (> 14 weeks) and high capex. Procurement must ensure bundled jitter analysis software licenses (e.g., D9010JITA / DPOJET) and manufacturer calibration certificates (NIST/ISO 17025) are explicitly included in the purchase requisition to prevent uncalibrated downtime.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Procurement of this metrology unit gates Milestone 1.3 PCB Bring-up signoff. If lead time slips beyond schedule boundaries, the program cannot validate 180nm DRAM command/address bus margins before tapeout package commitment. A secondary contingency must secure a certified rental unit or university lab access for the interim window.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Probe-tip capacitive loading (> 0.5 pF) degrading measured signal slew rate by > 30%, falsely triggering eye mask violation.
1. Improper ground-loop lead length (> 2 mm) introducing high-frequency inductive peaking, ringing, and artificial periodic jitter (PJ).
1. Thermal drift in uncalibrated real-time scope ADCs during multi-hour stress testing causing vertical baseline drift and corrupted random jitter (RJ) Gaussian tail fitting.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-PCB-1-3-3-01` | **Level-Shifter Output Eye-Diagram Opening and Mask Compliance Test** | 4 GHz Real-Time Oscilloscope (>= 20 GSa/s, 10-bit ADC), 4 GHz Active Differential Probe (< 0.3 pF, 50 kOhm DC resistance), PRBS7 Generator from ESP32 Test Firmware. | 1. Solder high-bandwidth differential probe tip directly across receiver termination pads of the level shifter bus (CMD line). 2. Inject continuous PRBS7 pattern at 200 Mbps from ESP32 master. 3. Acquire 1,000,000 continuous UI (unit intervals) on oscilloscope using hardware clock recovery (PLL loop BW = 1.5 MHz). 4. Apply standard rectangular eye mask (inner horizontal eye width = 0.65 UI, vertical eye height = 1.2 V). 5. Compute total mask violations and extract eye height and width. | `Total eye mask violations = 0 hits over 10^6 UI; Eye Height >= 1.35 V (at 1.8V logic domain); Eye Width >= 0.72 UI (>= 3.60 ns at 200 Mbps).` |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-PCB-1-3-3-02` | **Total Jitter (TJ) Decomposition and Random Jitter (RJ/DJ) Extraction** | 4 GHz Real-Time Oscilloscope with Jitter Decomposition Engine, 4 GHz Active Probe, Low-Jitter External Clock Reference Source. | 1. Connect active probe to DRAM clock distribution line (CLK/CLK#) on level shifter PCB. 2. Capture a single contiguous acquisition waveform containing >= 2,000,000 edges. 3. Run dual-Dirac jitter separation algorithm to decompose Total Jitter (TJ at BER 10^-12) into Random Jitter (RJ rms) and Deterministic Jitter (DJ delta-delta). 4. Record RJ, DJ, and Periodic Jitter (PJ) spectrum peaks. | `RJ (rms) <= 4.5 ps; DJ (delta-delta) <= 35.0 ps; Total Jitter TJ (BER 10^-12) <= 98.0 ps.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ESD-safe conductive lab coat (surface resistivity 10^6 - 10^9 ohms/sq), ESD wrist strap connected to common ground through 1 MOhm resistor, Cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, Class 100/ISO 5 compatible), ANSI Z87.1 approved safety glasses with side shields
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact: Flush immediately with clean eyewash water for 15 minutes. Inhalation: Move personnel to fresh air. Skin contact: Wash area with mild soap and water. Electrical shock: Cut main power breaker before approaching victim; apply CPR if unresponsive and notify lab emergency team.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard electronics lab benchtop snorkel exhaust (minimum 100 LFM face velocity) active during probe-tip solvent degreasing and micro-soldering.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispose of solvent-soaked lint-free wipes in dedicated yellow flammable waste bin with airtight foot pedal lid; hazardous chemical collection in accordance with local environmental regulations.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic / Semi Grade (VLSI) | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly reflowed Level Shifter Daughtercard PCB with flux residues cleaned using semi-grade IPA; test pads free of surface oxidation (ENIG finish intact).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Inspection-completed PCB with de-soldered probe pigtails, test points cleaned with zero particulate contamination, and sealed in static-shielding dry bags.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Atmospheric copper/nickel-immersion-gold boundary oxidation and ambient particulate/ionic contamination increasing probe contact resistance and RF reflection coefficient.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Procured and calibrated high-bandwidth real-time oscilloscope metrology station successfully deployed, de-embedded, and verified against high-speed 50-Ohm level-shifter daughtercard bus with zero mask violations and sub-100ps total jitter at BER 10^-12.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `SCOPE_EYE_DIAGRAM_REPORT_REV1.pdf`
- [ ] `JITTER_DECOMPOSITION_RAW_DATA_1MUI.csv`
- [ ] `PROBE_DEEMBED_TOUCHSTONE_SPARAM.s2p`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Real-time eye height opening under full 1.8V switching amplitude across 10^6 UI** | `1.42 V` | +/- 0.05 V | Oscilloscope automated eye-diagram amplitude histogram slice at 50% UI |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Clock bus Total Jitter (TJ) extrapolated at BER 10^-12** | `85.0 ps` | <= 98.0 ps | Dual-Dirac model fitting algorithm on real-time acquisition engine |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Probe-induced bandwidth attenuation at fundamental bus frequency (100 MHz)** | `0.15 dB` | <= 0.30 dB | VNA S21 insertion loss comparison with and without active probe attached |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Formal signoff requires an ISO 17025 factory calibration certificate for the oscilloscope and probe amplifier, zero mask violations over 1,000,000 continuous UI on all critical DRAM bus lines, and co-signatures from Systems Engineer and Domain Expert on the final SI report.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): High-Speed Level Shifter IC & Low-Loss Substrate Material Procurement

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > ESP32 Closed-Loop Motor Controller [Electronics & Firmware] > Signal Integrity & Level Shifter Daughtercard PCB (50-Ohm Controlled Impedance Microstrips) [PCB & Hardware] > High-Speed Level Shifter IC & Low-Loss Substrate Material Procurement [Packaging]
**Target Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type**: Buy

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: DI Water: 18.2 MΩ·cm, Particle Count < 5 / wafer.
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using 4-Point Probe / Ellipsometer / Fume Hood Interlock.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Procuring ultra-fast level shifters (e.g., Texas Instruments TXU0104/SN74AXC4T774 or discrete high-speed transceivers) alongside hydrocarbon ceramic/PTFE laminates (such as Rogers RO4350B or Panasonic Megtron 6) must strictly guarantee skew matching under 150 ps across all bidirectional command/data buses between 3.3V ESP32 GPIOs and 1.8V 180nm DRAM test pads. Slew rate mismatch and trace propagation delay variance across dielectric thickness tolerances can completely collapse the DRAM read/write setup and hold windows at 50-100 MHz clock speeds.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Controlled-impedance 50-ohm microstrip design on high-frequency laminates requires rigorous copper surface roughness considerations (standard ED copper vs. reverse-treated VLP copper) and stable dielectric constant (Dk = 3.48-3.66, Df <= 0.0037). Furthermore, if daughtercard wire bonding or spring-pin socketing interfaces with the 180nm DRAM die, the ENIG/ENEPIG plating thickness must be tightly constrained (electroless nickel 3-6 um, immersion gold 0.05-0.1 um) to prevent hyper-corrosion / 'black pad' defects and ensure wedge-bonding pull strength >= 4.0 gf.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Specialty RF/high-speed laminates (Rogers RO4000 series, Megtron 6 core + prepreg) and sub-1.0V/3.3V dual-supply level translators face lead-time volatility and MOQ constraints in regional domestic PCB fabs in Vietnam. Procurement must lock down dual-source equivalents (e.g., Shengyi S7439 / Isola FR408HR as qualified fallbacks) and secure certified distributor reels with verified C-of-C (Certificate of Conformance) to prevent counterfeit ICs and obsolete lot codes.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Budget and schedule gating require incoming material acceptance within 5 business days of receiving lamination panels and active IC batches. Failure to validate Dk/Df material test coupons and IC prop delay characteristics before committing to full daughtercard panelization will delay the Gen 2 closed-loop DRAM integration milestone by at least 4 weeks.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Propagation delay dispersion and output skew exceeding 250 ps across level shifter channels, causing severe data-strobe misalignment and DRAM setup/hold violations.
1. Delamination or impedance discontinuity exceeding +/-10% (out of target 50-ohm spec) due to moisture absorption or resin starvation during low-loss core/prepreg hot pressing.
1. Black pad formation or brittle gold-aluminum intermetallic failure at ENIG/ENEPIG interfaces during wedge/ball wire bonding or board-level surface mount.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-PCB-2-01` | **Level Shifter Dynamic Propagation Delay & Inter-Channel Skew Verification** | Keysight Infiniium 4-channel 4 GHz Oscilloscope (>= 20 GSa/s), Picosecond Pulse Generator (rise time <= 100 ps, 50-ohm output), Active High-Z Differential Probes (1 GHz BW, <= 1 pF capacitance), Keithley 2231A Triple-Output DC Power Supply. | 1. Inject a 50 MHz square wave with 10% to 90% rise time <= 500 ps into Input Channel 1 at 3.3V logic levels. 2. Concurrently split and inject the identical signal into Channels 2, 3, and 4. 3. Measure propagation delay (t_PLH and t_PHL) at the 50% voltage crossover between input (1.65V) and 1.8V output (0.90V) across 10,000 consecutive acquisition cycles. 4. Compute channel-to-channel output skew: t_skew = max(t_pd) - min(t_pd) across all 4 channels. | `Propagation delay t_pd <= 2.8 ns across all channels; inter-channel output skew t_skew <= 150 ps; output rise/fall time (20%-80%) <= 1.2 ns. Numerical failure recorded if any parameter exceeds these thresholds.` |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-PCB-2-02` | **Substrate Dielectric Constant (Dk), Loss Tangent (Df), and 50-Ohm TDR Impedance Test** | Keysight E5080B Vector Network Analyzer (VNA) up to 20 GHz, Keysight 86100D DCA Wide-Bandwidth Oscilloscope with TDR Module (18 ps system rise time), Micro-Coax GSG (Ground-Signal-Ground) 500 um pitch microprobes, SPDR (Split Post Dielectric Resonator) cavity fixture (10 GHz). | 1. Insert unclad substrate sample into the 10 GHz SPDR cavity and record resonant frequency shift and Q-factor to calculate Dk and Df. 2. Connect TDR module via GSG microprobe to the 100 mm microstrip coupon. 3. Calibrate TDR using standard open, short, and 50-ohm reference loads at the probe tip. 4. Launch 20 ps rise-time step pulse into the coupon trace and acquire characteristic impedance profile Z_0 along the entire 100 mm line length. | `Measured Dk at 10 GHz must be 3.48 +/- 0.05; loss tangent Df <= 0.0037; characteristic microstrip impedance Z_0 must be strictly within 50.0 +/- 2.5 ohms (5%) over the center 80% span of the transmission line.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical splash safety goggles, Nitrile chemical-resistant gloves (thickness >= 6 mil), ESD-safe dissipative lab coat, Half-mask respirator with organic vapor/P100 particulate cartridge during solvent coupon cleaning and lamination routing
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin exposure: Flush thoroughly with running water for at least 15 minutes while removing contaminated clothing. Eye contact: Irrigate eyes immediately at eyewash station with saline or clean water for >= 15 minutes holding eyelids open; seek ophthalmic medical evaluation. Inhalation: Relocate individual immediately to fresh air; administer oxygen if respiration is laboured.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: All solvent wiping, coupon degreasing, and reflow soldering operations must take place inside a ducted chemical fume hood or localized solder fume extraction canopy providing face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 FPM). Dry routing and dicing of ceramic/hydrocarbon laminate must be performed under dedicated HEPA-filtered dust extraction.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent IPA and solvent wipes in grounded, airtight UN-approved flammable liquid drums. Solid solder dross and solder paste wipes must be segregated into sealed hazardous heavy-metal containment pails labeled for licensed EPA/RoHS recycling disposal. Do not discharge solvents into municipal sanitary drainage.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (VLSI) | `>= 99.8% w/w` |
| **Lead-Free Solder Paste (Sn96.5/Ag3.0/Cu0.5 alloy with modified rosin flux)** | `7440-31-5` | IPC J-STD-006 Grade | `88.5% metal loading in flux carrier` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `480 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `720 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Vacuum-sealed moisture barrier bags (MBB) containing desiccants and 10% humidity indicator cards (HIC); ENIG/ENEPIG pads free of tarnish, oxidation, or organic residues.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Pre-baked, degreased, dry nitrogen purged coupons/substrates (moisture content < 0.05% weight), packaged in ESD-safe cleanroom bags backfilled with 99.999% N2.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture absorption causing explosive delamination ('popcorning') during reflow soldering at 245-260°C, and surface oxidation of immersion gold/nickel layers degrading solderability and wire bond shear strength below Mil-Std-883 standards.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full procurement qualification and incoming physical verification of high-speed dual-supply level shifter ICs and low-loss hydrocarbon ceramic daughtercard laminates, ensuring tight propagation skew and controlled 50-ohm impedance required for 180nm DRAM Gen 2 high-frequency test fixtures.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
