# Standard Operating Procedure: Microstrip TDR Impedance Metrology & Signal Integrity Eye-Diagram Validation

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 2 (µm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Microstrip characteristic impedance discontinuities at the ESP32 level-shifter interface will induce severe transmission-line reflections, degrading the setup/hold margin of high-speed write clocks and corrupting DRAM command framing if return paths across ground plane splits are unreferenced.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Time-Domain Reflectometry (TDR) measurements require calibrated sub-35ps step rise times and SOLT/TRL de-embedding up to 6 GHz to isolate SMA/microprobe launch parasitics from trace Z0; failing to account for FR4/Rogers hybrid moisture absorption and copper roughness (Ra > 0.6 µm) will skew differential skew and eye-opening metrics.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: High-frequency micro-coaxial RF probes (GSG 500µm pitch) and phase-matched SMA test cables (rated to 18 GHz) exhibit long lead times and high cost in local Vietnamese supply chains; substitute SMA end-launch fixtures require rigorous secondary calibration verification to avoid measurement artifacts.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Schedule slippage risk is critical if PCB fab over-etches or under-etches the 50-ohm controlled impedance traces, requiring iterative respins; clear go/no-go TDR screening must precede populated component assembly to avoid wasting expensive high-speed level shifter ICs.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Characteristic impedance mismatch exceeding ±10% (Z0 outside 45-55 Ohm window) causing excessive ringing and false double-clocking at the level shifter receiver input.
1. SMA launcher ground-loop inductance causing localized high-frequency TDR inductive spikes (>60 Ohm) that mask microstrip distributed capacitance.
1. Excessive dielectric loss tangent (tan delta) and high trace resistance causing eye-height collapse below 150 mV at 50 MHz DRAM clock harmonics.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-PCB-3-01` | **Time-Domain Reflectometry (TDR) Characteristic Impedance Metrology** | Keysight N1055A 50GHz TDR/TDT Module or Tektronix 80E04 TDR Sampling Head mounted in digital sampling oscilloscope with 50-ohm GSG microprobe and SOLT calibration substrate. | 1. Land GSG microprobe tips onto microstrip test coupon launch pads using micro-manipulator under stereo microscope. 2. Inject 200 mV step with 35 ps rise time into the 50-ohm trace. 3. Set horizontal scale to 50 ps/div and acquire reflection profile across coupon length (50 mm). 4. Measure mean trace impedance Z0 in the stabilized plateau region (between 20% and 80% electrical length). | `Mean characteristic impedance Z0 must be 50.0 Ohm ± 3.5 Ohm (46.5 Ohm to 53.5 Ohm); localized discontinuity spikes at transitions must not exceed ±5.0 Ohm (45.0 Ohm to 55.0 Ohm).` |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-PCB-3-02` | **High-Speed Signal Integrity Eye-Diagram and Jitter Validation** | High-bandwidth Real-Time Oscilloscope (>= 4 GHz, >= 20 GSa/s), differential active probe (Keysight InfiniiMax or equivalent), and ESP32 PRBS7 pattern generator outputting 50 MHz clock/data stream via level shifter. | 1. Configure ESP32 to drive continuous PRBS7 test sequence through level shifter into controlled-impedance microstrip. 2. Attach differential probe across 50-ohm load resistor at daughtercard output connector. 3. Accumulate minimum 1,000,000 unit intervals (UI) into oscilloscope persistence memory. 4. Extract eye height, eye width, and total jitter (TJ at BER 10^-12). | `Eye height >= 70% of nominal VDD (>= 2.31 V for 3.3V logic or >= 1.26 V for 1.8V logic); Eye width >= 0.75 UI; Total Jitter (TJ) <= 250 ps pk-pk.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ANSI Z87.1 certified ESD-safe safety glasses with side shields, Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, chemical resistant), ESD-grounded wrist strap (1 Mohm series resistor), Static dissipative lab coat
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of eye contact with IPA, flush eyes immediately with copious clean water for at least 15 minutes at eyewash station. In case of skin exposure, wash thoroughly with soap and water. If vapor inhaled causing dizziness, move subject to fresh air immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Benchtop localized ESD fume extractor with activated carbon filtration during probe/pad solvent swab cleaning; general lab ventilation >= 8 air changes per hour (ACH).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispose of IPA-soaked cleanroom lint-free wipes in dedicated sealed, airtight flammable waste container marked for solvent disposal; no drain disposal permitted.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic / Semi Grade (VLSI) | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched and immersion gold plated (ENIG) or OSP finish, degreased with zero organic residue or flux contaminants.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Pristine, probe-tested microstrip surface free from copper gouges, scrub marks, oxidation, or ionic residue, vacuum-sealed with desiccant.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture adsorption into FR4/dielectric substrate alters relative permittivity (Dk) upwards by 0.2-0.4, causing irreversible downward drift in measured characteristic impedance below 46 Ohm and increasing dielectric dissipation factor (Df).

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full physical TDR impedance trace profiles and dynamic PRBS eye-diagram characterization proving that the daughtercard microstrip lines satisfy strict 50-ohm ±7% transmission line requirements and achieve clean eye openings (>70% height) for reliable DRAM interface control.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `tdr_microstrip_impedance_profile_TC-MCU-COTS-PCB-3-01.csv`
- [ ] `eye_diagram_signal_integrity_report_TC-MCU-COTS-PCB-3-02.pdf`
- [ ] `probed_trace_surface_microscopy_inspection.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Microstrip steady-state characteristic impedance (Z0)** | `50.0 Ohm` | ±3.5 Ohm | Keysight N1055A TDR 35ps step reflection measurement averaged across central 60% of trace coupon. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Dynamic signal integrity eye opening height at 50 MHz** | `2.45 V` | >= 2.31 V (min 70% VDD on 3.3V rail) | High-bandwidth real-time sampling oscilloscope statistical eye analysis over 1e6 cycles. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Total deterministic and random jitter (TJ @ BER 1e-12)** | `180 ps` | <= 250 ps pk-pk | Oscilloscope jitter decomposition module using dual-Dirac model extrapolation. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All tested microstrip channels exhibit characteristic impedance strictly within 46.5 to 53.5 Ohm, eye diagrams show zero mask violations over 1,000,000 unit intervals, and CSV/PDF metrology records are digitally timestamped and signed off by the Lead Hardware Metrology Engineer.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): TDR Calibration Kit & RF Micro-Coaxial Probe Fixture Acquisition

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > ESP32 Closed-Loop Motor Controller [Electronics & Firmware] > Signal Integrity & Level Shifter Daughtercard PCB (50-Ohm Controlled Impedance Microstrips) [PCB & Hardware] > Microstrip TDR Impedance Metrology & Signal Integrity Eye-Diagram Validation [Metrology] > TDR Calibration Kit & RF Micro-Coaxial Probe Fixture Acquisition [Metrology]
**Target Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type**: Buy

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: DI Water: 18.2 MΩ·cm, Particle Count < 5 / wafer.
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using 4-Point Probe / Ellipsometer / Fume Hood Interlock.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The TDR calibration substrate and RF micro-coaxial probe fixture interface directly into the 50-Ohm controlled impedance microstrips of the level shifter daughtercard. Without a high-bandwidth Open-Short-Load (OSL) calibration fixture matching probe pitch (0.5 mm to 1.0 mm GSG), parasitic tip inductance (>0.8 nH) will blur the TDR step response, masking localized impedance discontinuities and trace mismatch between the ESP32 high-speed GPIO and DRAM bus interface.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Gen 2 microstrip characterization requires sub-picosecond rise times (Tr <= 35 ps) to accurately resolve microstrip discontinuities down to millimeter lengths. Purchasing a commercial GSG probe fixture and precision calibration substrate must ensure planar contact repeatability across gold-plated test coupon pads, avoiding copper oxidation or contact resistance spikes (>50 mOhm) that distort reflection coefficient rho and characteristic impedance calculations.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Precision microwave coaxial probe fixtures (e.g., GGB Picoprobe or FormFactor ACP series) and matched alumina calibration substrates have lead times exceeding 8 to 14 weeks and require export control compliance. Sourcing high-frequency SMA/2.92mm interconnects, torque wrenches, and replacement tungsten-rhenium or beryllium-copper tips must be dual-sourced via regional RF distributors to avoid project stalling.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Acquisition cost for micro-coaxial probe arms, articulated positioners, and NIST-traceable calibration kits can consume over 35% of the metrology hardware budget. Delivery and acceptance testing must strictly align with the arrival of the bare daughtercard PCB fab batch to prevent unverified PCB lots from lingering uncharacterized in inventory.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Probe tip deformation or pitch misalignment causing asymmetric ground-signal contact, introducing capacitive dip artifacts in TDR reflection signatures.
1. Contamination or abrasive wear on the precision calibration substrate gold pads, invalidating reference 50-Ohm calibration and shifting system impedance baseline.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-PCB-3-1-01` | **OSL Calibration Verification and System Baseline Noise Floor Test** | Sampling Oscilloscope with TDR Head (>=20 GHz bandwidth, <=35 ps incident step rise time), Precision 50-Ohm Coaxial Airline / Calibration Substrate, Calibrated Torque Wrench (8 in-lb). | 1. Connect precision 2.92mm RF cables to TDR sampling channels torqued to 8 in-lb. 2. Mount GSG probe to micro-positioner and execute full Open-Short-Load (OSL) calibration on the alumina calibration substrate. 3. Engage probe tips onto the substrate 50-Ohm precision termination pad using 50 um overtravel. 4. Record baseline characteristic impedance profile across a 10 ns window. | `Measured characteristic impedance on 50-Ohm load must be 50.0 Ohm +/- 0.5 Ohm across the full 10 ns window; residual peak-to-peak baseline noise ripple must not exceed +/- 0.25 Ohm.` |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-PCB-3-1-02` | **RF Micro-Coaxial Probe Fixture Contact Repeatability & Return Loss Verification** | Vector Network Analyzer (VNA) / TDR Scope up to 20 GHz, GSG RF Micro-Coaxial Probe Fixture, Precision Verification Coupon with 50-Ohm Coplanar Waveguide. | 1. Land probe tips onto the 50-Ohm verification line test coupon pads. 2. Record TDR reflection coefficient rho and step response impedance. 3. Retract probe stage by 2 mm and re-land at the exact location for 10 consecutive landing cycles. 4. Compute maximum delta in measured line impedance across cycles. | `Contact impedance repeatability across 10 cycles must exhibit delta Z0 <= 0.35 Ohm; contact resistance per probe tip must remain <= 40 mOhm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ESD-safe nitrile gloves (powder-free), ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with side shields, Static-dissipative cleanroom lab coat
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin contact with cleaning solvent, wash with soap and water. For eye exposure, flush eyes immediately with eyewash station for minimum 15 minutes. Inhalation: Move individual to fresh air. Ingestion: Seek immediate medical attention; do not induce vomiting.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Benchtop localized fume extraction arm or certified laminar flow clean bench equipped with Class 100 HEPA filtration and organic solvent exhaust venting.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used IPA swabs and wipes must be disposed of in a designated, self-closing, FM-approved flammable solvent waste can. No open solvent discharge allowed.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (VLSI / Semiconductor) | `>= 99.8%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `60 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `48 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Factory-sealed hermetic packaging with desiccant; gold-plated contact pads clean, free of organic films or particle contamination.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Solvent-cleaned probe tips and calibration substrate stored in dry nitrogen purge box (<5% RH) to eliminate atmospheric sulfidation/oxidation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Oxidation and organic contamination on calibration pads causing false high-frequency capacitive/inductive mismatch, resulting in faulty TDR de-embedding and distorted PCB impedance profiling.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful procurement, receiving verification, and baseline calibration acceptance of the TDR Calibration Kit and RF Micro-Coaxial GSG Probe Fixture, ensuring metrology readiness for 50-Ohm microstrip impedance validation.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `TDR_Calibration_Kit_NIST_Traceability_Certificate.pdf`
- [ ] `RF_Probe_Fixture_OSL_Baseline_Impedance_Data.csv`
- [ ] `Probe_Tip_Microscopic_Inspection_Report.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Calibrated precision 50-Ohm reference load impedance accuracy across TDR sweep window** | `50.0 Ohm` | +/- 0.5 Ohm | TDR step reflection measurement using 35 ps incident rise time over 10 ns acquisition window |
| `ASSERT-02` | **RF micro-coaxial probe fixture contact landing repeatability variation** | `0.15 Ohm` | <= 0.35 Ohm | 10-cycle land/retract repeatability test on coplanar waveguide verification standard |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researcher exit sign-off granted when all delivery items match mechanical and RF specifications, OSL baseline calibration passes ASSERT-01 and ASSERT-02, and probe fixture is integrated into the metrology station inside the dry nitrogen cabinet.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Microstrip Characteristic Impedance TDR Profiling & Discontinuity Extraction

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 2 (µm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Microstrip line characteristic impedance (Z0) deviations directly impact high-speed signal integrity between the ESP32 closed-loop controller and the DRAM interface, leading to signal reflections, eye closure, and increased bit-error rates (BER) during 180nm DRAM command/address line switching. The metrology loop must de-embed SMA launch discontinuities from the actual microstrip trace impedance.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Time-Domain Reflectometry (TDR) spatial resolution is constrained by the system step pulse rise time (tr <= 35 ps for Gen 2 sub-millimeter discontinuity localization). Using an inadequate sampling oscilloscope bandwidth or neglecting dielectric dispersion in FR4/Rogers hybrid stackups will smear out localized capacitive discontinuities at connector footprints and test pads.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Controlled-impedance coupon test fixtures require high-frequency sub-miniature coaxial launches (e.g., 2.92mm/SMA end-launch connectors) and calibrated air coplanar microprobes; lead times for precision 40 GHz calibration standards (SOLT/TRL) and high-bandwidth RF probes can exceed 10-12 weeks if not secured under vendor consignment.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Impedance profiling must be completed within the Stage 2 gate review without holding up daughtercard surface mount assembly (SMT). Metrology coupons routed on panel breakout rails must be profiled prior to depaneling to avoid edge-stress delamination artifacts.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Launch parasite masking: Inductive SMA transition parasitics exceed 1.2 nH, obscuring upstream microstrip characteristic impedance profile within the first 15 mm of trace length.
1. Etch undercut variation: Copper foil over-etching reduces trace top width W from nominal 180 um to 155 um, causing an uncompensated characteristic impedance surge above 55 Ohms (+10% design ceiling).
1. Moisture absorption dielectric drift: Environmental relative humidity (>60% RH) increases FR4 effective relative permittivity (eps_r), shifting bulk trace Z0 down by >3.5 Ohms post-baking.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-PCB-3-2-01` | **Microstrip Steady-State Characteristic Impedance (Z0) Spatial TDR Profiling** | Sampling Oscilloscope (>= 20 GHz bandwidth) with TDR Step Generator Module (tr <= 35 ps, 200 mV step into 50 Ohm), 50-Ohm semi-rigid coaxial test leads, and high-precision Ground-Signal (GS) microprobe station. | 1. Land GS microprobe on the 50-Ohm microstrip coupon launch pad under microscope alignment. 2. Launch 35 ps step pulse into the line and acquire reflection coefficient rho(t) over a 2.0 ns window with 4096-point resolution. 3. Apply time-to-distance transformation using effective propagation velocity (v_p = c / sqrt(eps_eff)). 4. Gate the waveform to isolate the uniform trace section (10 mm to 40 mm away from launch). 5. Record mean characteristic impedance Z0 and peak-to-peak impedance ripple across the trace window. | `Nominal characteristic impedance Z0 must be 50.0 Ohms +/- 2.5 Ohms (47.5 Ohm <= Z0 <= 52.5 Ohm) across >= 95% of the gated uniform trace length, with peak ripple <= 1.5 Ohms.` |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-PCB-3-2-02` | **Launch Connector & Via Discontinuity Reactance (L_disc, C_disc) Extraction** | TDR / TDT Metrology System (sampling head <= 35 ps incident rise time), precision torque wrench (5 in-lbs for SMA/2.92mm), Vector Network Analyzer / TDR software discontinuity extraction module. | 1. Connect TDR source to daughtercard edge SMA launch. 2. Capture the reflected waveform profile rho(t) across the connector-to-microstrip transition and internal layer-transition via. 3. Integrate the differential reflection coefficient profile over the transition time window delta_t: excess capacitance C_excess = (1 / (2 * Z0)) * integral(rho(t) dt) for capacitive dips, or excess inductance L_excess = (Z0 / 2) * integral(rho(t) dt) for inductive peaks. 4. Extract peak discontinuity impedance excursion delta_Z_peak. | `Launch discontinuity peak reflection |rho_peak| <= 0.05 (equivalent to return loss >= 26 dB up to 5 GHz); extracted excess discontinuity capacitance C_excess <= 180 fF and excess inductance L_excess <= 350 pH.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses with side shields, Class 0 ESD-safe conductive nitrile gloves (surface resistivity 10^6 to 10^8 Ohm/sq), Static-dissipative cleanroom lab coat
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin contact with cleaning solvent, wash thoroughly with soap and copious clean water. For eye contact, flush eyes at emergency eyewash station for minimum 15 minutes holding eyelids open. If inhaled in high concentrations, move victim to fresh air; seek medical attention if irritation persists.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operate probe station and solvent coupon wiping under local benchtop snorkel exhaust with capture velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 fpm), or within a standard ISO Class 7 laminar flow hood.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent solvent-soaked wipes and rinse waste in dedicated, grounded, flame-resistant safety waste cans labeled 'Flammable Solvent Waste - IPA'; dispose via certified industrial hazardous waste contractor.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (VLSI / Semiconductor Grade) | `99.8% min` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `48 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched or post-bake clean PCB coupon, ENIG (Electroless Nickel Immersion Gold) contact pads pristine, free of flux residues and surface oxidation.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: TDR-profiled coupon with microprobe landing marks < 25 um scrub depth, degreased with anhydrous IPA, nitrogen blow-dried, and sealed in anti-static moisture barrier bag (MBB).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture reabsorption into hygroscopic dielectric laminate shifts eps_r by > +0.15, causing a false fail on characteristic impedance (-2.0 Ohm shift) and interfacial oxidation on copper/ENIG contact pads.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full spatial TDR characteristic impedance profile of the daughtercard 50-Ohm microstrip interconnects and quantitative extraction of launch connector/via reactive discontinuities validating signal integrity margins for 180nm DRAM interfacing.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `TDR_Z0_Spatial_Profile_TC_MCU_COTS_PCB_3_2.csv`
- [ ] `Discontinuity_Extraction_L_C_Parameters.pdf`
- [ ] `Probe_Landing_Inspection_Micrographs.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Mean characteristic impedance across uniform microstrip trace length** | `50.0 Ohm` | +/- 2.5 Ohm | Gated time-domain reflectometry spatial averaging from 10 mm to 40 mm along trace |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Peak SMA launch transition excess parasitic inductance** | `280 pH` | <= 350 pH | Time-integral de-embedding of positive TDR reflection peak over connector transition region |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Signal path via discontinuity excess shunt capacitance** | `120 fF` | <= 180 fF | Time-integral de-embedding of negative TDR reflection valley across via transition region |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% of tested coupon lines demonstrate 47.5 Ohm <= Z0 <= 52.5 Ohm across >= 95% of line length, SMA launch return loss verified >= 26 dB (rho <= 0.05), all deliverable artifacts archived, and signoff endorsed by Metrology Lead and Systems Engineer.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): TDR Calibration & Fixture De-embedding Setup

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > ESP32 Closed-Loop Motor Controller [Electronics & Firmware] > Signal Integrity & Level Shifter Daughtercard PCB (50-Ohm Controlled Impedance Microstrips) [PCB & Hardware] > Microstrip TDR Impedance Metrology & Signal Integrity Eye-Diagram Validation [Metrology] > Microstrip Characteristic Impedance TDR Profiling & Discontinuity Extraction [Metrology] > TDR Calibration & Fixture De-embedding Setup [Metrology]
**Target Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type**: Make

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: DI Water: 18.2 MΩ·cm, Particle Count < 5 / wafer.
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using 4-Point Probe / Ellipsometer / Fume Hood Interlock.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Purchasing commercial TDR calibration substrate kits (e.g. Rosenberger or Cascade ACP-series CS-5) and SOLT/2x-Thru de-embedding software artifacts must guarantee an absolute reference plane at the 50-Ohm daughtercard SMA launch pads. The primary architecture risk is assuming connector repeatability: poor mechanical torque repeatability on SMA launches (must be calibrated to 8 in-lbs / 0.9 Nm) will shift phase measurements, introducing fictitious inductive discontinuities into the level-shifter transmission line profile.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For 180nm DRAM signaling driven across microstrips via the ESP32 level-shifter daughtercard, 10-90% risetimes below 150 ps excite high-frequency substrate dispersion. The COTS 2x-Thru or TRL/SOLT fixture de-embedding algorithm must accurately eliminate the PCB SMA launch pad discontinuity (typically 0.3-0.8 pF capacitive dip) down to the DUT boundary. If de-embedding parameters assume ideal 50.0 Ohm lines without extracting copper surface roughness (Ra) and FR4 loss tangent variation, extracted characteristic impedance will report a 3-5 Ohm offset error.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Precision 50-Ohm calibration standards (mechanical SOLT cal kits, precision 3.5mm/SMA female loads rated to 18 GHz with VSWR < 1.05) and phase-matched flexible RF cable assemblies carry substantial lead times (8-12 weeks) and high cost. Sourcing COTS calibration artifacts requires NIST-traceable certificates of conformity (CoC) and guaranteed dimensional stability to avoid uncalibrated drift during high-volume PCB impedance testing in local VN labs.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Procurement of the TDR calibration kit and fixture de-embedding math module is a gatekeeper milestone for validating the signal integrity daughtercard. Failure to have calibrated reference kits on bench will bottleneck high-speed DRAM address/data eye-diagram sign-off. The commercial solution must interface natively with Python/SCPI automation scripts without recurring per-seat proprietary vendor licensing lock-in.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. SMA Launch Pad De-embedding Phase Error: Incorrect electrical delay entry for the 2x-Thru fixture standard leads to over-subtraction of test-fixture capacitance, erroneously masking physical microstrip necking or over-etch defects.
1. Calibration Standard Wear or Center-Pin Recession: Center conductor recession on mechanical 50-Ohm SMA termination standards exceeding 0.000 to -0.003 inches results in intermittent ground contact, corrupting raw TDR step reflection coefficients (Gamma).
1. Torque Wrench Calibration Drift: Over-torquing SMA interconnects past 8 in-lbs damages precision PTFE dielectric interfaces, permanently distorting characteristic impedance at the calibration reference plane.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-PCB-3-2-1-01` | **NIST-Traceable SOLT Reference Plane Calibration Verification** | Keysight/Tektronix High-Bandwidth Sampling TDR Oscilloscope (>=20 GHz, <=35 ps incident rise time), 50-Ohm Precision 3.5mm/SMA SOLT Calibration Kit (Short, Open, 50-Ohm Load, Thru), Calibrated 8 in-lb (0.9 Nm) Break-Over Torque Wrench, Phase-Stable Semi-Rigid Coaxial Cables | 1. Connect phase-stable cable assembly to TDR sampling channel 1. 2. Tighten connections using the 8 in-lb break-over torque wrench. 3. Execute standard SOLT calibration sequence using precision Short, Open, 50-Ohm Load, and Thru standards. 4. Reconnect precision 50-Ohm verification load at the calibrated reference plane. 5. Acquire time-domain reflection profile over a 10 ns window at 4096 points with 16x averaging. 6. Measure baseline reflection coefficient (Gamma) and equivalent characteristic impedance across the 2 ns flatline region. | `Reference plane residual reflection coefficient |Gamma| <= 0.005 (return loss >= 46 dB). Extracted characteristic impedance of the precision load across 2 ns baseline window must be 50.00 Ohm ± 0.25 Ohm.` |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-PCB-3-2-1-02` | **2x-Thru Fixture De-embedding Discontinuity Removal Validation** | TDR Oscilloscope with IEEE 370 compliant 2x-Thru De-embedding Tool / Scikit-RF S-Parameter Engine, Level Shifter Daughtercard Test Coupon featuring 2x-Thru calibration structure and 50-Ohm microstrip DUT line, Calibrated 8 in-lb SMA Torque Wrench | 1. Connect TDR channel to the input of the on-board 2x-Thru fixture coupon. 2. Measure and record S21 insertion loss, S11 return loss, and TDR step response through the 2x-Thru structure. 3. Synthesize the 1x-fixture S-parameter matrix using IEEE 370 2x-Thru de-embedding algorithm. 4. Connect TDR probe to the daughtercard SMA launch connected to the 50-Ohm microstrip DUT. 5. Apply the synthesized 1x-fixture de-embedding S-parameter block to mathematically strip SMA launch parasitics. 6. Extract the residual reflection peak at the launch-to-microstrip junction and the planar microstrip trace impedance. | `De-embedded SMA launch capacitive discontinuity peak must be suppressed to |delta_Z| <= 0.75 Ohm relative to bulk microstrip impedance. Post-de-embedding microstrip characteristic impedance must evaluate within 50.0 Ohm ± 1.0 Ohm across trace length.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom ESD-Safe Nitrile Gloves (Class 100 / ISO 5), ANSI Z87.1 Approved UV-Blocking Safety Glasses, Static-Dissipative Cleanroom Lab Coat with Conductive Wrist Cuff Grounding
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Inhalation: Move exposed researcher to fresh air immediately. Eye Contact: Flush eyes thoroughly with isotonic saline or copious sterile water for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Skin Contact: Wash skin with mild soap and water; remove contaminated apparel. Ingestion: Do not induce vomiting; drink water and seek medical evaluation.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Benchtop localized laminar flow extraction hood (minimum face velocity 100 fpm / 0.5 m/s) dedicated to solvent vapor clearing during connector wipe-down; general metrology lab air changes >= 15 ACH with HEPA filtration.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispose of solvent-soaked lint-free cleanroom wipes in dedicated, grounded, self-closing UL-listed steel flammable rag disposal containers. Spent liquid IPA must be collected in labeled DOT UN-rated HDPE solvent carboys for hazardous chemical waste reclamation.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (VLSI / Semiconductor Grade) | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `60 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly fabricated ENIG (Electroless Nickel Immersion Gold) or Immersion Silver PCB test coupon launch pads, degreased, free of flux residues, fingerprint grease, and particulate contamination.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Cleaned, dry, calibrated SMA/RF launch interface with intact plating, torqued to baseline specifications and sealed with clean anti-static protective connector caps.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Atmospheric moisture absorption into FR4/Megtron-6 substrate causing loss tangent (tan delta) elevation, combined with atmospheric sulfur/oxide growth on unplated launch interfaces resulting in >1.5 Ohm apparent calibration drift and contact resistance degradation.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful procurement, physical verification, and algorithmic deployment of a high-precision TDR calibration and fixture de-embedding setup capable of stripping connector/launch parasitics down to the 50-Ohm microstrip interface on the ESP32 level shifter daughtercard with sub-ohm accuracy.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `tdr_solt_reference_calibration_report.pdf`
- [ ] `deembedded_microstrip_impedance_profile.csv`
- [ ] `fixture_1x_s_parameters_model.s2p`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Calibrated reference plane characteristic impedance baseline accuracy on precision 50-Ohm termination standard** | `50.00 Ohm` | ±0.25 Ohm | TDR flatline step reflection extraction over 2 ns time window post-SOLT calibration |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Residual SMA connector launch parasitic discontinuity following IEEE 370 2x-Thru de-embedding** | `0.00 Ohm` | ±0.75 Ohm | Processed TDR impedance profile delta at transition boundary from connector pad to 50-Ohm microstrip |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Torque repeatability error of calibration standard interconnect interfaces across 10 repeated reconnect cycles** | `0.000 Gamma` | ±0.002 Gamma | TDR S11 reflection magnitude variance measured with 8 in-lb calibrated break-over torque wrench |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researcher exit sign-off requires: (1) Execution of NIST-traceable SOLT reference plane calibration achieving residual Gamma <= 0.005, (2) Extraction and validation of 1x-fixture de-embedding S-parameters matching measured 2x-Thru S21 within 0.1 dB up to 10 GHz, and (3) Automated Python SCPI script generating deembedded_microstrip_impedance_profile.csv verifying 50.0 ± 1.0 Ohm microstrip continuity across all daughtercard level-shifter lines.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Information
- **Title:** Microstrip $Z_0$ Continuous Spatial Profiling & TDR Acquisition
- **Tree Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > ESP32 Closed-Loop Motor Controller [Electronics & Firmware] > Signal Integrity & Level Shifter Daughtercard PCB (50-Ohm Controlled Impedance Microstrips) [PCB & Hardware] > Microstrip TDR Impedance Metrology & Signal Integrity Eye-Diagram Validation [Metrology] > Microstrip Characteristic Impedance TDR Profiling & Discontinuity Extraction [Metrology] > Microstrip $Z_0$ Continuous Spatial Profiling & TDR Acquisition [Metrology]
- **Generation:** Gen 2 ($\mu$m)
- **Action Type:** Make

---

## 1. Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     TDR Instrument     │
│  Warmup & Calibration  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Ground-Signal-Ground  │
│   Microprobe Launch    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Fast Step Injection   │
│       & Waveform       │
│      Acquisition       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Continuous Spatial   │
│       Z0 Profile       │
│      De-embedding      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

### Step 1: Instrument Warmup & Calibration
1. Power on the sampling oscilloscope / TDR mainframe (with ultrafast step generator module, $t_r \le 35\text{ ps}$, $20\text{ GHz}+$ bandwidth) and allow thermal stabilization for at least $30\text{ minutes}$.
2. Perform a precision SOLT (Short-Open-Load-Through) or calibrated open/short/50-$\Omega$ reference calibration at the coaxial reference plane ($2.92\text{ mm}$ / SMA) to establish the time-zero ($t_0$) reflection benchmark and system incident step amplitude ($V_{\text{inc}} = 200\text{ mV}$ to $400\text{ mV}$).

### Step 2: High-Frequency Microprobe Launch Fixturing
1. Mount the PCB under test (Signal Integrity & Level Shifter Daughtercard) on a vibration-isolated metrology vacuum chuck.
2. Align a precision high-frequency Ground-Signal-Ground (GSG) differential or single-ended microprobe (pitch: $500\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ to $1000\text{ }\mu\text{m}$) with the daughtercard test coupons and microstrip launch pads under stereo inspection microscope.
3. Establish coplanar probe contact on the immersion gold/copper pad, verifying probe tip deflection within manufacturer tolerances ($50\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ to $75\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ skate) to eliminate contact inductive spikes.

### Step 3: Fast Step Injection & High-Resolution Waveform Acquisition
1. Inject a high-speed step edge with $10\%\text{--}90\%$ rise time $t_r = 35\text{ ps}$ into the $50\text{ }\Omega$ nominal daughtercard microstrip trace.
2. Set oscilloscope horizontal acquisition window to record both incident and reflected waveforms:
   - Sampling density: $\ge 4096\text{ points}$ over a $5\text{ ns}$ window (sampling interval $\Delta t \le 1.22\text{ ps/pt}$).
   - Averaging mode: 128-sweep to 512-sweep hardware averaging to depress thermal baseline noise below $0.5\text{ mV RMS}$.
3. Record the reflection coefficient $\Gamma(t) = \frac{V_{\text{meas}}(t) - V_{\text{inc}}}{V_{\text{inc}}}$ across the entire coupon length.

### Step 4: Spatial Transformation & Continuous $Z_0(x)$ De-embedding
1. Convert propagation time $t$ to physical spatial distance $x$ along the trace using effective relative permittivity $\varepsilon_{r,\text{eff}}$:
   $$x = \frac{c \cdot (t - t_0)}{2 \sqrt{\varepsilon_{r,\text{eff}}}}$$
   *(factor of 2 accounts for round-trip path length).*
2. Compute the instantaneous characteristic impedance profile:
   $$Z_0(x) = Z_{\text{ref}} \cdot \frac{1 + \Gamma(x)}{1 - \Gamma(x)}$$
   where $Z_{\text{ref}} = 50.0\text{ }\Omega$.
3. Apply dynamic de-convolution algorithm to de-embed multiple reflections from connector launches and localized capacitive dips/inductive bumps along the continuous microstrip.

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                         TDR Metrology Nominal Targets  
                      ┌────────────────────────────────┐
                      │░░░                             │
       TDR Spatial Res┤░░░                             │
                      │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒         │
  TDR Step Tr (10-90%)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒         │
Discontinuity Delta Z0┤▓▓▓▓                            │
                      │▓▓▓▓                            │
    Z0 Continuous Mean┤████████████████████████████████│
                      │████████████████████████████████│
                      └┬───────┬───────┬──────┬───────┬┘
                      0.0    12.5    25.0   37.5   50.0 
```

| Parameter Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Physical Unit | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Mean Characteristic Impedance ($Z_{0,\text{mean}}$)** | $50.0$ | $\pm 2.5$ ($\pm 5\%$) | $\Omega$ | TDR plateau spatial integration over flat trace length |
| **Localized Discontinuity Peak ($\Delta Z_0$)** | $< 4.5$ | $\le 5.0$ max | $\Omega$ | Absolute peak-to-valley excursion at launch via/pad |
| **TDR Incident Step Rise Time ($t_{r, 10-90\%}$)** | $35$ | $\le 40$ | $\text{ps}$ | Calibrated open-circuit reflected edge rise time |
| **Spatial Resolution ($\Delta x_{\text{res}}$)** | $3.5$ | $\le 5.0$ | $\text{mm}$ | In-substrate resolution limit ($\Delta x \approx \frac{c \cdot t_r}{2\sqrt{\varepsilon_{r,\text{eff}}}}$) |

---

## 4. Context Citations & Technical Alignment

1. **[PCB & Hardware Level Shifter Daughtercard Interface]**:
   - The daughtercard routes critical fast control and read/write signal lines to interface high-speed digital controllers (ESP32 / FPGA / ASIC) to 180nm DRAM test fixtures with strictly controlled $50\text{ }\Omega$ microstrip lines to prevent signal reflections and ISI (Inter-Symbol Interference).
2. **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**:
   - High-speed bitline and wordline signal integrity on the host interface directly impacts timing margins when driving and sensing ultra-low capacitance nodes ($C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$, leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$). Trace reflections exceeding $\pm 5\%\text{ }Z_0$ cause ringing that erodes read sensing margins.
3. **[1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets]**:
   - Maintaining high-fidelity $50\text{ }\Omega$ signal integrity at the daughtercard microstrip interface ensures accurate write pulses and clean sensing strobe transitions without inducing parasitic common-mode ground bounce across bitline arrays ($C_b = 150\text{--}250\text{ fF}$, capacitance ratio $C_b/C_s$ maintained between $5:1$ and $9:1$).
4. **[Stage 3 Reality Gate: Discrete Long-Channel MOSFET & CMOS Inverter Verification]**:
   - Drives characterization logic levels ($V_{\text{DS}} = 1.8\text{ V}$, $I_{\text{on}} \ge 500\text{ }\mu\text{A}/\mu\text{m}$, $I_{\text{on}}/I_{\text{off}} > 10^7$) where impedance mismatches on transmission traces produce overshoot/undershoot violating gate oxide breakdown thresholds.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Integration of the ESP32 closed-loop controller with high-speed 180nm DRAM test signals demands strict 50-Ohm matched impedance across the daughtercard. Parasitic inductance from SMA end-launch launch transitions and dielectric loss variations on FR4/Rogers hybrid substrates will induce severe reflections and ringing, degrading edge rates and corrupting DRAM clock/command eye margins unless spatial TDR profiling isolates board discontinuities with sub-millimeter resolution.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Accurate continuous spatial profiling requires a step generator with an incident rise time under 35 ps (equivalent to >10 GHz bandwidth) to resolve discontinuities separated by less than 2.5 mm on typical laminates (Dk ~ 4.2). Furthermore, dielectric dispersion and skin effect along microstrip traces cause a non-uniform impedance profile that must be corrected using dynamic de-embedding and peer calibration substrates (SOLT/TRL) rather than standard static baseline calibration.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Precision 50-Ohm semi-rigid coaxial cables, 2.92mm/SMA calibration standards, and microwave coplanar ground-signal-ground (GSG) microprobes have long procurement lead times and high fragility. The laboratory must maintain validated spare probe tips and calibrated torque wrenches (5 in-lbs / 0.56 N·m) to prevent interface degradation and measurement drift across test campaigns.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Metrology throughput must not bottleneck the fabrication and daughtercard assembly pipeline. Establishing a streamlined, automated TDR acquisition routine with predefined mask limit checking is mandatory to deliver immediate pass/fail feedback for incoming daughtercard batches prior to level shifter chip mounting.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Launch discontinuity masking: Excessive inductive peaking at the coaxial connector-to-microstrip transition obscuring downstream impedance variations along the initial 5 mm of trace.
1. Probe contact degradation: Oxidation or mechanical tip wear on GSG microprobes introducing variable series contact resistance, distorting the measured reflection coefficient (rho) and falsely reporting trace impedance deviations.
1. Substrate moisture absorption: Ambient humidity uptake in hygroscopic PCB prepregs altering local dielectric constant (Dk), causing systematic downward shifts in characteristic impedance (Z0).

Measure secondary reflection at the far-end termination. | `Peak reflection coefficient |rho_peak| at the launch interface must not exceed 0.050 (corresponding to return loss > 26 dB); excess parasitic inductance L_launch must be <= 120 pH.` |

- **Mandatory PPE**: ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses, Static-dissipative ESD lab coat, Powder-free cleanroom-grade nitrile gloves (thickness >= 4 mil), ESD wrist strap with 1 MOhm current-limiting resistor
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of eye contact with IPA, rinse immediately with copious amounts of clean water at an emergency eye wash station for at least 15 minutes. In case of inhalation of solvent vapors, remove victim to fresh air. For high-voltage ESD shock or skin abrasion, disinfect wound and consult occupational first aid.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Benchtop localized fume extraction arm or standard laminar flow bench with volatile organic vapor exhaust (face velocity >= 0.5 m/s) during probe and pad solvent cleaning.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispose of solvent-soaked wipes and swabs in designated airtight hazardous waste flammables containers with self-closing lids in compliance with local environmental regulations; avoid pouring excess solvents into municipal drains.

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `48 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Etched and surface-finished (ENIG/ENEPIG) microstrip test coupon, degreased with anhydrous IPA and dried under clean dry nitrogen, free of flux residue or ionic contamination.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Pristine, probe-inspected microstrip test traces with validated nominal impedance; probe contact marks documented and traces packaged in moisture-barrier anti-static bags with active desiccant.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Extended exposure to ambient humidity promotes moisture uptake into FR4/prepreg cores, altering effective permittivity and skewing TDR impedance readings downward by 1 to 3 Ohms, accompanied by surface oxidation on gold/nickel contacts increasing probe contact resistance.

**Title:** Impedance Discontinuity Extraction & Parasitic LC Modeling  
**Level:** Leaf SOP [Metrology / Signal Integrity]  
**Document Link:** [sop_impedance_discontinuity_extraction.md](./docs/sop_impedance_discontinuity_extraction.md)

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Instrumentation Calibration & Setup:**
   - Configure a sampling oscilloscope / TDR step generator with a step rise time $t_r \le 35\ \text{ps}$ ($10\%$ to $90\%$).
   - Perform an Open-Short-Load (OSLT) calibration at the precision coaxial launch/probe reference plane ($Z_{\text{ref}} = 50.0\ \Omega$).
   - Set the acquisition time window to $T_{\text{window}} \ge 2\tau_{\text{prop}} + 5\ \text{ns}$ with sampling resolution $\Delta t \le 1.0\ \text{ps}$.
2. **Spatial Characteristic Impedance ($Z_0$) Profiling:**
   - Probe the daughtercard $50\ \Omega$ microstrip line and record the reflection profile:
     $$\rho(t) = \frac{V_{\text{refl}}(t) - V_{\text{incident}}}{V_{\text{incident}}}$$
   - Calculate instantaneous impedance:
     $$Z(t) = Z_{\text{ref}} \cdot \frac{1 + \rho(t)}{1 - \rho(t)}$$
   - Transform time to distance $x = \frac{c \cdot t}{2\sqrt{\varepsilon_{\text{eff}}}}$ and confirm the uniform trace matches $50.0\ \Omega \pm 2.5\ \Omega$ ($\pm 5\%$).
3. **Discontinuity Windowing & Excess Reactance Extraction:**
   - Define a gated time window $[t_1, t_2]$ isolating the localized anomaly (via, level-shifter landing pad, or launch transition).
   - **Capacitive Discontinuity ($\Delta \rho(t) < 0$):**
     $$C_{\text{excess}} = -\frac{1}{2 Z_0} \int_{t_1}^{t_2} \Delta \rho(t) \, dt$$
   - **Inductive Discontinuity ($\Delta \rho(t) > 0$):**
     $$L_{\text{excess}} = \frac{Z_0}{2} \int_{t_1}^{t_2} \Delta \rho(t) \, dt$$
4. **SPICE Lumped Model Synthesis & Validation:**
   - Synthesize a $\Pi$-network ($C_{\text{pad1}} - L_{\text{via}} - C_{\text{pad2}}$) or T-network ($L_{\text{lead1}} - C_{\text{pad}} - L_{\text{lead2}}$) subcircuit.
   - Run transient SPICE simulation driven by the identical $35\ \text{ps}$ step and correlate with the acquired raw TDR waveform.

---


| **Interface Pad Excess Capacitance ($C_{\text{pad}}$)** | $\le 0.45$ | $0.10 - 0.45$ | $\text{pF}$ | Gated $\Delta \rho$ time integration |
| **Signal Via Excess Inductance ($L_{\text{via}}$)** | $\le 0.60$ | $0.20 - 0.60$ | $\text{nH}$ | Gated $\Delta \rho$ time integration |

---

### 4. Verified Context Literature Citations

- **Source: 1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**: Guided the parasitic limits. Bitline parasitic capacitance is bounded to $C_b = 150 - 250\ \text{fF}$ across 256/512 cell array blocks, with nominal cell storage node capacitance $C_s \ge 25 - 30\ \text{fF}$ (nominally $28\ \text{fF}$). Fixture pad excess capacitance ($C_{\text{pad}}$) must be precisely modeled and isolated so external metrology does not corrupt bitline sensing timing margins.
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Referenced for 180nm channel length ($L = 180\ \text{nm}$, $W = 220\ \text{nm}$) and stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture.
- **Source: Transmission Line Measurement (TLM) for Specific Contact Resistivity**: Referenced for extraction of series resistance, sheet resistance ($R_s$), and contact interface parasitics.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Extracting LC parasitics directly from TDR waveforms without deconvolving the SMA launch connector and probe contact resistance creates severe systematic overestimation of excess pad capacitance (C_pad) and via series inductance (L_via). The level shifter interface demands sub-50ps jitter at the 180nm DRAM test fixture boundary; an uncompensated 1.2 pF discontinuity translates to over 140 ps of rise-time degradation, collapsing the eye margin for address/command lines driving the closed-loop motor controller registers.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Lumped element LC approximations are only valid when the physical discontinuity electrical length is less than 1/10th of the signal Nyquist wavelength. At 20 GHz TDR bandwidth (17.5 ps step rise time), microstrip solder pads (500 um x 300 um) exhibit distributed transmission line behavior rather than pure capacitive excess. Using TLM-style linear resistance de-embedding and true time-domain integral extraction (Z0 * Delta t * Delta rho) is mandatory to separate skin-effect trace resistance from excess inductive dips.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Precision 50-Ohm calibration substrates (such as CS-5 or ACP40-GSG calibration tiles) and high-bandwidth precision RF microprobes (2.92mm/K-connector compatible) have 16-to-24-week procurement lead times with export control classifications. If probe tips are damaged due to over-travel on the daughtercard test coupons during repeated probing, metrology throughput completely halts without local stock of replacement beryllium-copper tips.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Stage 2 Reality Gate sign-off requires unambiguous correlation between SPICE netlist parasitic LC values and the measured physical microstrip discontinuities before tape-out sign-off. If the metrology team delivers non-standardized raw TDR curves instead of automated Touchstone S2P and SPICE .subckt extractions, downstream firmware integration for the ESP32 motor controller PCB cannot close timing on schedule.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Launch Pad Capacitive Excess Peaking: Unmitigated ground-plane copper directly beneath surface-mount SMA connector pads causing a local impedance drop below 42 Ohms, inducing multiple reflection ringing that masks downstream level-shifter transmission line faults.
1. Probe Contact Over-Travel Oxidation Wear: Repeated probing breaking through ENIG/immersion gold plating down to nickel-phosphorus underlayer, resulting in variable contact resistance that corrupts the rho(t) integral and falsely inflates extracted series inductance L_excess by >40%.

Lower GSG microprobe tips onto the 150 um pitch landing pads of the microstrip test structure under 20x microscope inspection with 50 um over-travel. 2. Acquire reflected step response rho(t) over a 2.0 ns window with 4096 points and 16x hardware averaging. 3. Locate the level-shifter input pad discontinuity region between spatial markers X1 (pad entry) and X2 (pad exit). 4. Calculate instantaneous impedance profile Z(t) = Z0 * (1 + rho(t)) / (1 - rho(t)). 5. critics.systems_engineer: Extracting LC parasitics directly from TDR waveforms without deconvolving the SMA launch connector and probe contact resistance creates severe systematic overestimation of excess pad capacitance (C_pad) and via series inductance (L_via). The level shifter interface demands sub-50ps jitter at the 180nm DRAM test fixture boundary; an uncompensated 1.2 pF discontinuity translates to over 140 ps of rise-time degradation, collapsing the eye margin for address/command lines driving the closed-loop motor controller registers.
critics.domain_expert: Lumped element LC approximations are only valid when the physical discontinuity electrical length is less than 1/10th of the signal Nyquist wavelength. At 20 GHz TDR bandwidth (17.5 ps step rise time), microstrip solder pads (500 um x 300 um) exhibit distributed transmission line behavior rather than pure capacitive excess. Using TLM-style linear resistance de-embedding and true time-domain integral extraction (Z0 * Delta t * Delta rho) is mandatory to separate skin-effect trace resistance from excess inductive dips.
critics.supply_chain: Precision 50-Ohm calibration substrates (such as CS-5 or ACP40-GSG calibration tiles) and high-bandwidth precision RF microprobes (2.92mm/K-connector compatible) have 16-to-24-week procurement lead times with export control classifications. If probe tips are damaged due to over-travel on the daughtercard test coupons during repeated probing, metrology throughput completely halts without local stock of replacement beryllium-copper tips.
critics.laya_pm: Stage 2 Reality Gate sign-off requires unambiguous correlation between SPICE netlist parasitic LC values and the measured physical microstrip discontinuities before tape-out sign-off. If the metrology team delivers non-standardized raw TDR curves instead of automated Touchstone S2P and SPICE .subckt extractions, downstream firmware integration for the ESP32 motor controller PCB cannot close timing on schedule.
critical_failure_modes: Launch Pad Capacitive Excess Peaking: Unmitigated ground-plane copper directly beneath surface-mount SMA connector pads causing a local impedance drop below 42 Ohms, inducing multiple reflection ringing that masks downstream level-shifter transmission line faults.

Probe Contact Over-Travel Oxidation Wear: Repeated probing breaking through ENIG/immersion gold plating down to nickel-phosphorus underlayer, resulting in variable contact resistance that corrupts the rho(t) integral and falsely inflates extracted series inductance L_excess by >40%.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure: High-Speed Eye-Diagram Signal Integrity & Jitter Margin Verification

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 2 (µm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The eye-diagram metrology setup must de-embed parasitic inductance and capacitance from SMA edge-launch connectors and high-impedance active probe loading; failure to perform S-parameter de-embedding will artificially collapse eye height and overestimate deterministic jitter (DJ) on the 50-ohm level-shifter lines interfacing the ESP32 and DRAM wordline/bitline driver stages.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm node interface transition rates (sub-nanosecond rise times t_r < 800 ps), microstrip surface roughness, FR4 dielectric dispersion (tan delta variation across 100 MHz to 2.5 GHz), and ground return-path discontinuities will induce substantial inter-symbol interference (ISI) and data-dependent jitter (DDJ); the PRBS-7 and PRBS-15 test patterns must be run long enough to achieve a Bit Error Rate (BER) confidence level of 10^-12.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Real-time oscilloscopes with >4 GHz analog bandwidth, differential active probes, and low-loss phase-matched coaxial cable pairs have severe lead-time constraints and rental overhead in Vietnam; calibration kits (SOLT/TRL) must be shared with the RF metrology cell, necessitating strict scheduled equipment-slot allocation.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Signal integrity characterization cannot gate the fabrication of the daughtercard batch if basic TDR baseline impedance is within 50 ± 5 ohms; eye-diagram jitter margin sign-off must be completed within a 36-hour testing window to prevent downstream ESP32 closed-loop motor stage integration stalls.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Probe-tip ground lead inductance resonance causing false ringing, waveform distortion, and apparent eye-mask violation.
1. Impedance mismatch at the daughtercard edge connector generating reflections that superimpose onto the eye transition threshold, degrading total jitter (TJ@BER=10^-12) beyond 120 ps.
1. Thermal drift in level-shifter IC output drivers causing propagation delay dispersion and asymmetrical rise/fall times, collapsing vertical eye opening.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-PCB-3-3-01` | **Eye Height and Eye Width Verification under PRBS-7 Stress Pattern** | Keysight/Tektronix 4-Channel 4 GHz Digital Storage Oscilloscope (DSO), 50-ohm input termination, two 4 GHz Differential Active Probes (attenuation 10:1, C_in < 0.3 pF), Signal Generator outputting PRBS-7 data stream at 200 Mbps (3.3V to 1.8V levels). | 1. Solder 50-ohm micro-coaxial pigtails to level-shifter transmitter test points (TX_DATA, TX_CLK). 2. Inject 200 Mbps PRBS-7 sequence through the microstrip transmission line into 50-ohm receiver load. 3. Acquire 1,000,000 continuous Unit Intervals (UI) using eye-diagram acquisition mode with CDR (Clock Data Recovery) PLL loop bandwidth set to 1.5 MHz. 4. Measure inner eye height at mid-UI (50% phase point) and horizontal eye width at 50% voltage threshold. | `Eye Height >= 1.44 V for 1.8V nominal level (>= 80% open); Eye Width >= 4.2 ns for 5.0 ns UI (>= 84% UI); zero mask violations against custom DRAM 180nm interface keep-out mask over 10^6 captured bits.` |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-PCB-3-3-02` | **Total Jitter (TJ), Random Jitter (RJ), and Deterministic Jitter (DJ) Decomposition at BER 10^-12** | 4 GHz Real-Time Oscilloscope with Jitter Analysis Software Package (Dual-Dirac model decomposition), low-jitter external reference clock (< 1 ps RMS jitter). | 1. Connect active probe across differential test pads at the receiver end of the 50-ohm level shifter line. 2. Capture Time Interval Error (TIE) jitter spectrum across a minimum sample depth of 20 Mpts. 3. Run jitter separation algorithm using Dual-Dirac spectral and tail-fit methods to isolate Random Jitter (RJ_rms) and Deterministic Jitter (DJ_pp). 4. Calculate Total Jitter TJ = DJ_pp + 14.069 * RJ_rms at BER = 10^-12. | `Total Jitter TJ(BER=10^-12) <= 150 ps; Random Jitter RJ_rms <= 6.0 ps; Deterministic Jitter DJ_pp <= 65 ps.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses, ESD-safe conductive wrist strap and heel grounders (1 Megohm series resistor), Nitrile gloves (thickness >= 4 mil) for handling clean PCB assemblies and solvent wipes
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin or eye contact with IPA or flux residue: Flush eyes immediately with copious clean water from eyewash station for >= 15 minutes. In case of inhalation of solvent or soldering flux fumes, move personnel to fresh air immediately. For thermal burns from soldering iron, immerse affected area in cool running water for 10 minutes.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Benchtop localized solder fume extractor with activated carbon and HEPA filtration (face velocity >= 0.5 m/s); general ESD metrology bench ventilation maintaining 6 to 10 air changes per hour (ACH).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent solvent cleaning wipes soaked with IPA must be collected in closed, airtight, dedicated flammable-waste cans; hazardous waste collected by certified chemical disposal handler in accordance with local environmental regulations.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor / Electronic Grade (VLSI) | `>= 99.8%` |
| **Lead-Free Solder Rosin Flux Residue (Modified Rosin)** | `65997-06-0` | Technical Grade | `< 5.0% on uncleaned joints` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly reflowed, ultrasonic IPA-cleaned ENIG (Electroless Nickel Immersion Gold) pads and SMA connector pins, free of flux residue (ionic contamination < 1.5 ug/cm^2 NaCl equivalent).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Characterized daughtercard with desoldered pigtails, pads wicked clean of excess solder, surface defluxed and dried, vacuum-sealed with desiccant.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Atmospheric moisture absorption into FR4 core (dielectric constant Er increases from 4.2 to >4.6), causing trace characteristic impedance drop below 47 ohms and increased dielectric loss tangent, invalidating calibrated TDR/eye-diagram baseline models.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full electrical characterization of the 50-ohm controlled impedance microstrip traces on the level-shifter daughtercard under 200 Mbps PRBS-7/15 data streams, validating eye height opening, eye width margin, and total jitter limits to ensure error-free command/address/data transfer between ESP32 controller and 180nm DRAM test fixtures.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `EYE_DIAGRAM_PRBS7_200MBPS_REPORT.pdf`
- [ ] `JITTER_DECOMPOSITION_TJ_DJ_RJ_METRICS.csv`
- [ ] `DE_EMBEDDED_S21_S11_TOUCHSTONE_DATA.s2p`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Vertical Eye Opening (Eye Height) at 50% bit interval under 1.8V IO signaling** | `1.52 V` | +0.15 V / -0.08 V | Real-time oscilloscope statistical eye analysis over 1,000,000 unit intervals |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Total Jitter (TJ) extrapolated at Bit Error Rate 10^-12** | `110 ps` | +30 ps / -25 ps | Dual-Dirac jitter decomposition algorithm on oscilloscope TIE histogram |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Microstrip Characteristic Impedance (Z0) via TDR reflected step-response** | `50.0 ohms` | +/- 2.5 ohms | TDR sampling head reflected voltage calibrated with open/short/load standards |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All tested signal channels exhibit zero keep-out mask violations across 10^6 consecutive UIs, TJ(BER=10^-12) strictly <= 140 ps, characteristic impedance verified at 50 ± 2.5 ohms, and formal sign-off report countersigned by both Systems Engineer and Metrology Lead.
