critics.systems_engineer: Hardware refresh inhibition requires deterministic pause gating synchronously aligned to tRFC and row-cycle boundaries. If the ESP32 timer gating circuit deasserts refresh asynchronously relative to the DRAM internal refresh counter or sense amplifier precharge phases (EQ to VDD/2), mid-cycle bitline charge injection or floating bitline states will cause artificial cell corruption uncorrelated with dielectric leakage. Gating synchronization must employ a dual-stage synchronizer flip-flop clocked by the DRAM master clock domain with worst-case jitter under 50 ps.
critics.domain_expert: At the 180nm node with a 1T1C folded bitline structure, storage node capacitance (Cs) is 25-28 fF and bitline capacitance (Cb) is 150-250 fF, producing a sensing delta V of only 100-150 mV. During intentional refresh inhibit pauses up to 1000 ms for retention Shmoo mapping, subthreshold leakage of the access NMOS and junction leakage across the storage diffusion node will discharge Cs below the sense amplifier latching threshold. Any digital jitter or switching bounce (>20 mV) on the inhibit control line coupled into VDD or VBB will prematurely corrupt marginal weak cells.
critics.supply_chain: Implementing low-jitter hardware-timed gating on COTS ESP32 controller test fixtures requires discrete fast-switching logic buffers (e.g., 74LVC1G series or discrete PECL/LVDS transceivers) and precision RF coaxial cabling (SMA to microstrip pigtails). Sourcing automotive-grade -40°C to 125°C rated precision surface-mount pulse-forming gates and ultra-low jitter crystal oscillators (TCXO < 1 ps RMS phase jitter) must be secured across multiple distributors (DigiKey, Mouser, LCSC) with minimum 16-week safety stock.
critics.laya_pm: The Shmoo telemetry engine schedule is on the critical path for Gen 2 silicon characterization. Designing custom discrete hardware gating logic must not expand firmware testing cycle time beyond the allocated sprint window. Clock jitter and duty-cycle distortion on the ESP32 timer output exceeding 250 ps, introducing timing measurement uncertainty in retention Shmoo plots.

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180NM-SHMOO-001`  
**Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

---

## 1. Scope & Objective
Establish a rigorous oscilloscope metrology routine to characterize supply voltage stepping ($V_{DD}$), refresh inhibit pause transients, and bitline read development margins during automated $V_{DD}$ vs. retention time Shmoo plot execution on 180nm folded bitline 1T1C DRAM cells ($8F^2$ footprint, $0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$).

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Testbench Calibration & Active Probing Setup**:
   - Terminate oscilloscope channels into high-impedance active differential probes (bandwidth $\ge 1.5\ \text{GHz}$, input capacitance $< 0.8\ \text{pF}$).
   - Connect Channel 1 to the stepped core $V_{DD}$ rail at the chip decap entry pad.
   - Connect Channel 2 to the Shmoo engine hardware trigger / pause flag output from the microcontroller/FPGA.
   - Connect differential probe pair (Channels 3 & 4) to analog test pads for complementary bitlines ($BL$ and $\overline{BL}$).
   - Set probe attenuation and calibrate baseline DC offsets with bitlines equalized to $V_{DD} / 2$.

2. **Hardware Trigger & Step Synchronization**:
   - Configure oscilloscope trigger source to Channel 2 (rising edge on Shmoo hardware-timed step transition).
   - Set horizontal timebase to record across the variable retention pause interval before March pattern readback commences.

3. **$V_{DD}$ Step Settle Time & Transient Droop Metrology**:
   - Measure $V_{DD}$ settling time following a programmed voltage step.
   - Verify that transient ringing, rail bounce, or step droop on $V_{DD}$ dampens completely within the hardware-timed transition window before the sense amplifier equalizers turn off.

4. **Bitline Signal Development & Differential Sensing ($\Delta V$) Capture**:
   - Verify equalization network turns off, releasing $BL$ and $\overline{BL}$ from precharge level $V_{DD} / 2$.
   - Monitor wordline assertion ($L = 180\ \text{nm}$, $W = 220\ \text{nm}$ access NMOS active).
   - Capture differential signal development:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$
   - Measure $\Delta V$ immediately prior to sense amplifier latch activation (SAN pull-down / SAP pull-up).

5. **Automated Shmoo Step Pass/Fail Bit-Flip Correlation**:
   - Cross-correlate oscilloscope trace persistence with the March pattern bit-flip telemetry stream.
   - Flag bit-cell retention failure when sensing margins fall below threshold or March readback registers bit errors.

---

## 3. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Read Differential Signal ($\Delta V$)** | $100 \text{ to } 150$ | $\text{mV}$ | Oscilloscope differential readout on $BL - \overline{BL}$ |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 25 \text{ to } 30$ (Nominal: $28$) | $\text{fF}$ | Stacked MIM / ONO crown capacitance extraction |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_b$ / $C_{BL}$)** | $150 \text{ to } 250$ | $\text{fF}$ | Metrology extraction across 256–512 cells/bitline |
| **Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | $5:1 \text{ to } 9:1$ ($< 10:1$ strictly) | Dimensionless ratio | Capacitance bridge / metrology ratio calculation |
| **Cell Leakage Current ($85^\circ\text{C}$)** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Shmoo retention pause bit-flip threshold |

---

## 4. Literature & Context Citations

- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: Differential sensing with cross-coupled CMOS latch; precharge equalization to $V_{DD} / 2$; charge dump $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{BL})$; differential signal development $\Delta V = [C_s / (C_{BL} + C_s)] \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{DD}/2) \approx 100\ \text{mV} \text{ to } 150\ \text{mV}$ for $C_s = 25\ \text{fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\ \text{fF}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Unit cell geometry $L = 180\ \text{nm}$, $W = 220\ \text{nm}$; stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) with ONO/high-$\kappa$ dielectric; minimum $28\ \text{fF/cell}$ budget; leakage current $< 1\ \text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**: $8F^2$ folded bitline cell area ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\ \text{nm}$); storage capacitance $C_s \ge 25\text{--}30\ \text{fF}$ (nominal $28\ \text{fF}$); bitline parasitic $C_b = 150\text{--}250\ \text{fF}$ (256/512 cells per bitline); capacitance ratio $C_b / C_s$ bounded between $5:1$ and $9:1$ ($< 10:1$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Transient voltage dips during DAC/LDO VDD stepping on the ESP32-controlled Shmoo telemetry testbed must settle within 10 us to prevent premature DRAM sense amplifier latch failures that mimic false cell retention leakage. Coupling between the ESP32 GPIO high-speed switching edges and the analog VDD rail requires strict Kelvin 4-wire remote sensing directly at the package supply pin with an RC damping snubber, otherwise inductive ring-down (>50 mV pk-pk) will invalidate the March-C retention matrix.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm planar DRAM nodes, dynamic retention time is acutely sensitive to VDD scaling; a 100 mV step downward reduces the storage cell capacitor charge (Q = C_cell * VDD) below the minimum sensing margin (V_signal = (C_s / (C_s + C_bl)) * (VDD/2 - V_th)). Oscilloscope transient metrology must verify that during the refresh inhibit pause interval (10 ms to 2000 ms), the supply rail maintains <0.2% ripple and zero thermal drift, avoiding artificial sub-threshold channel conduction in the access transistor.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: COTS mixed-signal oscilloscopes (e.g., Rigol DHO804 or Siglent SDS1104X-E) and low-noise active differential probes with >=200 MHz bandwidth are commercially accessible off-the-shelf in Vietnam with zero ITAR/dual-use export controls. Utilizing standard high-impedance 10:1 passive probes is acceptable only if ground spring clips are mandatory, as 6-inch alligator ground leads inject >15 nH parasitic inductance, distorting transient settling time captures.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Execution of this metrology package is on the critical path prior to closing Gen 2 fab verification runs; metrology throughput must be automated via PyVISA/SCPI over USB-TMC. Capturing 256-point voltage step transients manually will delay the Shmoo plot calibration by 14 days, risking test-socket thermal degradation under ambient tropical laboratory humidity.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Inductive ground bounce on oscilloscope probe ground leads masquerading as true VDD supply rail undershoot during sudden high-current refresh inhibit resume bursts.
1. LDO step slew rate saturation causing prolonged linear-region voltage droop (>100 us settling time), triggering sense-amp metastability and corrupted bit-flip coordinate mapping.
1. High ambient lab relative humidity (>75% RH) inducing surface leakage currents across test-socket pins, masking DRAM capacitor leakage during extended 2-second pause durations.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

Connect Oscilloscope Channel 1 to DUT VDD pin using a sub-10mm ground spring contact. 2. Configure Oscilloscope: Trigger on rising/falling edge of ESP32 step-sync strobe signal, 20 mV/div vertical scale with DC offset at target VDD, 5 us/div timebase, persistence mode infinite. 3. Record peak overshoot/undershoot voltage (V_peak) and calculate transient settling time (t_settle) to within ±0.5% (±9 mV) of nominal target VDD. | `Settling time t_settle must be <= 12.5 us for all 50 mV steps; peak transient undershoot/overshoot must not exceed 25.0 mV (<1.4% of 1.8V VDD); zero observed rail oscillation ringing after 20 us.` |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-SHMOO-2-2-3-02` | **Refresh Inhibit Pause DC Voltage Stability & Ripple Metrology** | Digital Storage Oscilloscope with AC/DC High-Resolution Acquisition (Hi-Res Mode >= 12-bit, 20 MHz bandwidth limit enabled), True-RMS Microvoltmeter / Metrology DMM (6.5 digit). | 1. Set oscilloscope to AC coupling, 2 mV/div, 50 ms/div roll mode or Hi-Res acquisition mode over the full 500 ms pause window. 2. Synchronize trigger with ESP32 refresh-inhibit pin (active high). 3. Measure maximum peak-to-peak AC noise (V_pp) and calculate DC drift (Delta-V_DC) over the entire 500 ms hold interval. 4. Re-verify DC level with 6.5-digit DMM logged via SCPI. | `AC ripple and periodic noise during pause hold must be <= 4.0 mV pk-pk; overall DC baseline drift across 500 ms pause must be <= 1.5 mV (<= 0.125% of 1.20V).` |

1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets (Keeth, Baker, Johnson, Lin - DRAM Circuit Design: Fundamental and High-Speed Topics)

critics.systems_engineer: Transient voltage dips during DAC/LDO VDD stepping on the ESP32-controlled Shmoo telemetry testbed must settle within 10 us to prevent premature DRAM sense amplifier latch failures that mimic false cell retention leakage. Coupling between the ESP32 GPIO high-speed switching edges and the analog VDD rail requires strict Kelvin 4-wire remote sensing directly at the package supply pin with an RC damping snubber, otherwise inductive ring-down (>50 mV pk-pk) will invalidate the March-C retention matrix.
critics.domain_expert: At 180nm planar DRAM nodes, dynamic retention time is acutely sensitive to VDD scaling; a 100 mV step downward reduces the storage cell capacitor charge (Q = C_cell * VDD) below the minimum sensing margin (V_signal = (C_s / (C_s + C_bl)) * (VDD/2 - V_th)). Oscilloscope transient metrology must verify that during the refresh inhibit pause interval (10 ms to 2000 ms), the supply rail maintains <0.2% ripple and zero thermal drift, avoiding artificial sub-threshold channel conduction in the access transistor.
critics.supply_chain: COTS mixed-signal oscilloscopes (e.g., Rigol DHO804 or Siglent SDS1104X-E) and low-noise active differential probes with >=200 MHz bandwidth are commercially accessible off-the-shelf in Vietnam with zero ITAR/dual-use export controls. Utilizing standard high-impedance 10:1 passive probes is acceptable only if ground spring clips are mandatory, as 6-inch alligator ground leads inject >15 nH parasitic inductance, distorting transient settling time captures.
critics.laya_pm: Execution of this metrology package is on the critical path prior to closing Gen 2 fab verification runs; metrology throughput must be automated via PyVISA/SCPI over USB-TMC. Capturing 256-point voltage step transients manually will delay the Shmoo plot calibration by 14 days, risking test-socket thermal degradation under ambient tropical laboratory humidity.
critical_failure_modes: Inductive ground bounce on oscilloscope probe ground leads masquerading as true VDD supply rail undershoot during sudden high-current refresh inhibit resume bursts.
LDO step slew rate saturation causing prolonged linear-region voltage droop (>100 us settling time), triggering sense-amp metastability and corrupted bit-flip coordinate mapping.
High ambient lab relative humidity (>75% RH) inducing surface leakage currents across test-socket pins, masking DRAM capacitor leakage during extended 2-second pause durations.

testcases.title: VDD Step Transient Settling Time & Dynamic Overshoot Verification
testcases.instrumentation: 12-bit High-Resolution Digital Storage Oscilloscope (>=200 MHz, 50-ohm DC coupled or 10:1 passive probe with ground spring, 1.25 GS/s), ESP32-S3 Firmware Stepping Engine, Precision Programmable LDO/DAC Board.
testcases.pre_conditions: DUT DRAM test socket mounted on low-impedance ground plane board; probe calibrated and compensated; ambient temperature stabilized at 25.0 ± 0.5 °C; ESP32 firmware loaded with 50 mV incremental VDD stepping sequence (1.80V down to 1.00V).
testcases.procedure: 1. Connect Oscilloscope Channel 1 to DUT VDD pin using a sub-10mm ground spring contact. 2. Configure Oscilloscope: Trigger on rising/falling edge of ESP32 step-sync strobe signal, 20 mV/div vertical scale with DC offset at target VDD, 5 us/div timebase, persistence mode infinite. 3. Execute 50 mV downward stepping burst across 16 discrete levels. 4. Record peak overshoot/undershoot voltage (V_peak) and calculate transient settling time (t_settle) to within ±0.5% (±9 mV) of nominal target VDD.

testcases.instrumentation: Digital Storage Oscilloscope with AC/DC High-Resolution Acquisition (Hi-Res Mode >= 12-bit, 20 MHz bandwidth limit enabled), True-RMS Microvoltmeter / Metrology DMM (6.5 digit).

Re-verify DC level with 6.5-digit DMM logged via SCPI.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Bit-Flip Error Telemetry Ingestion & Retention Failure Bitmap Metrology

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 2 (µm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Ingesting high-throughput bit-flip telemetry over asynchronous UART/SPI from the ESP32 while executing pause-refresh March tests creates buffer saturation risks under high defect densities. If the DMA ring buffer drops packets during burst retention failures, physical topological coordinates (X/Y bitline/wordline address decodes) will desynchronize from logical fault maps, corrupting downstream failure bitmap spatial clustering and Shmoo contour generation.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm planar DRAM nodes, cell leakage is dominated by subthreshold junction leakage, gate-induced drain leakage (GIDL), and dielectric pinhole trap-assisted tunneling. The telemetry ingestion metrology engine must decouple true storage capacitor retention decay (1.8V nominal core VDD scaled down to sub-1.0V) from sense-amplifier latch offset drift and row-hammer disturbs by strictly enforcing deterministic March C- patterns with calibrated thermal soaking.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Relying on standard commercial off-the-shelf ESP32-WROOM/WROVER modules for probe card metrology introduces batch-to-batch clock jitter and ADC non-linearities. Automotive-grade ESP32-WROOM-32UE or external SPI-based galvanically isolated instrumentation PHYs must be second-sourced alongside ESD protection arrays to avoid interface burnout during wafer-level direct prober touch-downs.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: To maintain Gen 2 cadence, the closed-loop telemetry ingest pipeline and bitmap visualizer must converge into standardized open-source wafer map formats (e.g., Klarf or mapped CSV/HDF5) within the sprint cycle; proprietary data formats will block handover to the inline Karl Suss MA6 alignment and etching correlation work packages.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Telemetry packet drop during burst retention failure cascades, causing missing spatial bit coordinates and skewed Shmoo retention boundaries.
1. Ground bounce and cross-talk between high-speed ESP32 GPIO lines and unbuffered prober needles inducing false bit flips in adjacent weak DRAM cells.
1. Misalignment of logical-to-physical address scrambling tables, leading to inaccurate topological defect localization (e.g., misidentifying wordline shorts as isolated single-cell leakage).

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-SHMOO-2-3-01` | **Variable Retention Pause March C- Bit-Flip Telemetry Ingestion Verification** | ESP32 Closed-Loop Test Fixture, Agilent/Keysight E3631A Triple Output DC Power Supply (programmable VDD), Tektronix MSO54 4-Channel Mixed Signal Oscilloscope (UART/SPI protocol decoding), Host PC running Python Metrology Ingest Engine. | 1. Host metrology engine sends JSON command packet to ESP32 to initialize March C- write background (All 0s). 2. ESP32 applies retention pause timer calibrated from 10 ms to 1000 ms in logarithmic steps of 10 ms. 3. Read array and capture address and bit-flip polarities (0->1 or 1->0) via DMA streaming buffer. 4. Step VDD down from 1.80V to 0.80V in 20 mV increments. 5. Ingestion engine parses serial stream, validates packet CRC-16 checksums, and maps error coordinates to spatial bitmap. | `Packet loss rate must be strictly 0.000% across >= 10,000,000 transmitted bit-audit transactions; bit-flip spatial coordinates must match simulated fault injector ground truth with 100% address accuracy; timestamp jitter between pause completion and telemetry capture < 5.0 microseconds.` |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-SHMOO-2-3-02` | **Retention Failure Topological Bitmap Metrology & Shmoo Boundary Extraction** | Keithley 2450 SourceMeter (sub-picoamp precision core leakage validation), ESP32 Ingestion Metrology Engine, High-Resolution Wafer Prober Chuck with Thermal Controller (-10°C to +85°C). | 1. Soak wafer chuck at 85.0°C. 2. Execute retention pause ladder (50 ms, 100 ms, 200 ms, 500 ms, 1000 ms) across supply voltage range VDD = 1.0V to 1.8V. 3. Telemetry ingestion engine reconstructs 2D physical bitmap raster. 4. Apply 2D spatial clustering algorithm (DBSCAN / connected components) to categorize defects into Single Bit Failures (SBF), Row Fails (RF), Column Fails (CF), and Cluster Fails. 5. Generate Shmoo contour boundary curve separating passing retention space from fail space. | `Shmoo retention boundary contour repeatability across 5 consecutive runs must be within delta VDD <= 10 mV and delta retention time <= 2.5%; spatial categorization precision >= 99.5% against manual microscope prober optical inspection.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ANSI Z87.1 approved UV-blocking safety spectacles, Static dissipative ESD cleanroom lab coat, Nitrile cleanroom gloves (Class 100 / ISO 5 compatible, minimum 4 mil thickness), ESD wrist strap connected to single-point verified cleanroom earth ground
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye exposure: Flush eyes immediately with copious amounts of clean water at emergency eyewash station for at least 15 minutes while lifting upper and lower eyelids; seek immediate medical attention. Inhalation: Move subject to fresh air immediately; if breathing is labored, administer oxygen via trained personnel. Skin contact: Wash affected skin thoroughly with non-abrasive soap and water.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operation of cleaning solvents and hot wafer stage must be conducted under localized exhaust ventilation / chemical bench fume hood with face velocity maintain at 0.5 m/s (100 FPM) minimum, venting directly to exterior solvent exhaust scrubber.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA and cleaning solvent wipes must be collected in dedicated, grounded, flame-proof safety containers labeled 'Hazardous Waste - Flammable Organic Solvents'; do not drain dispose. No halogenated or heavy metal contamination permitted.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Grade (VLSI / MOS Grade) | `99.9%` |
| **Deionized Water (DI H2O)** | `7732-18-5` | Ultra-Pure / ASTM D5127 Type E-1 (18.2 MOhm-cm at 25C) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched/passivated 180nm wafer die with aluminum/gold wire-bond or probe pads free of native oxide hydration, organic residues, and particulate contamination (MIL-STD-883 Method 2010 Class Level A).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Electrically exercised probe pads with scrubbing marks <= 25% of pad area, zero micro-fracturing or pad cratering, and sealed in dry N2 purged vacuum carrier container.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture absorption and atmospheric airborne molecular contamination (AMC) causing probe pad corrosion, high contact resistance (> 5 Ohms), and ESD-sensitive gate oxide breakdown during repeated probe contact.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full deployment and validation of an automated ESP32 closed-loop telemetry ingestion engine capable of capturing real-time bit-flip stream data during variable retention March tests on 180nm open-source DRAM dies, reconstructing de-scrambled topological failure bitmaps, and outputting calibrated VDD-versus-retention-time Shmoo plots.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `retention_failure_bitmap_512x512.tiff`
- [ ] `shmoo_vdd_vs_retention_telemetry.csv`
- [ ] `dram180_metrology_validation_report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Telemetry streaming ingestion packet loss across UART/SPI interface during peak bit-flip burst** | `0.00` | +0.0001% | Automated hardware CRC-16 packet validation and missing sequence number counter over 10^7 March operations |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Topological bitmap spatial coordinate de-scrambling resolution matching physical layout** | `100.0` | 0.0% | Deterministic test address injection comparing simulated known-good defect coordinates with reconstructed raster bitmap |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Shmoo retention boundary extraction VDD threshold measurement repeatability** | `1.200` | +/- 0.010 V | 5-point automated iterative voltage ramp and pause soak sweep at 25.0 deg C across calibrated SourceMeter |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Zero missing packets during continuous 12-hour thermal stress Shmoo test run, successful topological bitmap rendering matching GDSII wordline/bitline array coordinates, and formal sign-off approval from both Systems Engineer and Metrology Domain Lead.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## High-Throughput UART/SPI Telemetry Ingestion Pipeline & Error Frame Parser

- **Document Path**: [docs/sop_telemetry_ingestion_pipeline.md](./docs/sop_telemetry_ingestion_pipeline.md)
- **Document ID**: `SOP-MET-DRAM-002`
- **Domain**: DRAM Foundation VN — Metrology & Ingestion Pipeline
- **Target Node**: Gen 2 ($180\,\text{nm}$) Stacked Capacitor Folded Bitline DRAM

---

### Ingestion & Metrology Pipeline Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    ESP32 March Test    │
│         Engine         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │UART / SPI Frame
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Ring Buffer       │
│       Ingestion        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  COBS / CRC32 Decoder  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Bit-Flip Bitmap     │
│       Metrology        │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Step 1: Physical Link & DMA Ring Buffer Allocation**
   - Connect ESP32 diagnostic lines to Host UART/SPI bridge.
   - Configure line discipline to **921,600 baud (8-N-1)** for UART or **10.0 MHz SCLK** for SPI.
   - Allocate contiguous $64\,\text{KB}$ DMA circular ring buffer on the host ingestion interface.

2. **Step 2: Delimited Stream Slicing & COBS Decoding**
   - Poll ring buffer read pointers and detect `0x00` frame boundary bytes.
   - Execute in-place COBS (Consistent Overhead Byte Stuffing) decoding on extracted frame slices to restore original unescaped telemetry frames:
     $$\text{Frame} = [\text{LEN}_{1\text{B}} \parallel \text{FLAGS}_{1\text{B}} \parallel \text{CYCLE\_ID}_{4\text{B}} \parallel V_{\text{DD\_MV}, 2\text{B}} \parallel \text{ROW}_{2\text{B}} \parallel \text{COL}_{2\text{B}} \parallel \text{EXP}_{1\text{B}} \parallel \text{ACT}_{1\text{B}} \parallel \text{CRC32}_{4\text{B}}]$$

3. **Step 3: CRC32 Integrity Gating**
   - Calculate IEEE 802.3 CRC32 ($0x04C11DB7$) across payload bytes $[0 \dots N-5]$.
   - Validate against the 4-byte frame trailer at offset $N-4$. Reject and log corrupt packets; zero-out state and re-align to the next delimiter.

4. **Step 4: Bit-Flip Vector Extraction & Coordinate Mapping**
   - Compute error bitmask: $\text{MASK} = \text{EXP\_DATA} \oplus \text{ACT\_DATA}$.
   - Map logical `(ROW, COL)` address pairs to physical $8F^2$ Folded Bitline topology ($0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2$ unit cell, $L=180\,\text{nm}, W=220\,\text{nm}$).
   - Push normalized coordinate tuples `(CYCLE_ID, VDD_MV, ROW, COL, MASK)` to the downstream Retention Failure Bitmap Metrology buffer.

---

### Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

```text
               Ingestion & Parser Pipeline Health (%)   
            ┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐
            │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
Bitmap Store┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
            │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
   CRC Check┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
  Parser FSM┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
            │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
 UART Buffer┤██████████████████████████████████████████│
            │██████████████████████████████████████████│
            └┬─────────┬──────────┬─────────┬─────────┬┘
             0        25         50        75       100 
```

1. **Sustained Ingestion Throughput**: $\ge 90\,\text{kB/s}$ continuous over UART ($921,600\,\text{baud}$) and $\ge 1.0\,\text{MB/s}$ over SPI ($10.0\,\text{MHz}$) without OS kernel buffer drops.
2. **Packet Loss / Overrun Ratio**: $\le 0.001\%$ ($< 1$ dropped frame per $100,000$ transmitted failure frames) under continuous burst error activity.
3. **Parsing & CRC32 Verification Latency**: Execution time $\le 15\,\mu\text{s}$ per 18-byte frame.
4. **Coordinate Mapping Fidelity**: $100.0\%$ address accuracy against physical folded bitline memory coordinates ($0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2$ unit footprint).

---

### Citations & Literature Context
- **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**: $8F^2$ folded bitline footprint ($0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\,\text{nm}$); storage node capacitance $C_s \ge 28\,\text{fF}$; bitline parasitic capacitance $C_b = 150\text{--}250\,\text{fF}$; $C_b/C_s$ budget between $5:1$ and $9:1$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Transistor dimensions $L = 180\,\text{nm}, W = 220\,\text{nm}$; minimum $28\,\text{fF}$ per cell charge capacity; leakage ceiling $< 1\,\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **SkyWater 130nm Open PDK Overview & Architecture**: Open PDK digital cell libraries and open EDA verification methodology.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Ingesting high-throughput bit-flip telemetry from an ESP32 closed-loop DRAM retention characterization rig via UART (up to 3-6 Mbps) or SPI (>10 MHz) creates severe backpressure bottlenecks on host memory buffers if serialization lacks hardware flow control (RTS/CTS) and packetized CRC-16 delimitation. Host thread starvation during parallel Shmoo sweep stepping will cause silent ring buffer overflow and dropped retention failure coordinates.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: DRAM retention bit-flip distributions follow non-uniform Poisson and Weibull decay profiles; bursty multi-cell failures during low-VDD/long-retention regimes generate dense error bursts. The framing protocol must implement run-length encoding (RLE) or coordinate-delta compaction to prevent telemetry saturation when retention pause sweeps exceed 500 ms and cascade into row-wide leakage.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: COTS USB-UART/SPI bridge ICs (e.g., FTDI FT232H / FT4232H or CP2102N) suffer from driver-dependent latency jitter across operating systems. In-line optocouplers or high-speed digital isolators (e.g., ADuM1401) required between the DUT testhead and ingest PC must be sourced with verified sub-15ns propagation delay to prevent clock/data skew at >10 MHz SPI rates.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Telemetry pipeline integration sits directly on the critical path between Gen 2 micron-scale physical alignment testing and full-die wafer-level yield verification. Delays in parser validation directly stall the automated VDD vs retention Shmoo engine sign-off and consume scarce cleanroom testing slots.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Host receiver buffer overflow during avalanche bit-flip bursts at minimum retention threshold voltages, causing loss of retention bitmap spatial integrity.
1. Framing desynchronization from electrostatic discharge (ESD) noise spikes on unshielded SPI/UART lines, resulting in misidentified row/column address bits.
1. Latency jitter in the host parser causing timing skew between applied DUT VDD stepped DAC updates and logged bit-flip timestamps.

Connect ESP32 UART TX/RX/RTS/CTS to FT232HQ. 2. Initialize host telemetry daemon with timestamp logging. 3. Trigger 10^7 consecutive pseudo-random bit-flip error frames (16-byte fixed payload: 32-bit row/col address, 16-bit VDD DAC state, 32-bit retention delay in us, 16-bit CRC). 4. Measure end-to-end packet arrival rate, parser CPU utilization, and drop count over 60 continuous minutes. | `Zero (0) dropped frames out of 10,000,000 transmitted packets (Packet Loss Rate = 0.00%). CRC checksum mismatch rate < 0.0001%. Mean host ingest parser throughput >= 2.50 Mbps sustained with peak CPU load <= 25%.` |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-SHMOO-2-3-1-02` | **High-Speed SPI Slave DMA Burst Telemetry and FIFO Drain Latency Validation** | ESP32-S3 configured as SPI Master (12 MHz SCLK), Logic Analyzer (Saleae Logic Pro 16) monitoring SCLK/MOSI/MISO/CS, Host High-Speed SPI-to-USB endpoint (FTDI FT4222H in SPI Slave Mode 0). | 1. Configure SPI bus to 12.0 MHz. 2. Inject synthetic 1024-byte error bitmap blocks representing row retention degradation at 50 ms pause intervals. 3. Transmit 100 consecutive 1024-byte bursts under active Shmoo voltage ramping (VDD 1.8V to 1.0V in 10mV steps). 4. Capture signal transitions on Saleae logic analyzer and measure inter-burst latency and host-side byte parsing latency. | `100% byte integrity match across all 100 blocks (102,400 bytes). Maximum parser frame processing latency <= 1.20 ms per 1024-byte block. SPI clock jitter < 5.0 ns at 12.0 MHz.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ESD-safe dissipative lab coat, Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (static dissipative, 6 mil), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV-filtering safety glasses, Grounded heel straps / ESD wrist strap with 1 MOhm current-limiting resistor
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact: Flush immediately with continuous eyewash stream for at least 15 minutes. Inhalation of solvent/flux vapor: Relocate personnel to fresh air immediately; administer oxygen if dyspneic. Skin exposure: Wash affected area with mild soap and copious deionized water. Seek immediate medical evaluation if ocular irritation persists.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Benchtop localized laminar exhaust snorkel hood operating at >= 100 linear feet per minute (LFPM) face velocity during PCB cleaning and board-level connector rework.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent IPA cleaning wipes and solvent run-off in dedicated, airtight, FM-approved flammable waste containers lined with conductive ESD-safe bags. Hand over to certified hazardous waste disposal contractor; do not drain to municipal sewers.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) Electronic Grade** | `67-63-0` | VLSI / Semiconductor Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Lead-Free Solder Rosin Flux Residue (Modified Colophony)** | `8050-09-7` | Technical Grade | `<5.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Gold-plated/OSP testhead PCB telemetry contact pads clean, free of organic flux residues and ionic salt contamination (< 1.5 ug/cm^2 NaCl equivalent).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Enclosed or desiccated testhead assembly with dry N2 purged connector housings ready for probe station mounting.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Atmospheric moisture absorption and copper/silver tarnishing causing contact resistance elevation (> 500 mOhm) on SPI/UART high-speed lines, inducing signal attenuation, edge reflection, and packet framing corruption.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Fully deployed and validated telemetry ingestion pipeline and error frame parser capable of decoding continuous DRAM bit-flip streams via high-baud UART (3 Mbps) or SPI (12 MHz) without packet drops, correctly formatting spatial failure coordinates for real-time retention Shmoo plot rendering.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram_telemetry_parser_validation_report.pdf`
- [ ] `bit_flip_ingestion_stress_test_log.csv`
- [ ] `reconstructed_retention_bitmap_validation.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Maximum sustained zero-loss UART ingestion data rate** | `3.00` | +/- 0.05 Mbps | Continuous streaming of 10^7 framed packets over 60 minutes verified by automated bit-level diff against transmitter PRBS sequence. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Host parser end-to-end frame decoding latency per 16-byte record** | `4.50` | <= 1.00 us | High-resolution monotonic timer benchmarking on host parser loop over 1,000,000 decoded frames. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Retention failure address mapping reconstruction accuracy** | `100.00` | 0.00% error | Comparison between hardware injected DRAM row/column error coordinates and parser-generated 2D bitmap output matrix. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researcher exit sign-off requires 100% verification across all quantitative assertions, zero unhandled parser exceptions over 24-hour continuous burn-in test, and formal sign-off signatures from the Metrology Lead and Systems Engineer on the validation report.

### Physical Address Descrambling & 2D Bit-Flip Topology Reconstruction Engine (Gen 2 / 180nm)

This Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) has been captured in [`docs/sop_physical_address_descrambling_engine.md`](./docs/sop_physical_address_descrambling_engine.md).

#### Reconstruction Workflow Diagram
```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Logical Bit-Flip    │
│  Telemetry Ingestion   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Descramble Inverted   │
│  Wordlines / Bitlines  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Map Folded Bitline   │
│    8F2 Topo: Pitch     │
│       360-400nm        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   2D Physical Array    │
│    Reconstruction:     │
│    256/512 Cells/BL    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Spatial Defect     │
│      Clustering &      │
│   Retention Heatmap    │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

#### Physical Metric Baseline Distribution
```text
                  ┌────────────────────────────────────┐
                  │░                                   │
Leakage Limit (fA)┤░                                   │
                  │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
  Pitch WL/BL (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
  C_s Nominal (fF)┤▓▓▓▓                                │
                  │▓▓▓▓                                │
   Cell Area (um2)┤█                                   │
                  │█                                   │
                  └┬────────┬────────┬───────┬────────┬┘
                   0       90       180     270     360 
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Logical Ingestion & Inversion Sanitization**:
   - Ingest raw telemetry failure tuples `[Bank, Row, Col, Polarity]`.
   - Realign bitline polarity by evaluating complementary folded bitline tracks ($\text{BL}$ vs $\overline{\text{BL}}$) against physical capacitor charge states.
2. **Address Bus Descrambling**:
   - Descramble row addresses $A_{R}$ to physical Wordline indexes $Y_{\text{phy}}$ matching sub-array decoder routing.
   - Descramble column addresses $A_{C}$ to physical Bitline tracks $X_{\text{phy}}$ spaced at **$360\text{--}400\ \text{nm}$ pitch**.
3. **2D Physical Cell Mapping**:
   - Reconstruct blocks matching **$256$ or $512$ cells per bitline**.
   - Group adjacent pairs sharing a common tungsten (W-plug) contact over bitline (COB) occupying an **$8F^2$ ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$) footprint** (access transistor length $L = 180\ \text{nm}$, width $W = 220\ \text{nm}$).
4. **Defect Clustering & Heatmap Generation**:
   - Correlate bit-flips with storage node leakage ($> 1\ \text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ or $C_s < 25\ \text{fF}$ vs nominal $28\ \text{fF}$).
   - Differentiate single-cell retention defects from shared-contact or continuous wordline/bitline shorts across the array.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Metric ID | Metric Parameter | Target Value / Tolerance | Physical Unit | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Unit Cell Footprint Grid Accuracy | $0.259 \pm 0.005$ | $\mu\text{m}^2$ | CAD GDSII Overlay Validation ($8F^2$ at $F = 180\ \text{nm}$) |
| **AC-02** | Bitline / Wordline Physical Pitch | $360 \text{ to } 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | Coordinate Reconstruction Step Pitch Verification |
| **AC-03** | Sub-Array Block Line Density | Exactly $256$ or $512$ | $\text{cells/bitline}$ | Telemetry Array Dimension Check |
| **AC-04** | Bit-Flip Retention Leakage Bound | Sub-threshold/Junction $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | Automated Shmoo Metrology ($> 64\ \text{ms}$ retention threshold) |

---

### Literature Context Sources
- *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* (W-plug shared contact, $L = 180\ \text{nm}, W = 220\ \text{nm}$, leakage $< 1\ \text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$, $C_s \ge 28\ \text{fF}$).
- *1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets* ($8F^2$ footprint area $0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$, $C_s \ge 25\text{--}30\ \text{fF}$, $256/512\ \text{cells/bitline}$, $C_b = 150\text{--}250\ \text{fF}$, $C_b/C_s \in [5:1, 9:1]$).
- *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* (WL/BL pitch $360\text{--}400\ \text{nm}$, retention $> 64\ \text{ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$, $t_{\text{ox}} \sim 3.5\ \text{nm}\ \text{SiO}_2$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The ingestion pipeline between ESP32 serial telemetry and the 2D topology reconstruction host engine must accommodate variable UART packet delays and line dropouts without corrupting bitmap coordinate matrices. The physical descrambling module needs deterministic bit-manipulation LUTs or polynomial de-swizzling maps to reconstruct logical row/column addresses into exact die-level X/Y grid coordinates across memory banks.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: DRAM cell topologies in 180nm processes often employ folded bitline architectures with interleaved sense amplifiers and twisted metal routing, meaning logical bit consecutive addresses do not map monotonically to physical capacitor silicon coordinates. Furthermore, true/anti-cell data polarity inversions must be accounted for during data retention pattern audits to prevent misclassifying data-dependent leakage as bitline coupling failures.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: The host-side metrology workstation and telemetry interface rely on standard USB-to-UART bridging silicon (CP2102/CH340) and open-source scientific Python compute stacks (NumPy/SciPy/OpenCV); avoiding proprietary wafer-sort memory analysis licenses ensures cost sovereignty, but high-baud USB serial integrity requires shielded, ferrite-choked cables to prevent packet drops in high-EMI lab environments.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Delivery milestone requires that topological heatmaps and failure coordinates align with GDSII layout mask coordinates within Gen 2 tolerances (+/- 5 um physical verification target), ensuring downstream laser trimming or defect physical inspection workflows are not stalled by coordinate mismatch discrepancies.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Address Descrambler LUT Inversion: Logical-to-physical address permutation errors mapping single-bit cell failures to inverted adjacent wordline coordinates, masking physical row-hammer and cell-to-cell bridging signatures.
1. Data Inversion Bitmask Discrepancy: Failure to account for cell capacitor polarities (true vs inverted bit storage), resulting in false-positive retention leakage attribution on unwritten background patterns.
1. Telemetry Sync Slip: Serial frame dropping or unaligned byte parsing leading to row-column phase shifts across 2D reconstructed defect matrices.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-SHMOO-2-3-2-01` | **Deterministic Single-Bit Injection and Physical X/Y Topology Descrambler Validation** | Host Metrology PC running Bit-Flip Reconstruction Engine, ESP32 Retention Test Fixture, Agilent 34401A DMM monitoring supply VDD, Rigol DS1054Z Digital Storage Oscilloscope tracking UART TX/RX lines | 1. Inject 16 deterministic bit flips at known logical addresses: Row 0x00A, Col 0x015 across 4 banks. 2. Execute Variable Retention Pause telemetry read and capture raw JSON/binary bit-flip error stream. 3. Pass raw bitstream into the Physical Address Descrambling & 2D Bit-Flip Topology Reconstruction Engine. 4. Extract reconstructed physical coordinates (X_phys, Y_phys) and compare against GDSII layout cell capacitor centroids. | `Descrambled coordinate mapping error must be exactly 0 cells (100% deterministic spatial match across all 16 injected coordinates); physical X/Y placement matches GDSII capacitor centroid within 0.0 um logical delta.` |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-SHMOO-2-3-2-02` | **Full-Array Retention Shmoo 2D Spatial Defect Clustering and True/Anti-Cell Polarity Verification** | Host Compute Server with OpenCV/NumPy metrology engine, Programmable Keithley 2400 SourceMeter (VDD sweep 1.2V to 1.8V in 50mV steps), Temperature-controlled hot chuck at 85°C | 1. Perform automated VDD retention pause sweep from 1.8V down to 1.2V. 2. Stream all retention failure addresses to host engine. 3. Reconstruct full 2D spatial defect heatmap array. 4. Run DBSCAN spatial clustering algorithm on reconstructed 2D bitmap to classify random leakage versus physical bitline/wordline line defects. | `Reconstructed spatial resolution must resolve 1-cell defects across full 2D matrix; bitline/wordline failure clustering correctly identified with precision >= 99.0%; false polarity detection rate = 0%.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ESD-safe grounded wrist strap (1 Mohm series resistance), ANSI Z87.1 certified clear safety glasses with side shields, Class 100 cleanroom-compatible nitrile gloves (powder-free, 4 mil thickness), ESD-protective lab coat
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact: Flush eyes immediately with copious amounts of clean eyewash water for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Skin contact: Wash affected skin thoroughly with mild soap and water. Inhalation: Move to fresh air. If irritation persists, seek medical attention.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Retention Failure Spatial Bitmap Visualization & Cluster Defect Metrology

**Context & Scope:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) | Metrology Module  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm / 180nm Node) | **Action Type:** Make  
**Cell Architecture:** 1T1C Folded Bitline ($8F^2$, Cell Area = $0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$, $F = 180\text{ nm}$) with Stacked Capacitor (Crown/Cylinder) over Bitline (COB).

---

### Metrology Workflow

```text
┌──────────────────────────┐
│                          │
│     Ingest Telemetry     │
│           Logs           │
│                          │
└─────────────┬────────────┘
              │
              │
              ▼
┌──────────────────────────┐
│                          │
│      Physical BL/WL      │
│        Coordinate        │
│        Descramble        │
│                          │
└─────────────┬────────────┘
              │
              │
              ▼
┌──────────────────────────┐
│                          │
│    Compute 2D Spatial    │
│      Bitmap Density      │
│                          │
└─────────────┬────────────┘
              │
              │
              ▼
┌──────────────────────────┐
│                          │
│      Run Euclidean       │
│     Nearest Neighbor     │
│        Clustering        │
│                          │
└─────────────┬────────────┘
              │
              │
              ▼
┌──────────────────────────┐
│                          │
│        Morphology        │
│      Classification      │
│  Single/Row/Col/Cluster  │
│                          │
└─────────────┬────────────┘
              │
              │
              ▼
┌──────────────────────────┐
│                          │
│   Acceptance Metrology   │
│           Gate           │
│                          │
└──────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: Telemetry Ingestion & Format Validation
- Ingest raw bit-flip logs streamed from the ESP32 Retention Telemetry Engine (generated under variable retention pauses, testing targets up to $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
- Parse records containing `[Logical_Bank, Logical_Row, Logical_Col, Expected_Data, Actual_Data, Pause_Time_ms]`. Filter for retention-induced cell discharge errors ($1 \to 0$ discharge on capacitor storage node $C_s$).

#### Step 2: Physical Topology Descrambling (Logical-to-Physical Coordinate Mapping)
- Map logical addresses to physical array coordinates $(X, Y)$ using the 180nm $8F^2$ folded bitline topology mapping table:
  - **Bitline Pitch ($P_{BL}$):** $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$ along the $X$-axis.
  - **Wordline Pitch ($P_{WL}$):** $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$ along the $Y$-axis.
  - **Transistor Dimensions:** Channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Compute physical coordinates:
    $$X_i = \text{Descramble}_{BL}(\text{Bank}, \text{Col}) \times P_{BL}$$
    $$Y_i = \text{Descramble}_{WL}(\text{Bank}, \text{Row}) \times P_{WL}$$
- Account for shared bitline contacts (shared between two adjacent cells) and sub-array block boundaries ($256$ or $512$ cells per bitline).

#### Step 3: Spatial Bitmap Generation & Defect Clustering
- Construct a 2D binary fail matrix $M(X, Y) \in \{0, 1\}$ representing the physical array floorplan.
- Execute nearest-neighbor clustering (DBSCAN / Euclidean distance threshold) where the neighborhood radius is bounded by the pitch dimension:
  $$\varepsilon \le \sqrt{2} \times \max(P_{BL}, P_{WL}) \approx 509\text{ nm} \text{ to } 565\text{ nm}$$
- Group contiguous defective cells into defect clusters $\{C_k\}$.

#### Step 4: Cluster Morphology & Root-Cause Classification
Classify each cluster $C_k$ into standard physical defect morphologies:
1. **Single-Bit Retention Failures (Isolated):** Random junction/sub-threshold leakage exceeding $1\text{ fA/cell}$ or local micro-leakage in the dielectric ($C_s < 25\text{ fF}$).
2. **Bitline / Column Failures:** Contiguous fails along $Y$ ($P_{BL}$ constant). Root cause: Bitline short, open tungsten plug (W-plug), sense-amplifier imbalance, or $C_b > 250\text{ fF}$ driving $C_b / C_s > 10:1$.
3. **Wordline / Row Failures:** Contiguous fails along $X$ ($P_{WL}$ constant). Root cause: Wordline bridge, gate oxide breakdown ($\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ $\text{SiO}_2$), or pass-gate leakage.
4. **Area / Multi-Cell Clusters:** Failures extending across multiple adjacent rows and columns. Root cause: Lithographic bridging in stacked capacitor crown/cylinder structures, large particle contamination, or local thinning in ONO / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ high-$k$ dielectric stacks ($\text{EOT} = 3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$).

---

### Defect Morphology Inspection Metric

```text
           Spatial Retention Defect Morphology Breakdown
           ┌───────────────────────────────────────────┐
           │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
 Single Bit┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
           │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                             │
Row Failure┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                             │
Col Failure┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                                  │
           │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                                  │
Area Defect┤█████                                      │
           │█████                                      │
           └┬──────────┬─────────┬──────────┬─────────┬┘
           0.0       35.5      71.0       106.5   142.0 
```

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Condition | Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Nominal Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $28.0$ | Min $\ge 25.0$, Max nominal $30.0$ | $\text{fF}$ |
| **Cell Leakage Current Target** | $< 1.0$ | Measured at $85^\circ\text{C}$ across storage node | $\text{fA/cell}$ |
| **Parasitic Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | $5.0 : 1 \text{ to } 9.0 : 1$ | $C_b \in [150, 250]\text{ fF}$; Reject if $> 10.0 : 1$ | Dimensionless ratio |
| **Baseline Data Retention Time ($t_{ret}$)** | $> 64$ | At $T_j = 85^\circ\text{C}$ under nominal $V_{DD}$ | $\text{ms}$ |
| **Physical Array Cell Footprint** | $0.259$ | $8F^2$ Folded Bitline layout at $F = 180\text{ nm}$ | $\mu\text{m}^2$ |

---

### 3. Source Citations
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - Transistor gate channel $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) crown/MIM topology with W-plug drain contact.
  - ONO triple dielectric / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$k$ stack ($\kappa > 15$).
  - Storage node capacitance budget $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$; leakage limit $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source: 1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**
  - $8F^2$ folded bitline physical footprint ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$).
  - Storage capacitance $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF to } 30\text{ fF}$ (nominal $28\text{ fF}$).
  - Array block bitline parasitics $C_b = 150\text{ fF to } 250\text{ fF}$ (256/512 cells/BL).
  - Capacitance ratio constraint $C_b / C_s \in [5:1, 9:1]$ (severe read margin failure if $> 10:1$).
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - Minimum retention interval $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Bitline and wordline pitch $= 360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$.
  - Gate dielectric $\text{SiO}_2$ physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$; capacitor EOT $= 3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$ ($\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Ingesting asynchronous UART/SPI telemetry streams from the ESP32 closed-loop tester to reconstruct physical 2D/3D bit-cell topology introduces data alignment risks. Logical bit-line (BL) and word-line (WL) scrambling, dummy cell padding, and sense-amplifier interleaving must be strictly mapped to physical layout GDS coordinates. If UART drops framing bytes during high-frequency March test iterations, spatial defect localization will shift by integer offsets, corrupting spatial cluster metrics (e.g., Neyman-Scott defect cluster index). Packet framing requires 32-bit CRC validation and monotonic timestamping per burst.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: DRAM retention degradation under variable pause times follows a bi-modal tail distribution driven by variable retention time (VRT) and trap-assisted tunneling (TAT) across 180nm storage node deep depletion junctions. A cluster of retention failures along a single WL or adjacent BLs points directly to physical bridge defects, gate oxide breakdown, or junction leakage spikes caused by heavy metal contamination or dislocation loops. The spatial metrology engine must distinguish between isolated single-cell VRT outliers (Poisson distributed) and contiguous multi-cell clusters (Hough transform or DBSCAN clustering) with sub-micron spatial bounding.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: COTS ESP32-S3 boards, high-speed optocouplers (such as 6N137/ADuM1400 for ground-loop isolation), and USB-UART bridge chips (FT232H / CP2102N) are readily available through local distributors, but signal integrity across breadboard/custom daughterboard hookups is vulnerable to ringing. Custom PCB breakout with controlled impedance traces (50 ohm single-ended) and BNC/SMA probe points must be fabricated via rapid-turn PCB suppliers (e.g., JLCPCB 4-layer FR4) to avoid intermittent signal degradation during sub-millivolt VDD sweep telemetry.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Telemetry pipeline integration and defect clustering software must not stall physical wafer probing schedules. Development of the Python/Rust spatial bitmap ingestion module must be decoupled using simulated bit-flip test vectors before tapeout silicon arrival. Milestones must enforce automated schema validation and automated PDF/TIFF report generation within 15 minutes of shmoo completion to enable real-time fab feedback loops.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Logical-to-physical address scrambling mismatch causing cluster analysis algorithms to misidentify contiguous physical silicon defects as pseudo-random uniform failures.
1. Buffer overflow or dropped packets over the UART telemetry bridge during high error-rate pauses (>10% bit failure rate), corrupting the retention spatial bitstream.
1. Misclassification of global supply-rail droop or sense-amp bias collapse as localized lithographic cluster defects due to inadequate per-bank decoupling capacitance.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-SHMOO-2-3-3-01` | **Logical-to-Physical Bitmap Reconstruction & Cluster Isolation Verification** | ESP32-S3 Microcontroller Test Rig, Rigol DS1104Z Plus Oscilloscope (monitoring VDD/UART lines), Host PC running automated spatial metrology ingestion engine (Python 3.10 with OpenCV/SciPy DBSCAN clustering module). | 1. Initialize memory array with March C- pattern (solid 0s, solid 1s, checkerboard) via ESP32 test firmware. 2. Inject synthetic 8-cell contiguous cluster faults (WL[12:15], BL[4:5]) into test vectors, followed by a 2.5-second retention pause at VDD = 1.4V. 3. Trigger automated bitmap telemetry ingestion pipeline over serial interface. 4. Execute DBSCAN spatial clustering (epsilon = 1.5 physical pitches, min_samples = 3) on the ingested bit-flip coordinates. 5. Measure coordinate accuracy and computation time for cluster centroid extraction. | `Cluster centroid coordinates must match synthetic injection coordinates exactly (Delta X = 0.0 um, Delta Y = 0.0 um, 100% classification accuracy). Ingestion and spatial bitmap rendering of 64kbit array must complete in < 1200 ms with zero packet loss (CRC32 error count = 0).` |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-SHMOO-2-3-3-02` | **Retention Shmoo Telemetry Dynamic Range & Defect Density Quantification** | Keithley 2400 SourceMeter (precision VDD supply 0.8V - 2.0V), ESP32-S3 DUT Controller, environmental chamber stabilized at 25.0°C ± 0.5°C, Automated Telemetry Logger with Plotext/Matplotlib visualization export. | 1. Step VDD from 1.8V down to 1.0V in 50 mV decrements. 2. For each voltage step, sweep retention pause time from 10 ms to 10,000 ms across logarithmic intervals (10 steps per decade). 3. Record bit-error telemetry packets, extracting total bit-flip count and spatial coordinates per step. 4. Compute radial defect density (defects/cm^2) and evaluate nearest-neighbor cluster index (Clark-Evans ratio R). 5. Generate and export spatial bitmap TIFF image and comprehensive Shmoo CSV log. | `Telemetry stream must achieve 100% packet integrity across all 17 voltage steps and 31 pause duration points (total 527 test nodes). Calculated cluster index R must resolve with a standard deviation < 0.02 across 5 consecutive sweep iterations.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ANSI Z87.1 certified UV-filtering safety glasses / splash goggles, Nitrile chemical gloves (minimum 6 mil thickness, dual-layered during solvent handling), ESD-safe cleanroom coat (antistatic polyester/carbon grid), Polypropylene cleanroom apron and face shield during chemical tank dispensing
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For TMAH skin contact (CAS 75-59-2): Immediately flush affected skin under emergency deluge shower for a minimum of 15 minutes while stripping contaminated clothing. TMAH acts as a potent systemic neurotoxin and cholinergic agonist; administer immediate medical evaluation and treat with respiratory support if inhaled/absorbed. For eye contact: Irrigate eyes continuously using sterile saline or eyewash station for 20 minutes, holding eyelids open. For solvent inhalation (PGMEA/IPA): Remove victim to fresh uncontaminated air, provide supplemental oxygen if dyspneic.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Wet chemical handling (MF-319, S1813 spin-coating, developer tanks) must be strictly confined to a dedicated polypropylene laminar-flow wet bench with active exhaust face velocity maintained at 100 ± 10 FPM (0.51 m/s). Exhaust ducts must be tied to an acid/solvent scrubber system. Electronic testing bench requires a local HEPA downflow hood (Class 100 / ISO 5) with antistatic ESD ionizers.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregate TMAH developer wastewater into dedicated organic alkali waste carboys; do not combine with acidic streams (violent exothermic neutralization risk). Neutralize dilute TMAH effluent using dilute citric acid or sulfuric acid down to pH 6.5 - 8.5 only in a certified industrial batch treatment tank. Spent photoresist and solvent-saturated rags must be stored in airtight UN-rated flammables disposal drums for certified hazardous incineration.

| **Shipley Microposit S1813 Photoresist (Propylene glycol monomethyl ether acetate, Diazo photoactive compound)** | `108-65-6` | VLSI Grade | `>70% PGMEA solvent matrix` |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Grade (MOS) | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly exposed metal/poly top pad surface, solvent-degreased via acetone/IPA ultrasonic wash, rinsed to >18 MOhm-cm DI water resistivity, and blown dry with filtered 0.02 um N2.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Electrically probed die surface with probe touchdown scrub marks < 15 um length; passivation layer intact without moisture condensation, post-test IPA-wiped, and desiccated.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air queue time causes native aluminum/copper oxidation on test pads, driving contact resistance > 10 ohms and leading to erratic VDD drop, false bit-flip telemetry triggers, and surface corrosion from ambient moisture/halides.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful ingestion, real-time spatial descrambling, and cluster defect analysis of DRAM retention test data yielding 2D spatial defect maps, DBSCAN cluster identification, and telemetry log archives compliant with Gen 2 180nm DRAM specifications.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:

- [ ] `retention_cluster_defect_metrics.csv`
- [ ] `shmoo_retention_vs_vdd_audit_report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

| `ASSERT-02` | **Physical cluster defect centroid localization accuracy relative to GDSII layout coordinates** | `0.0 um` | ± 0.2 um | Comparative verification of identified DBSCAN cluster boundary coordinates against known laser-injected and synthetic bit-flip coordinates. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **End-to-end telemetry ingestion and 2D spatial bitmap rendering latency per 64kbit array sweep** | `850 ms` | ± 150 ms | High-precision monotonic wall-clock timer benchmarking from final byte reception to uncompressed TIFF export. |

1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets (Keeth, Baker, Johnson, Lin - DRAM Circuit Design: Fundamental and High-Speed Topics)

critics.systems_engineer: Ingesting asynchronous UART/SPI telemetry streams from the ESP32 closed-loop tester to reconstruct physical 2D/3D bit-cell topology introduces data alignment risks. Logical bit-line (BL) and word-line (WL) scrambling, dummy cell padding, and sense-amplifier interleaving must be strictly mapped to physical layout GDS coordinates. If UART drops framing bytes during high-frequency March test iterations, spatial defect localization will shift by integer offsets, corrupting spatial cluster metrics (e.g., Neyman-Scott defect cluster index). Packet framing requires 32-bit CRC validation and monotonic timestamping per burst.
critics.domain_expert: DRAM retention degradation under variable pause times follows a bi-modal tail distribution driven by variable retention time (VRT) and trap-assisted tunneling (TAT) across 180nm storage node deep depletion junctions. A cluster of retention failures along a single WL or adjacent BLs points directly to physical bridge defects, gate oxide breakdown, or junction leakage spikes caused by heavy metal contamination or dislocation loops. The spatial metrology engine must distinguish between isolated single-cell VRT outliers (Poisson distributed) and contiguous multi-cell clusters (Hough transform or DBSCAN clustering) with sub-micron spatial bounding.
critics.supply_chain: COTS ESP32-S3 boards, high-speed optocouplers (such as 6N137/ADuM1400 for ground-loop isolation), and USB-UART bridge chips (FT232H / CP2102N) are readily available through local distributors, but signal integrity across breadboard/custom daughterboard hookups is vulnerable to ringing. Custom PCB breakout with controlled impedance traces (50 ohm single-ended) and BNC/SMA probe points must be fabricated via rapid-turn PCB suppliers (e.g., JLCPCB 4-layer FR4) to avoid intermittent signal degradation during sub-millivolt VDD sweep telemetry.
critics.laya_pm: Telemetry pipeline integration and defect clustering software must not stall physical wafer probing schedules. Development of the Python/Rust spatial bitmap ingestion module must be decoupled using simulated bit-flip test vectors before tapeout silicon arrival. Milestones must enforce automated schema validation and automated PDF/TIFF report generation within 15 minutes of shmoo completion to enable real-time fab feedback loops.
critical_failure_modes: Logical-to-physical address scrambling mismatch causing cluster analysis algorithms to misidentify contiguous physical silicon defects as pseudo-random uniform failures.
Buffer overflow or dropped packets over the UART telemetry bridge during high error-rate pauses (>10% bit failure rate), corrupting the retention spatial bitstream.
Misclassification of global supply-rail droop or sense-amp bias collapse as localized lithographic cluster defects due to inadequate per-bank decoupling capacitance.

# Standard Operating Procedure: High-Speed Shmoo Heatmap Telemetry Aggregator & Metrology Pipeline

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 2 (µm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Aggregating multi-dimensional VDD vs retention time matrices over high-speed telemetry channels (UART/USB/SPI/Ethernet) introduces packet jitter, FIFO overflow risk on the ESP32 bridge, and non-deterministic latency. Real-time telemetry binning requires strict backpressure flow control and deterministic DMA-driven memory buffering to prevent dropped test vectors or corrupted bitmask state telemetry during continuous shmoo sweeps across die matrices.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Characterizing DRAM cell retention at 180nm involves thermal acceleration governed by the Arrhenius relation alongside subthreshold leakage and junction band-to-band tunneling (BTBT). Correlating retention-time degradation with furnace-grown gate/tunnel dielectric quality requires precise synchronization between hot-chuck/thermal-furnace thermocouple data (maintaining +/- 0.5 deg C uniformity across isothermal zones) and high-speed multi-voltage shmoo passes to avoid misattributing trap-assisted leakage to voltage supply ripple.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: COTS ESP32 microcontrollers and high-speed instrumentation interface transceivers (FTDI FT4232H / W5500) exhibit varying silicon revisions and lead-time volatility. Sourcing industrial-grade parts rated for extended temperature ranges (-40 deg C to +105 deg C) alongside certified low-noise LDOs and calibrated SMUs is essential to maintain measurement accuracy in harsh thermal test environments without line disruptions.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Work package schedule risks stem from tight milestone dependencies between firmware shmoo step resolution, telemetry aggregation pipeline throughput, and automated heatmap generation. Firmware protocol freezes must precede Python/Rust metrology parser integration to ensure regression validation completes within the Gen 2 milestone window.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Telemetry packet drop during high-density shmoo iterations causing false fail-bins and distorted cell retention contour boundaries
1. Thermal drift of wafer chuck/environment (> 0.5 deg C shift) during multi-die rastering resulting in skewed retention activation energy (Ea) extraction
1. Ground bounce and power-rail ripple induced by ESP32 RF/high-current GPIO switching corrupting sub-mV VDD sweep resolution

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-SHMOO-3-01` | **Continuous Shmoo Telemetry Stream Bandwidth and Packet Loss Verification** | Logic Analyzer (Saleae Logic Pro 16 / 100MSps), Digital Storage Oscilloscope (Keysight DSOX3024T), Host Automated Test Bench running Python Pipeline | 1. Initiate automated VDD sweep from 1.2V to 2.2V in 10mV increments with retention hold times from 10ms to 10000ms logarithmically stepped. 2. Capture all telemetry packets over 100,000 continuous test vector iterations. 3. Monitor hardware RTS/CTS flow control lines and packet CRC32 error counters. 4. Verify received payload integrity against deterministic pseudo-random pattern generator (PRBS-7). | `Zero dropped packets across 100,000 frames (Frame Loss Rate = 0.00%), CRC32 error rate < 1e-6, and maximum aggregation pipeline processing latency < 5.0ms per 1024-byte telemetry block.` |
| `TC-MCU-COTS-SHMOO-3-02` | **VDD Sweep Voltage Accuracy and Retention Boundary Precision** | Keysight B2902B Precision Source/Measure Unit (SMU), 6.5-digit Digital Multimeter (Keithley 2000), Low-capacitance active probe (< 1pF) | 1. Program shmoo engine to sweep VDD across 100 discrete target voltages between 1.200V and 2.200V. 2. Record instantaneous voltage at DUT pin via DMM and SMU readback simultaneously. 3. Trigger memory cell retention readback pattern at each step and map pass/fail bit cell transition boundary. 4. Repeat measurement across 10 thermal cycles. | `Applied VDD voltage error <= +/- 2.0mV across entire 1.2V to 2.2V range; voltage settling time < 50us upon step transition; retention contour boundary repeatability within +/- 1 step resolution.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level 1 Cleanroom Garments (Antistatic Nitrile Gloves, Conductive ESD Smock), ANSI Z87.1 Approved UV/Laser Safety Glasses (when optical microscope/thermal lasers deployed), Thermal Protective Gloves (rated to 200 deg C for heated wafer chuck operation)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin/eye contact with IPA, flush immediately with copious potable water for at least 15 minutes at eyewash station. In case of thermal chuck burns, immediately cool affected area with cold running water and seek emergency medical care. In case of N2 asphyxiation risk, evacuate personnel to open air and administer oxygen if breathing is labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated cleanroom local exhaust ventilation (LEV) operating at minimum face velocity of 0.5 m/s for solvent wipe-down areas; thermal chuck purge vented through certified facility exhaust.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA wipes and contaminated solvents must be segregated into closed, grounded, flame-proof hazardous solvent waste drums for certified solvent reclamation; zero drain disposal permitted.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Dry Nitrogen Gas (N2)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity 5.0 (99.999%) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `48 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-passivation/post-dicing clean die mounted on ceramic DIP/carrier or bare wafer with intact Si3N4/polyimide moisture barrier, zero particulate contamination (Class 100 spec).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Electrically probed die/wafer with probe mark scrubs within pad limits (< 25% pad area), desiccated and vacuum-sealed under dry N2 purge.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture adsorption and atmospheric oxidation of bond pads leading to elevated contact resistance (> 5 Ohm), non-ohmic contact behavior during Kelvin sensing, and false-positive retention tail bit distributions.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Delivery and deployment of an integrated high-speed automated telemetry aggregator and shmoo heatmap metrology pipeline capable of ingesting raw test vector telemetry, validating bit retention vs VDD, and rendering multi-die 2D/3D contour plots with full statistical outlier identification.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram_shmoo_telemetry_aggregator_v2.csv`
- [ ] `retention_vs_vdd_shmoo_heatmap_report.pdf`
- [ ] `wafer_die_retention_contour_map.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Telemetry pipeline aggregation ingestion throughput** | `20000 vectors/sec` | +/- 5% | Automated pipeline benchmarking script measuring sustained ingestion rate over 1,000,000 test vectors |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Shmoo VDD sweep measurement repeatability** | `99.95%` | +/- 0.05% | Gauge Repeatability and Reproducibility (Gage R&R) study across 30 consecutive thermal-electrical sweep cycles |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Heatmap visual matrix rendering latency** | `250 ms` | <= 50 ms | Benchmarking timestamp profiling of 100x100 grid matrix interpolation and raster image output |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Successful multi-die shmoo retention sweep of 180nm DRAM test array across 1.2V-2.2V with zero telemetry buffer overruns, automated PDF/CSV/TIFF generation, and formal technical sign-off by Systems Engineer and Metrology Domain Lead.
